refs.text_en: At that time Jesus went on the Sabbath through the grainfields. And His disciples became hungry and began to pick ears of grain and eat.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人看见，就对祂说，看哪，你的门徒在作安息日不可作的事。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人看見，就對祂說，看哪，你的門徒在作安息日不可作的事。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees, seeing this, said to Him, Behold, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣却对他们说，大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所作的，你们没有念过么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌卻對他們說，大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所作的，你們沒有念過麼？
refs.text_en: But He said to them, Have you not read what David did when he became hungry, and those who were with him;

refs.text_gb: 他怎样进了神的殿，他们且吃了陈设饼，就是他不可吃，跟从他的人也不可吃，唯独祭司才可吃的。
refs.text_big5: 他怎樣進了神的殿，他們且喫了陳設餅，就是他不可喫，跟從他的人也不可喫，惟獨祭司纔可喫的。
refs.text_en: How he entered into the house of God, and they ate the bread of the Presence, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, except for the priests only?

refs.text_gb: 再者，律法上记着，当安息日，祭司在殿里渎犯了安息日，还是没有罪，你们没有念过么？
refs.text_big5: 再者，律法上記著，當安息日，祭司在殿裏瀆犯了安息日，還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過麼？
refs.text_en: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

refs.text_gb: 但我告诉你们，在这里有比殿更大的。
refs.text_big5: 但我告訴你們，在這裏有比殿更大的。
refs.text_en: But I say to you that something greater than the temple is here.

refs.text_gb: 还有，你们若明白什么是“我要的是怜悯，不是祭祀，”就不会定无罪的为有罪了。

refs.text_en: But if you knew what this means, "I desire mercy and not sacrifice," you would not have condemned the guiltless.

refs.text_gb: 因为人子是安息日的主。
refs.text_big5: 因為人子是安息日的主。
refs.text_en: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

refs.text_en: And one Sabbath He was going through the grainfields, and His disciples were picking and eating the ears of grain, rubbing them in their hands.

refs.text_gb: 有几个法利赛人说，你们为什么作安息日不可作的事？
refs.text_big5: 有幾個法利賽人說，你們為甚麼作安息日不可作的事？
refs.text_en: And some of the Pharisees said, Why are you doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所作的，连这个你们也没有念过么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所作的，連這個你們也沒有念過麼？
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered them and said, Have you not even read this that David did when he became hungry, he and those who were with him;

refs.text_en: How he entered into the house of God, and taking the bread of the Presence, he ate it and gave some to those with him, which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests alone?

refs.text_gb: 祂又对他们说，人子是安息日的主。
refs.text_big5: 祂又對他們說，人子是安息日的主。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

refs.text_big5: 你若在安息日掉轉你的腳步，在我的聖日不作自己喜愛的事，稱安息日為可喜樂的，稱那歸耶和華為聖之日為可尊重的，並且尊重這日，不行自己的路，不尋求自己的喜樂，也不說閒話；
refs.text_en: If you turn back your foot from the Sabbath, / From doing whatever you please on My holy day, / And call the Sabbath a delight, / That which is holy to Jehovah honorable, / And honor it, not doing your own ways, / Nor finding your own pleasure and speaking idle words;

refs.text_gb: 你就以耶和华为乐；我要使你乘驾地的高处，又以你祖雅各的产业喂养你；这是耶和华亲口说的。

refs.text_en: Then you will have delight in Jehovah; / And I will cause you to ride upon the heights of the earth, / And I will feed you with the inheritance of Jacob your father; / For the mouth of Jehovah has spoken.

refs.text_en: When you go into your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck some ears with your hand; but you shall not wield a sickle upon your neighbor's standing grain.

refs.text_big5: 你要取細麵，烤成十二個餅，每個餅用細麵一伊法的十分之二。
refs.text_en: And you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes with it; two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each cake.

refs.text_gb: 要把饼摆成两行，每行六个，放在耶和华面前纯金的桌子上；
refs.text_big5: 要把餅擺成兩行，每行六個，放在耶和華面前純金的桌子上；
refs.text_en: And you shall set them in two rows, six in a row, on the table of pure gold before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 又要把纯乳香放在每行的饼上，作为记念，作为献给耶和华的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 又要把純乳香放在每行的餅上，作為記念，作為獻給耶和華的火祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall put pure frankincense on each row, so that it may be a memorial for the bread, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 每安息日要常常把饼摆列在耶和华面前；这要为以色列人作永远的约。
refs.text_big5: 每安息日要常常把餅擺列在耶和華面前；這要為以色列人作永遠的約。
refs.text_en: Every Sabbath day continually he shall set it in order before Jehovah; it is an everlasting covenant for the children of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 这饼是要给亚伦和他子孙的，他们要在圣处吃，因为这在献给耶和华的火祭中是至圣的，要归与亚伦；这是永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 這餅是要給亞倫和他子孫的，他們要在聖處喫，因為這在獻給耶和華的火祭中是至聖的，要歸與亞倫；這是永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, for it is most holy to him of Jehovah's offerings by fire, a perpetual statute.

verses.text_gb: 祂又对他们说，[Cra]安息日是为着人的，[Fn1]人不是为着[Crb]安息日的；
verses.text_big5: 祂又對他們說，[Cra]安息日是為著人的，[Fn1]人不是為著[Crb]安息日的；
verses.text_en: And He said to them, The Sabbath came into being for man, and not man for the Sabbath.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂又对他们说，安息日是为着人的，人不是为着安息日的；
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂又對他們說，安息日是為著人的，人不是為著安息日的；

footnotes.en: 2:27 1 not Man was not created for the Sabbath; rather, the Sabbath was ordained for man that he might enjoy it with God (Gen. 2:2-3).

refs.text_gb: 六日你要作工，第七日要停工，使牛、驴可以歇息，并使你婢女的儿子和寄居的，都得以舒畅。
refs.text_big5: 六日你要作工，第七日要停工，使牛、驢可以歇息，並使你婢女的兒子和寄居的，都得以舒暢。
refs.text_en: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall cease from work so that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your female servant and the sojourner may be refreshed.

refs.text_gb: 所以不拘在饮食上、或在节期、月朔、或安息日方面，都不可让人论断你们，
refs.text_big5: 所以不拘在飲食上、或在節期、月朔、或安息日方面，都不可讓人論斷你們，
refs.text_en: Let no one therefore judge you in eating and in drinking or in respect of a feast or of a new moon or of the Sabbath,

verses.text_gb: 所以[Cra]人子也是[Fn1]安息日的主。
verses.text_big5: 所以[Cra]人子也是[Fn1]安息日的主。
verses.text_en: So then the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以人子也是安息日的主。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以人子也是安息日的主。

refs.text_big5: 但要叫你們知道人子在地上有赦罪的權柄─就對癱子說，
refs.text_en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority to forgive sins on earth-He said to the paralytic,

verses.text_big5: [Fn1]耶穌又進了會堂，在那裏有一個[Cra]人，枯乾了一隻手。
verses.text_en: And He entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had a withered hand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人，枯干了一只手。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌又進了會堂，在那裏有一個人，枯乾了一隻手。

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣离开那里，进了他们的会堂；
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌離開那裏，進了他們的會堂；
refs.text_en: And departing from there, He came into their synagogue.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，有一个人枯干了一只手；有人问耶稣说，在安息日可以治病么？为的是要控告祂。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，有一個人枯乾了一隻手；有人問耶穌說，在安息日可以治病麼？為的是要控告祂。
refs.text_en: And behold, a man who had a withered hand was there. And they asked Him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath? so that they might accuse Him.

refs.text_gb: 祂对他们说，你们中间谁有一只羊，若在安息日掉在坑里，不把它抓住拉上来？
refs.text_big5: 祂對他們說，你們中間誰有一隻羊，若在安息日掉在坑裏，不把牠抓住拉上來？
refs.text_en: And He said to them, What man will there be among you who will have one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not take hold of it and lift it out?

refs.text_gb: 人比羊贵重多了；所以在安息日可以行善。
refs.text_big5: 人比羊貴重多了；所以在安息日可以行善。
refs.text_en: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! So then it is lawful to do well on the Sabbath.

refs.text_gb: 于是祂对那人说，伸出手来。他一伸，手就复了原，像另一只手那样的康健。
refs.text_big5: 於是祂對那人說，伸出手來。他一伸，手就復了原，像另一隻手那樣的康健。
refs.text_en: Then He said to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched it out and it was restored, as sound as the other.

refs.text_gb: 但法利赛人出去，商议怎样抵挡祂，为要除灭祂。
refs.text_big5: 但法利賽人出去，商議怎樣抵擋祂，為要除滅祂。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees, going out, took counsel against Him as to how they might destroy Him.

refs.text_gb: 在另一个安息日，耶稣进了会堂施教。在那里有一个人，右手枯干了。
refs.text_big5: 在另一個安息日，耶穌進了會堂施教。在那裏有一個人，右手枯乾了。
refs.text_en: And on another Sabbath He entered into the synagogue and taught. And there was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

refs.text_gb: 经学家和法利赛人窥探耶稣，在安息日要不要治病，好得把柄控告祂。
refs.text_big5: 經學家和法利賽人窺探耶穌，在安息日要不要治病，好得把柄控告祂。
refs.text_en: And the scribes and the Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find reason to accuse Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对那枯干手的人说，起来，站在当中。那人就起来站着。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對那枯乾手的人說，起來，站在當中。那人就起來站著。
refs.text_en: But He knew their reasonings and said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise and stand in the midst. And he rose up and stood.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，我问你们，在安息日行善作恶，救命毁命，哪样是可以的？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，我問你們，在安息日行善作惡，救命毀命，那樣是可以的？
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, I ask you, Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save a life or to destroy it?

refs.text_gb: 祂就环视他们众人，对那人说，伸出手来。他一伸，手就复了原。
refs.text_big5: 祂就環視他們眾人，對那人說，伸出手來。他一伸，手就復了原。
refs.text_en: And looking around at all of them, He said to him, Stretch out your hand. And he did, and his hand was restored.

refs.text_gb: 他们就满心大怒，彼此讨论怎样处治耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 他們就滿心大怒，彼此討論怎樣處治耶穌。
refs.text_en: But they were filled with rage and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.

verses.text_big5_plain: 眾人窺探耶穌，在安息日要不要醫治那人，為的是要控告祂。

refs.text_en: And as He went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching Him closely.

refs.text_big5: 於是他們窺探耶穌，打發奸細裝作公正人，要抓祂的話柄，好將祂交在總督的管治和權柄之下。
refs.text_en: And they watched Him closely and sent spies who feigned themselves to be righteous, in order that they might lay hold on some word of His, so as to deliver Him up to the rule and authority of the governor.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人对祂说，看哪，他们为什么作安息日不可作的事？
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人對祂說，看哪，他們為甚麼作安息日不可作的事？
refs.text_en: And the Pharisees said to Him, Look! Why are they doing on the Sabbath what is not lawful?

refs.text_gb: 祭司长和全议会尽力寻找见证，控告耶稣，为要把祂治死，总是得不到。
refs.text_big5: 祭司長和全議會盡力尋找見證，控告耶穌，為要把祂治死，總是得不到。
refs.text_en: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death, and they could not find it.

refs.text_big5: 祭司長告了祂許多事。

verses.text_big5: 耶穌就對那枯乾手的人說，起來，站在當中。

footnotes.zh_big5: 這含示奴僕救主是解救者，釋放受苦的人脫離宗教儀式的轄制。

verses.text_gb: 耶稣[Fn1]怒目[Cra]环视他们，因他们的心[Crb]刚硬而甚忧愁，就对那人说，[Crc]伸出手来。他一伸，手就[Fn2]复了原。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌[Fn1]怒目[Cra]環視他們，因他們的心[Crb]剛硬而甚憂愁，就對那人說，[Crc]伸出手來。他一伸，手就[Fn2]復了原。
verses.text_en: And looking around at them with anger and being greatly grieved with the hardness of their heart, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣怒目环视他们，因他们的心刚硬而甚忧愁，就对那人说，伸出手来。他一伸，手就复了原。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌怒目環視他們，因他們的心剛硬而甚憂愁，就對那人說，伸出手來。他一伸，手就復了原。

footnotes.zh: 救主向反对者发怒，因他们刚硬而甚忧愁；但祂向病人却动了慈心，使他枯干的肢体复原。祂的怒气和忧愁，可视为祂人性之真的流露；而祂的慈心和医治，乃是祂人性美德与神圣能力的汇合，二者又在同时显明与人。因此，祂的神性再一次在人面前彰显在祂的人性里。见十14注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 救主向反對者發怒，因他們剛硬而甚憂愁；但祂向病人卻動了慈心，使他枯乾的肢體復原。祂的怒氣和憂愁，可視為祂人性之真的流露；而祂的慈心和醫治，乃是祂人性美德與神聖能力的匯合，二者又在同時顯明與人。因此，祂的神性再一次在人面前彰顯在祂的人性裏。見十14註1。
footnotes.en: 3:5 1 anger Toward the opposers the Savior's anger was exercised, and He was greatly grieved at their hardness; but toward the sick His compassion was exercised, and He restored the withered member. His anger and grief may be considered the expression of the genuineness of His humanity, whereas His compassion and healing were a merging of His human virtue with His divine power, which were manifested simultaneously to men. Thus, His deity in His humanity was again expressed before men. See note Mark 10:14 1 .

footnotes.zh: 见一31注1。枯干的手复原，显示奴仆救主神性的能力。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見一31註1。枯乾的手復原，顯示奴僕救主神性的能力。
footnotes.en: 3:5 2 restored See note Mark 1:31 1 . The restoration of the withered hand displayed the power of the Slave-Savior's deity.

refs.text_gb: 于是祂环视那些围祂而坐的人，说，看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄！
refs.text_big5: 於是祂環視那些圍祂而坐的人，說，看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄！

refs.text_big5: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說，有錢財的人要進神的國，是何等的難！
refs.text_en: And Jesus, looking around, said to His disciples, How difficult it will be for those who have riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

refs.text_en: For I do not want you, brothers, to be ignorant of this mystery (lest you be wise in yourselves), that hardness has come upon Israel in part, until the fullness of the Gentiles comes in;

refs.text_gb: 他们在悟性上既然昏暗，就因着那在他们里面的无知，因着他们心里的刚硬，与神的生命隔绝了；
refs.text_big5: 他們在悟性上既然昏暗，就因著那在他們裏面的無知，因著他們心裏的剛硬，與神的生命隔絕了；
refs.text_en: Being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance which is in them, because of the hardness of their heart;

refs.text_big5: 船上的人遂都拜祂說，你真是神的兒子。
refs.text_en: And those who were in the boat worshipped Him, saying, Truly You are the Son of God.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣再三地[Fn1]嘱咐它们，[Cra]不要显扬祂。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌再三的[Fn1]囑咐牠們，[Cra]不要顯揚祂。
verses.text_en: And He charged them many times not to make Him known.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣再三地嘱咐它们，不要显扬祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌再三的囑咐牠們，不要顯揚祂。

footnotes.zh: 污灵对奴仆救主喊叫，也是祂福音服事的阻挠。祂嘱咐它们，不要显扬祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 污靈對奴僕救主喊叫，也是祂福音服事的阻撓。祂囑咐牠們，不要顯揚祂。
footnotes.en: 3:12 1 charged The demons' crying out concerning the Slave-Savior was a further frustration to His gospel service. He charged them not to make Him known.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌再三的囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西喫。
refs.text_en: And He strongly commanded them that no one should know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

refs.text_gb: 又嘱咐他们，不要显扬祂。
refs.text_big5: 又囑咐他們，不要顯揚祂。
refs.text_en: And He charged them not to make Him known,

verses.text_gb: 耶稣上了山，把祂所愿意要的人[Cra]召来，他们便到祂那里去。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌上了山，把祂所願意要的人[Cra]召來，他們便到祂那裏去。
verses.text_en: And He went up to the mountain and called to Him those whom He Himself wanted, and they went to Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣上了山，把祂所愿意要的人召来，他们便到祂那里去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌上了山，把祂所願意要的人召來，他們便到祂那裏去。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，给他们制伏污灵的权柄，可以赶逐它们，并医治各样的疾病，和各种的症候。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，給他們制伏污靈的權柄，可以趕逐牠們，並醫治各樣的疾病，和各種的症候。
refs.text_en: And He called His twelve disciples to Him and gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they would cast them out and heal every disease and every sickness.

refs.text_gb: 到了天亮，祂就叫门徒来，从他们中间挑选十二个人，称他们为使徒，
refs.text_big5: 到了天亮，祂就叫門徒來，從他們中間挑選十二個人，稱他們為使徒，
refs.text_en: And when it became day, He called His disciples to Him, and He chose from them twelve, whom He also named apostles:

refs.text_gb: 耶稣叫齐了十二个门徒，给他们能力、权柄，制伏一切的鬼，并医治疾病。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫齊了十二個門徒，給他們能力、權柄，制伏一切的鬼，並醫治疾病。
refs.text_en: And He called together the twelve and gave them power and authority over all the demons and to heal diseases.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，赐给他们权柄，制伏污灵；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個的出去，賜給他們權柄，制伏污靈；
refs.text_en: And He called the twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over the unclean spirits;

verses.text_gb: 祂就[Fn1]选立[Fn2]十二个人，[Fn3]称他们为使徒，要他们和祂同在，好差遣他们去[Fn4]传道，
verses.text_big5: 祂就[Fn1]選立[Fn2]十二個人，[Fn3]稱他們為使徒，要他們和祂同在，好差遣他們去[Fn4]傳道，
verses.text_en: And He appointed twelve, whom He also named apostles, so that they might be with Him and that He might send them to preach
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂就选立十二个人，称他们为使徒，要他们和祂同在，好差遣他们去传道，
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂就選立十二個人，稱他們為使徒，要他們和祂同在，好差遣他們去傳道，

footnotes.zh: 这是为了奴仆救主福音服事的开展。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是為了奴僕救主福音服事的開展。
footnotes.en: 3:14 1 appointed This was for the spreading of the Slave-Savior's gospel service.

footnotes.zh: 见启二一12注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見啟二一12註2。
footnotes.en: 3:14 2 twelve See note Rev. 21:12 2 .

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷无，称他们为使徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷無，稱他們為使徒。
footnotes.en: 3:14 3 whom Some MSS omit, whom He also named apostles.

footnotes.zh: 见一14注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見一14註3。
footnotes.en: 3:14 4 preach See note Mark 1:14 2 .

verses.text_gb: 又有[Cra]权柄[Fn1]赶鬼。
verses.text_big5: 又有[Cra]權柄[Fn1]趕鬼。
verses.text_en: And to have the authority to cast out the demons.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又有权柄赶鬼。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又有權柄趕鬼。

footnotes.zh: 见一23注1。传扬(14)福音是把神供应人，赶鬼是使撒但离开人。这些构成奴仆救主福音服事的主要目的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見一23註1。傳揚（14）福音是把神供應人，趕鬼是使撒但離開人。這些構成奴僕救主福音服事的主要目的。
footnotes.en: 3:15 1 cast See note note Mark 1:23 1 . To preach (v. 14) the gospel was to minister God to people; to cast out demons was to keep Satan away from people. These constituted the main purpose of the Slave-Savior's gospel service.

refs.text_gb: 众人都希奇，以致彼此讨论说，这是什么事？是个新鲜的教训！祂用权柄命令污灵，污灵就听从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都希奇，以致彼此討論說，這是甚麼事？是個新鮮的教訓！祂用權柄命令污靈，污靈就聽從了祂。
refs.text_en: And they were all amazed, so that they discussed among themselves, saying, What is this? A new teaching! With authority He orders even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，赐给他们权柄，制伏污灵；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個的出去，賜給他們權柄，制伏污靈；
refs.text_en: And He called the twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over the unclean spirits;

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]祂选立的[Cra]十二位有：西门，祂又给他[Fn2]起名叫[Crb]彼得；
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]祂選立的[Cra]十二位有：西門，祂又給他[Fn2]起名叫[Crb]彼得；
verses.text_en: And He appointed the twelve: and to Simon He gave the name Peter;
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂选立的十二位有：西门，祂又给他起名叫彼得；
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂選立的十二位有：西門，祂又給他起名叫彼得；

footnotes.en: 3:16 1 And For vv. 16-19, see notes in Matt. 10:2-4.

footnotes.zh: 直译，放上名字，或，加上名字。17节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，放上名字，或，加上名字。17節者同。
footnotes.en: 3:16 2 gave Lit., placed on, or, put on. So in v. 17.

refs.text_gb: 这十二使徒的名字是：头一个，称呼彼得的西门，还有他的兄弟安得烈；西庇太的儿子雅各，和他的兄弟约翰；
refs.text_big5: 這十二使徒的名字是：頭一個，稱呼彼得的西門，還有他的兄弟安得烈；西庇太的兒子雅各，和他的兄弟約翰；
refs.text_en: And the names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; and James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

refs.text_gb: 腓力和巴多罗买；多马和税吏马太；亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太；
refs.text_big5: 腓力和巴多羅買；多馬和稅吏馬太；亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太；
refs.text_en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

refs.text_gb: 热烈派的西门，和出卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
refs.text_big5: 熱烈派的西門，和出賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
refs.text_en: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

refs.text_gb: 就是西门，耶稣又给他起名叫彼得，还有他的兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和约翰，腓力和巴多罗买，
refs.text_big5: 就是西門，耶穌又給他起名叫彼得，還有他的兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和約翰，腓力和巴多羅買，
refs.text_en: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother and James and John and Philip and Bartholomew

refs.text_gb: 马太和多马，亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和称为热烈派的西门，
refs.text_big5: 馬太和多馬，亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和稱為熱烈派的西門，
refs.text_en: And Matthew and Thomas and James the son of Alphaeus and Simon, who was called Zealot,

refs.text_gb: 雅各的兄弟犹大，和以后出卖主的加略人犹大。
refs.text_big5: 雅各的兄弟猶大，和以後出賣主的加略人猶大。
refs.text_en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became the traitor.

refs.text_gb: 他们进了城，就上了所住的一间楼房，在那里有彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗买、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、热烈派的西门和雅各的兄弟犹大。
refs.text_big5: 他們進了城，就上了所住的一間樓房，在那裏有彼得、約翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多馬、巴多羅買、馬太、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、熱烈派的西門和雅各的兄弟猶大。
refs.text_en: And when they entered, they went up to the upper room where they were residing, Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot and Judas the brother of James.

refs.text_gb: 于是领他到耶稣那里。耶稣看着他说，你是约翰的儿子西门，你要称为矶法。（矶法翻出来，就是彼得。）
refs.text_big5: 於是領他到耶穌那裏。耶穌看著他說，你是約翰的兒子西門，你要稱為磯法。（磯法繙出來，就是彼得。）
refs.text_en: He led him to Jesus. Looking at him, Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; you shall be called Cephas (which is interpreted, Peter).

refs.text_gb: 我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的召会建造在这磐石上，阴间的门不能胜过她。
refs.text_big5: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的召會建造在這磐石上，陰間的門不能勝過她。
refs.text_en: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

verses.text_gb: 还有[Cra]西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟[Crb]约翰，祂又给他们起名叫[Fn1]半尼其，就是雷子的意思；
verses.text_big5: 還有[Cra]西庇太的兒子雅各，和雅各的兄弟[Crb]約翰，祂又給他們起名叫[Fn1]半尼其，就是雷子的意思；
verses.text_en: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James, and He gave them the name, Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder;
verses.text_gb_plain: 还有西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，祂又给他们起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思；
verses.text_big5_plain: 還有西庇太的兒子雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，祂又給他們起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思；

footnotes.zh: 半尼其，出自亚兰文的希腊文。因着雅各和约翰的性情急躁，主给他们起了这名(参路九54～55，可九38与注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 半尼其，出自亞蘭文的希臘文。因著雅各和約翰的性情急躁，主給他們起了這名。（參路九54～55，可九38與註1。）
footnotes.en: 3:17 1 Boanerges Greek from Aramaic. A name added to James and John because of their impetuosity (cf. Luke 9:54-55; Mark 9:38 and note).

refs.text_gb: 祂稍往前走，又看见西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，在船上补网。
refs.text_big5: 祂稍往前走，又看見西庇太的兒子雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，在船上補網。
refs.text_en: And going on a little, He saw James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, who also were in their boat, mending the nets.

refs.text_gb: 除了彼得、雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰，祂不许任何人跟着祂。
refs.text_big5: 除了彼得、雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰，祂不許任何人跟著祂。
refs.text_en: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter and James and John the brother of James.

verses.text_gb: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多罗买、[Cra]马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、达太、热烈派的西门、
verses.text_big5: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、[Cra]馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、達太、熱烈派的西門、
verses.text_en: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananaean,

verses.text_big5_plain: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、達太、熱烈派的西門、

refs.text_gb: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说，跟从我。他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說，跟從我。他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
refs.text_en: And as Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man sitting at the tax office, called Matthew, and He said to him, Follow Me. And he rose and followed Him.

verses.text_gb: 和[Fn1]出卖耶稣的加略人[Cra]犹大。
verses.text_big5: 和[Fn1]出賣耶穌的加略人[Cra]猶大。
verses.text_en: And Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 和出卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
verses.text_big5_plain: 和出賣耶穌的加略人猶大。

footnotes.zh: 直译，交出。全书同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，交出。全書同。
footnotes.en: 3:19 1 betrayed Lit., delivered Him up. So throughout the book.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的；他本是十二门徒中的一个，后来要出卖耶稣的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌是指著加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二門徒中的一個，後來要出賣耶穌的。
refs.text_en: Now He spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for he, one of the twelve, would betray Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我蘸一点饼给谁，就是谁。耶稣就蘸了一点饼，递给西门的儿子加略人犹大。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給西門的兒子加略人猶大。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered, It is he for whom I will dip the morsel and to whom I will give it. And dipping the morsel, He gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]耶稣进了一个[Cra]屋子，群众又聚在一起，以致他们[Fn2][Crb]连吃[Fn3]饭都不能。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]耶穌進了一個[Cra]屋子，群眾又聚在一起，以致他們[Fn2][Crb]連喫[Fn3]飯都不能。
verses.text_en: And He came into a house, and again a crowd came together, so that they could not even eat bread.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣进了一个屋子，群众又聚在一起，以致他们连吃饭都不能。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌進了一個屋子，群眾又聚在一起，以致他們連喫飯都不能。

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷作，他们进了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷作，他們進了。
footnotes.en: 3:20 1 He Some MSS read, they came.

footnotes.zh: 这指明奴仆救主作神的奴仆，在福音服事上的忙碌、殷勤和忠心。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明奴僕救主作神的奴僕，在福音服事上的忙碌、殷勤和忠心。
footnotes.en: 3:20 2 not This indicates the busyness, diligence, and faithfulness of the Slave-Savior as the Slave of God in His evangelistic service.

footnotes.zh: 直译，饼。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，餅。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣离开群众，进了屋子，门徒就将这比喻问祂。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌離開群眾，進了屋子，門徒就將這比喻問祂。
refs.text_en: And when He entered into a house from the crowd, His disciples questioned Him concerning the parable.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒暗暗地问祂说，我们为什么不能赶出它去？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒暗暗的問祂說，我們為甚麼不能趕出牠去？
refs.text_en: And when He entered into the house, His disciples questioned Him privately, Why were we not able to cast it out?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对他们说，来吧，你们暗暗地到旷野地方歇一歇。这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有机会。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對他們說，來罷，你們暗暗的到曠野地方歇一歇。這是因為來往的人多，他們連喫飯也沒有機會。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Come by yourselves privately to a deserted place and rest a while. For there were many coming and going, and they did not even have opportunity to eat.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣的[Cra]亲属听见，就出来要拉住祂，因为他们说[Fn1]祂[Crb]癫狂了。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌的[Cra]親屬聽見，就出來要拉住祂，因為他們說[Fn1]祂[Crb]癲狂了。
verses.text_en: And when His relatives heard about it, they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, He is beside Himself.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住祂，因为他们说祂癫狂了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住祂，因為他們說祂癲狂了。

footnotes.zh: “祂癫狂了，”乃是感叹的话，说出奴仆救主的亲属对祂天然的关切。这为经学家开了亵渎祂的路(22)。
footnotes.zh_big5: “祂癲狂了，”乃是感歎的話，說出奴僕救主的親屬對祂天然的關切。這為經學家開了褻瀆祂的路。（22。）
footnotes.en: 3:21 1 He “He is beside Himself” was an exclamation expressing the natural concern for the Slave-Savior on the part of His relatives. It opened the way for the scribes to blaspheme Him (v. 22).

refs.text_gb: 当下耶稣的母亲和兄弟来，站在外面，打发人去叫祂。
refs.text_big5: 當下耶穌的母親和兄弟來，站在外面，打發人去叫祂。
refs.text_en: And His mother and His brothers came, and standing outside, they sent word to Him and called Him.

refs.text_gb: 保罗这样分诉，非斯都大声说，保罗，你癫狂了，你的学问太大，反叫你癫狂了。
refs.text_big5: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說，保羅，你癲狂了，你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了。
refs.text_en: And as he was saying these things in his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, You are insane, Paul. Much learning is driving you insane.

refs.text_gb: 因我们或是癫狂，乃是向着神；或是谨守，乃是为着你们。
refs.text_big5: 因我們或是癲狂，乃是向著神；或是謹守，乃是為著你們。
refs.text_en: For whether we were beside ourselves, it was to God; or whether we are sober-minded, it is for you.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]从[Cra]耶路撒冷下来的[Fn2]经学家[Crb]说，祂[Crc]有[Fn3][Crd]别西卜附着；又说，祂是靠着[Fn4][Cre]鬼王赶鬼。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]從[Cra]耶路撒冷下來的[Fn2]經學家[Crb]說，祂[Crc]有[Fn3][Crd]別西卜附著；又說，祂是靠著[Fn4][Cre]鬼王趕鬼。
verses.text_en: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebul, and by the ruler of the demons He casts out the demons.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从耶路撒冷下来的经学家说，祂有别西卜附着；又说，祂是靠着鬼王赶鬼。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從耶路撒冷下來的經學家說，祂有別西卜附著；又說，祂是靠著鬼王趕鬼。

footnotes.en: 3:22 1 And For vv. 22-30, see notes in Matt. 12:24-32.

footnotes.zh: 见二6注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二6註1。
footnotes.en: 3:22 2 scribes See note Mark 2:6 1 .

footnotes.zh: 这是亵渎的话，是由21节天然关切的感叹引进的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是褻瀆的話，是由21節天然關切的感歎引進的。
footnotes.en: 3:22 3 Beelzebul This was a word of blasphemy ushered in by the exclamation of natural concern in v. 21.

footnotes.zh: 奴仆救主赶鬼，就是赶出为撒但黑暗的国工作的邪恶者，然而反对者却说，祂是靠着鬼王赶鬼。那恶者是何等诡诈，鼓动这些邪恶的反对者说这话！他们与那恶者同工，甚至与他是一。
footnotes.zh_big5: 奴僕救主趕鬼，就是趕出為撒但黑暗的國工作的邪惡者，然而反對者卻說，祂是靠著鬼王趕鬼。那惡者是何等詭詐，鼓動這些邪惡的反對者說這話！他們與那惡者同工，甚至與他是一。
footnotes.en: 3:22 4 ruler The Slave-Savior cast out demons, the evil workers for the dark kingdom of Satan, yet the opposers said that He did it by the ruler of the demons. What a subtlety of the evil one, who motivated these evil opposers to say this! They were the co-workers of the evil one and even were one with him.

refs.text_gb: 有法利赛人和几个经学家，从耶路撒冷来到耶稣那里聚集。
refs.text_big5: 有法利賽人和幾個經學家，從耶路撒冷來到耶穌那裏聚集。
refs.text_en: And the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to Him when they had come from Jerusalem

refs.text_gb: 那时，有法利赛人和经学家从耶路撒冷来到耶稣跟前，说，
refs.text_big5: 那時，有法利賽人和經學家從耶路撒冷來到耶穌跟前，說，
refs.text_en: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人听见了，却说，这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人聽見了，卻說，這個人趕鬼，無非是靠著鬼王別西卜。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees, hearing this, said, This man does not cast out the demons except by Beelzebul, ruler of the demons.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就对他们说，凡国自相分争，必至荒凉；凡城或家自相分争，也难站住。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就對他們說，凡國自相分爭，必至荒涼；凡城或家自相分爭，也難站住。
refs.text_en: But knowing their thoughts, He said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself becomes desolate, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

refs.text_gb: 若撒但赶逐撒但，他就自相分争，他的国怎能站住？
refs.text_big5: 若撒但趕逐撒但，他就自相分爭，他的國怎能站住？
refs.text_en: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

refs.text_gb: 我若是靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟又是靠着谁赶呢？这样，他们就要审判你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若是靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟又是靠著誰趕呢？這樣，他們就要審判你們了。
refs.text_en: And if I, by Beelzebul, cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

refs.text_gb: 我若靠着神的灵赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若靠著神的靈趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
refs.text_en: But if I, by the Spirit of God, cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

refs.text_gb: 人怎能进壮者家里，抢夺他的家具？除非先捆绑那壮者，才能洗劫他的家。
refs.text_big5: 人怎能進壯者家裏，搶奪他的家具？除非先捆綁那壯者，纔能洗劫他的家。
refs.text_en: Or how can anyone enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods unless he first binds the strong man? And then he will thoroughly plunder his house.

refs.text_gb: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_big5: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_en: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，人一切的罪和亵渎，都能得赦免；唯独亵渎那灵，不能得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，人一切的罪和褻瀆，都能得赦免；惟獨褻瀆那靈，不能得赦免。
refs.text_en: Therefore I say to you, Every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

refs.text_gb: 并且无论谁说话抵挡人子，他都能得赦免；但无论谁说话抵挡圣灵，无论在今世，或是在来世，他都不能得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 並且無論誰說話抵擋人子，他都能得赦免；但無論誰說話抵擋聖靈，無論在今世，或是在來世，他都不能得赦免。
refs.text_en: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age nor in the one to come.

refs.text_gb: 其中却有人说，祂是靠着鬼王别西卜赶鬼。
refs.text_big5: 其中卻有人說，祂是靠著鬼王別西卜趕鬼。
refs.text_en: But some of them said, By Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons, He casts out the demons.

refs.text_gb: 又有人试诱耶稣，向祂求个从天上来的神迹。
refs.text_big5: 又有人試誘耶穌，向祂求個從天上來的神蹟。
refs.text_en: And others, tempting Him, sought from Him a sign out of heaven.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对他们说，凡一国自相分争，必至荒凉；一家自相分争，也必败落。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說，凡一國自相分爭，必至荒涼；一家自相分爭，也必敗落。
refs.text_en: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself becomes desolate, and a house divided against a house falls.

refs.text_gb: 若撒但自相分争，他的国怎能站住？因为你们说我是靠着别西卜赶鬼。
refs.text_big5: 若撒但自相分爭，他的國怎能站住？因為你們說我是靠著別西卜趕鬼。
refs.text_en: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? For you say that it is by Beelzebul that I cast out the demons.

refs.text_gb: 我若是靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟又是靠谁赶呢？这样，他们就要审判你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若是靠著別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟又是靠誰趕呢？這樣，他們就要審判你們了。
refs.text_en: But if I by Beelzebul cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

refs.text_gb: 我若靠着神的指头赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。
refs.text_big5: 我若靠著神的指頭趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
refs.text_en: But if I by the finger of God cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

refs.text_gb: 壮者全副武装，看守自己住宅的时候，他的家业就平安无事。
refs.text_big5: 壯者全副武裝，看守自己住宅的時候，他的家業就平安無事。
refs.text_en: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own homestead, his possessions are in peace.

refs.text_gb: 但有一个比他更壮的来，胜过他，就夺去他所倚靠的全副军装，又分了他的掳物。
refs.text_big5: 但有一個比他更壯的來，勝過他，就奪去他所倚靠的全副軍裝，又分了他的擄物。
refs.text_en: But when one stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes away his whole armor in which he had trusted and distributes his spoil.

refs.text_gb: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_big5: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。
refs.text_en: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

refs.text_gb: 群众回答说，你有鬼附着，谁想要杀你？
refs.text_big5: 群眾回答說，你有鬼附著，誰想要殺你？
refs.text_en: The crowd answered, You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill You?

refs.text_gb: 犹太人回答祂说，我们说你是撒玛利亚人，又有鬼附着，岂不正对么？
refs.text_big5: 猶太人回答祂說，我們說你是撒瑪利亞人，又有鬼附著，豈不正對麼？
refs.text_en: The Jews answered and said to Him, Have we not spoken well in saying that You are a Samaritan and have a demon?

refs.text_gb: 犹太人对祂说，现在我们知道你有鬼附着。亚伯拉罕死了，众申言者也死了，你还说人若遵守我的话，必永远不尝死味。
refs.text_big5: 猶太人對祂說，現在我們知道你有鬼附著。亞伯拉罕死了，眾申言者也死了，你還說人若遵守我的話，必永遠不嘗死味。
refs.text_en: The Jews therefore said to Him, Now we know that You have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets too; yet You say, If anyone keeps My word, he shall by no means taste death forever.

refs.text_gb: 其中有好些人说，祂是被鬼附着，而且疯了，为什么听祂？
refs.text_big5: 其中有好些人說，祂是被鬼附著，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽祂？
refs.text_en: And many of them said, He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to Him?

refs.text_gb: 门徒和他的老师一样，奴仆和他的主人一样，也就够了。人既称家主为别西卜，何况他的家人？
refs.text_big5: 門徒和他的老師一樣，奴僕和他的主人一樣，也就彀了。人既稱家主為別西卜，何況他的家人？
refs.text_en: It is sufficient for the disciple that he become like his teacher, and the slave like his master. If they have called the Master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of His household!

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人却说，祂是靠着鬼王赶鬼。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人卻說，祂是靠著鬼王趕鬼。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees said, By the ruler of the demons He casts out the demons.

refs.text_gb: 现在这世界受审判，这世界的王要被赶出去。
refs.text_big5: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
refs.text_en: Now is the judgment of this world; now shall the ruler of this world be cast out.

refs.text_gb: 那时，你们在其中行事为人，随着这世界的世代，顺着空中掌权者的首领，就是那现今在悖逆之子里面运行之灵的首领；
refs.text_big5: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨著這世界的世代，順著空中掌權者的首領，就是那現今在悖逆之子裏面運行之靈的首領；
refs.text_en: In which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit which is now operating in the sons of disobedience;

verses.text_gb: 耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说，撒但怎能赶逐撒但？
verses.text_big5: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說，撒但怎能趕逐撒但？
verses.text_en: And He called them to Himself and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说，撒但怎能赶逐撒但？
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說，撒但怎能趕逐撒但？

verses.text_gb: 若是一[Fn1][Cra]国自相分争，那国就站立不住；
verses.text_big5: 若是一[Fn1][Cra]國自相分爭，那國就站立不住；
verses.text_en: And if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom is not able to stand;
verses.text_gb_plain: 若是一国自相分争，那国就站立不住；
verses.text_big5_plain: 若是一國自相分爭，那國就站立不住；

footnotes.zh: 这指明撒但不仅有家，也有国。他的家是罪的家(约壹三8，10)，他的国是黑暗的国(西一13)。罪人属于他的家，也属于他的国。鬼属于他的国，也为着他的国附在人身上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明撒但不僅有家，也有國。他的家是罪的家，（約壹三8，10，）他的國是黑暗的國。（西一13。）罪人屬於他的家，也屬於他的國。鬼屬於他的國，也為著他的國附在人身上。
footnotes.en: 3:24 1 kingdom This indicates that Satan has not only a house but also a kingdom. His house is a house of sin (1 John 3:8, 10), and his kingdom is a kingdom of darkness (Col. 1:13). The sinners belong to both his house and his kingdom. The demons belong to his kingdom and possess people for his kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 若撒但赶逐撒但，他就自相分争，他的国怎能站住？
refs.text_big5: 若撒但趕逐撒但，他就自相分爭，他的國怎能站住？
refs.text_en: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

refs.text_gb: 我差你到他们那里去，叫他们的眼睛得开，从黑暗转入光中，从撒但权下转向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，并在一切圣别的人中得着基业。
refs.text_big5: 我差你到他們那裏去，叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗轉入光中，從撒但權下轉向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，並在一切聖別的人中得著基業。
refs.text_en: To open their eyes, to turn them from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.

refs.text_gb: 祂拯救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁入祂爱子的国里；
refs.text_big5: 祂拯救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷入祂愛子的國裏；
refs.text_en: Who delivered us out of the authority of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of the Son of His love,

verses.text_gb: 若是一家自相分争，那家就站立不住；
verses.text_big5: 若是一家自相分爭，那家就站立不住；
verses.text_en: And if a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand;
verses.text_gb_plain: 若是一家自相分争，那家就站立不住；
verses.text_big5_plain: 若是一家自相分爭，那家就站立不住；

verses.text_gb: 若是撒但自相攻打分争，他就站立不住，必要灭绝。
verses.text_big5: 若是撒但自相攻打分爭，他就站立不住，必要滅絕。
verses.text_en: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he is not able to stand but has come to an end.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若是撒但自相攻打分争，他就站立不住，必要灭绝。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若是撒但自相攻打分爭，他就站立不住，必要滅絕。

verses.text_gb: 没有人能进壮者家里，[Cra]洗劫他的[Fn1]家具，除非先[Fn2][Crb]捆绑那壮者，才能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_big5: 沒有人能進壯者家裏，[Cra]洗劫他的[Fn1]家具，除非先[Fn2][Crb]捆綁那壯者，纔能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_en: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man and thoroughly plunder his goods unless he first binds the strong man, and then he will thoroughly plunder his house.
verses.text_gb_plain: 没有人能进壮者家里，洗劫他的家具，除非先捆绑那壮者，才能洗劫他的家。
verses.text_big5_plain: 沒有人能進壯者家裏，洗劫他的家具，除非先捆綁那壯者，纔能洗劫他的家。

footnotes.zh: 指罪人，他们为着撒但的国，被拘禁在撒但家里。奴仆救主捆绑那壮者撒但，并进入他的家里劫夺罪人，好为着神的国(约三5)，借着重生，把他们带进神的家(弗二19)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指罪人，他們為著撒但的國，被拘禁在撒但家裏。奴僕救主捆綁那壯者撒但，並進入他的家裏劫奪罪人，好為著神的國，（約三5，）藉著重生，把他們帶進神的家。（弗二19。）
footnotes.en: 3:27 1 goods Sinners kept in Satan's house for his kingdom. The Slave-Savior bound Satan, the strong man, and entered into his house to plunder the sinners so that through regeneration they could be brought into the house of God (Eph. 2:19) for the kingdom of God (John 3:5).

footnotes.zh: 这指明奴仆救主从事福音的服事，就是捆绑那壮者撒但。福音的服事乃是一场摧毁撒但及其黑暗国度的争战。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明奴僕救主從事福音的服事，就是捆綁那壯者撒但。福音的服事乃是一場摧毀撒但及其黑暗國度的爭戰。
footnotes.en: 3:27 2 binds This indicates that while the Slave-Savior was doing the gospel service, He was binding the strong man, Satan. The gospel service is a warfare to destroy Satan and his kingdom of darkness.

refs.text_gb: 壮者抢去的岂能夺回？理当掳掠的岂能解救么？
refs.text_big5: 壯者搶去的豈能奪回？理當擄掠的豈能解救麼？
refs.text_en: Can the booty be taken from the strong man, / Or the lawful captives be delivered?

refs.text_gb: 我要把诸天之国的钥匙给你，凡你在地上捆绑的，必是在诸天之上已经捆绑的；凡你在地上释放的，必是在诸天之上已经释放的。
refs.text_big5: 我要把諸天之國的鑰匙給你，凡你在地上捆綁的，必是在諸天之上已經捆綁的；凡你在地上釋放的，必是在諸天之上已經釋放的。
refs.text_en: I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of the heavens, and whatever you bind on the earth shall have been bound in the heavens, and whatever you loose on the earth shall have been loosed in the heavens.

verses.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，[Fn1]人一切的罪和亵渎，无论是[Cra]亵渎什么，都能得[Crb]赦免；
verses.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，[Fn1]人一切的罪和褻瀆，無論是[Cra]褻瀆甚麼，都能得[Crb]赦免；
verses.text_en: Truly I say to you that all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they blaspheme,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我实在告诉你们，人一切的罪和亵渎，无论是亵渎什么，都能得赦免；
verses.text_big5_plain: 我實在告訴你們，人一切的罪和褻瀆，無論是褻瀆甚麼，都能得赦免；

footnotes.zh: 直译，人的儿子们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，人的兒子們。

refs.text_gb: 我从前是亵渎神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了怜悯，因我是在不信中，无知而作的。
refs.text_big5: 我從前是褻瀆神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了憐憫，因我是在不信中，無知而作的。
refs.text_en: Who formerly was a blasphemer and a persecutor and an insulting person; but I was shown mercy because, being ignorant, I acted in unbelief.

refs.text_gb: 并且人要靠着祂的名，传悔改以得赦罪之道，从耶路撒冷起，直到万邦。
refs.text_big5: 並且人要靠著祂的名，傳悔改以得赦罪之道，從耶路撒冷起，直到萬邦。
refs.text_en: And that repentance for forgiveness of sins would be proclaimed in His name to all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 这一位，神已将祂高举在自己的右边，作元首，作救主，将悔改和赦罪赐给以色列人。
refs.text_big5: 這一位，神已將祂高舉在自己的右邊，作元首，作救主，將悔改和赦罪賜給以色列人。
refs.text_en: This One God has exalted to His right hand as Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.

refs.text_gb: 众申言者也为祂作见证说，凡信入祂的人，必借着祂的名得蒙赦罪。
refs.text_big5: 眾申言者也為祂作見證說，凡信入祂的人，必藉著祂的名得蒙赦罪。
refs.text_en: To this One all the prophets testify that through His name everyone who believes into Him will receive forgiveness of sins.

verses.text_gb: 但无论谁亵渎[Fn1]圣[Cra]灵，却永不得赦免，乃要担当[Fn2]永远的罪。
verses.text_big5: 但無論誰褻瀆[Fn1]聖[Cra]靈，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當[Fn2]永遠的罪。
verses.text_en: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit has no forgiveness forever, but is guilty of an everlasting sin.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但无论谁亵渎圣灵，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但無論誰褻瀆聖靈，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。

footnotes.zh: 这说出奴仆救主福音的服事，特别在赶鬼，摧毁撒但黑暗的国一事上，乃是靠着圣灵。祂为圣灵所膏，在一切的行动上都一直受圣灵的引导(路四18，1，可一12)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這說出奴僕救主福音的服事，特別在趕鬼，摧毀撒但黑暗的國一事上，乃是靠著聖靈。祂為聖靈所膏，在一切的行動上都一直受聖靈的引導。（路四18，1，可一12。）
footnotes.en: 3:29 1 Holy This shows that the Slave-Savior's gospel service, especially in casting out the demons to destroy the dark kingdom of Satan, was by the Holy Spirit, with whom He was anointed and by whom He was being led continuously in His move (Luke 4:18, Luke 4:1; Mark 1:12).

footnotes.zh: 指永远不得赦免的罪。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指永遠不得赦免的罪。
footnotes.en: 3:29 2 everlasting A sin that will not be forgiven forever.

refs.text_gb: 凡说话抵挡人子的，还能得赦免；唯独亵渎圣灵的，不能得赦免。
refs.text_big5: 凡說話抵擋人子的，還能得赦免；惟獨褻瀆聖靈的，不能得赦免。
refs.text_en: And everyone who will say a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.

refs.text_gb: 何况那践踏神的儿子，将他借以成圣的立约之血当作俗物，又亵慢恩典之灵的，你们想，他该受怎样更重的刑罚？
refs.text_big5: 何況那踐踏神的兒子，將他藉以成聖的立約之血當作俗物，又褻慢恩典之靈的，你們想，他該受怎樣更重的刑罰？
refs.text_en: By how much do you think he will be thought worthy of worse punishment who has trampled underfoot the Son of God and has considered the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified a common thing and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

refs.text_gb: 你们这硬着颈项，心与耳未受割礼的人，时常抗拒圣灵，你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。
refs.text_big5: 你們這硬著頸項，心與耳未受割禮的人，時常抗拒聖靈，你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
refs.text_en: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in hearts and ears, you always oppose the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, you also do.

verses.text_gb: 这话是因为他们说，祂有污灵附着。
verses.text_big5: 這話是因為他們說，祂有污靈附著。
verses.text_en: He said this because they said, He has an unclean spirit.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这话是因为他们说，祂有污灵附着。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這話是因為他們說，祂有污靈附著。

verses.text_gb: 当下[Cra]耶稣的[Fn1]母[Crb]亲和[Crc]兄弟来，站在外面，打发人去叫祂。
verses.text_big5: 當下[Cra]耶穌的[Fn1]母[Crb]親和[Crc]兄弟來，站在外面，打發人去叫祂。
verses.text_en: And His mother and His brothers came, and standing outside, they sent word to Him and called Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当下耶稣的母亲和兄弟来，站在外面，打发人去叫祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當下耶穌的母親和兄弟來，站在外面，打發人去叫祂。

footnotes.zh: 反对者受撒但煽动，亵渎主以后，奴仆救主的亲属又来，以天然的关切烦扰祂。毫无疑问，这也是那恶者所鼓动的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 反對者受撒但煽動，褻瀆主以後，奴僕救主的親屬又來，以天然的關切煩擾祂。毫無疑問，這也是那惡者所鼓動的。
footnotes.en: 3:31 1 mother After the opposers' blasphemy, which was instigated by Satan, the relatives of the Slave-Savior came again to trouble Him with their natural concern for Him. Undoubtedly, this too was motivated by the evil one.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣还对群众说话的时候，看哪，祂的母亲和兄弟站在外面，要找祂说话。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌還對群眾說話的時候，看哪，祂的母親和兄弟站在外面，要找祂說話。
refs.text_en: While He was still speaking to the crowds, behold, His mother and His brothers stood outside seeking to speak to Him.

refs.text_gb: 有人对祂说，看哪，你的母亲和兄弟站在外面，要找你说话。
refs.text_big5: 有人對祂說，看哪，你的母親和兄弟站在外面，要找你說話。
refs.text_en: And someone said to Him, Behold, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside seeking to speak to You.

refs.text_gb: 祂却回答那对祂说话的人说，谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？
refs.text_big5: 祂卻回答那對祂說話的人說，誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？
refs.text_en: But He answered and said to him who spoke to Him, Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?

refs.text_gb: 就伸手指着门徒说，看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄！
refs.text_big5: 就伸手指著門徒說，看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄！
refs.text_en: And stretching out His hand toward His disciples, He said, Behold, My mother and My brothers!

refs.text_gb: 因为凡实行我在诸天之上父旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母亲了。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡實行我在諸天之上父旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母親了。
refs.text_en: For whoever does the will of My Father who is in the heavens, he is My brother and sister and mother.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣的母亲和兄弟来了，因为人多，不能与祂相会。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌的母親和兄弟來了，因為人多，不能與祂相會。
refs.text_en: And His mother and brothers came up to Him and were not able to get to Him because of the crowd.

refs.text_gb: 有人报告祂说，你的母亲和兄弟站在外面，想要见你。
refs.text_big5: 有人報告祂說，你的母親和兄弟站在外面，想要見你。
refs.text_en: And it was reported to Him, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside wanting to see You.

refs.text_gb: 祂却回答他们说，这些听了神的话而实行的人，就是我的母亲，我的弟兄了。
refs.text_big5: 祂卻回答他們說，這些聽了神的話而實行的人，就是我的母親，我的弟兄了。
refs.text_en: But He answered and said to them, My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住祂，因为他们说祂癫狂了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住祂，因為他們說祂癲狂了。
refs.text_en: And when His relatives heard about it, they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, He is beside Himself.

refs.text_gb: 这不是那木匠么？不是马利亚的儿子，雅各、约西、犹大、西门的长兄么？祂妹妹们不也是在我们这里么？他们就因祂绊跌。
refs.text_big5: 這不是那木匠麼？不是馬利亞的兒子，雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄麼？祂妹妹們不也是在我們這裏麼？他們就因祂絆跌。
refs.text_en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? And are not His sisters here with us? And they were stumbled because of Him.

refs.text_gb: 这事以后，耶稣与祂的母亲、兄弟和门徒，都下迦百农去，在那里住了不多几日。
refs.text_big5: 這事以後，耶穌與祂的母親、兄弟和門徒，都下迦百農去，在那裏住了不多幾日。
refs.text_en: After this He went down to Capernaum, He and His mother and His brothers and His disciples; and they remained there not many days.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣的兄弟就对祂说，你离开这里上犹太去吧，叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌的兄弟就對祂說，你離開這裏上猶太去罷，叫你的門徒也看見你所行的事。
refs.text_en: His brothers therefore said to Him, Depart from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples also may behold Your works which You are doing;

refs.text_gb: 原来连祂的兄弟也不信入祂。
refs.text_big5: 原來連祂的兄弟也不信入祂。
refs.text_en: For not even His brothers believed into Him.

refs.text_gb: 然而祂兄弟上去过节以后，祂也上去了，但不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
refs.text_big5: 然而祂兄弟上去過節以後，祂也上去了，但不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
refs.text_en: But when His brothers had gone up to the feast, then He Himself also went up, not openly, but as it were in secret.

refs.text_gb: 这些人同着几个妇人，和耶稣的母亲马利亚，并耶稣的兄弟，都同心合意，坚定持续地祷告。
refs.text_big5: 這些人同著幾個婦人，和耶穌的母親馬利亞，並耶穌的兄弟，都同心合意，堅定持續的禱告。
refs.text_en: These all continued steadfastly with one accord in prayer, together with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.

refs.text_gb: 难道我们没有权利带着为妻子的姊妹往来，仿佛其余的使徒，和主的兄弟，并矶法一样么？
refs.text_big5: 難道我們沒有權利帶著為妻子的姊妹往來，彷彿其餘的使徒，和主的兄弟，並磯法一樣麼？
refs.text_en: Do we not have a right to take along a sister as a wife, even as the rest of the apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?

refs.text_gb: 至于别的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都没有见过。
refs.text_big5: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有見過。
refs.text_en: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.

verses.text_gb: 有群众在耶稣周围坐着，他们就告诉祂说，看哪，你的母亲和兄弟，并你的妹妹，在外面找你。
verses.text_big5: 有群眾在耶穌周圍坐著，他們就告訴祂說，看哪，你的母親和兄弟，並你的妹妹，在外面找你。
verses.text_en: And a crowd sat around Him, and they said to Him, Behold, Your mother and Your brothers and Your sisters are outside seeking You.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有群众在耶稣周围坐着，他们就告诉祂说，看哪，你的母亲和兄弟，并你的妹妹，在外面找你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有群眾在耶穌周圍坐著，他們就告訴祂說，看哪，你的母親和兄弟，並你的妹妹，在外面找你。

verses.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，[Fn1]谁是我的母亲和弟兄？
verses.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，[Fn1]誰是我的母親和弟兄？
verses.text_en: And He answered them and said, Who is My mother and My brothers?
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣回答他们说，谁是我的母亲和弟兄？
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌回答他們說，誰是我的母親和弟兄？

footnotes.zh: 见太十二48注1。这指明奴仆救主拒绝祂亲属天然的关切。祂为着摧毁那恶者的诡计，完成祂福音的服事，就不愿留在天然生命的关系里。这显示祂在人性里向着神的绝对。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見太十二48註1。這指明奴僕救主拒絕祂親屬天然的關切。祂為著摧毀那惡者的詭計，完成祂福音的服事，就不願留在天然生命的關係裏。這顯示祂在人性裏向著神的絕對。
footnotes.en: 3:33 1 Who See note Matt. 12:48 1 . This indicated the Slave-Savior's rejection of His relatives' natural concern. To defeat the evil one's schemes and to fulfill His gospel service, He refused to remain in any relationship in the natural life. This displayed His absoluteness for God in His humanity.

verses.text_gb: 于是祂[Cra]环视那些围祂而坐的人，说，看哪，我的母亲，我的[Crb]弟兄！
verses.text_big5: 於是祂[Cra]環視那些圍祂而坐的人，說，看哪，我的母親，我的[Crb]弟兄！
verses.text_en: And looking around at those sitting in a circle around Him, He said, Behold, My mother and My brothers!
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是祂环视那些围祂而坐的人，说，看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄！
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是祂環視那些圍祂而坐的人，說，看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄！

refs.text_gb: 耶稣怒目环视他们，因他们的心刚硬而甚忧愁，就对那人说，伸出手来。他一伸，手就复了原。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌怒目環視他們，因他們的心剛硬而甚憂愁，就對那人說，伸出手來。他一伸，手就復了原。
refs.text_en: And looking around at them with anger and being greatly grieved with the hardness of their heart, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.

refs.text_gb: 因为神所预知的人，祂也预定他们模成神儿子的形像，使祂儿子在许多弟兄中作长子。
refs.text_big5: 因為神所豫知的人，祂也豫定他們模成神兒子的形像，使祂兒子在許多弟兄中作長子。
refs.text_en: Because those whom He foreknew, He also predestinated to be conformed to the image of His Son, that He might be the Firstborn among many brothers;

refs.text_gb: 因那圣别人的，和那些被圣别的，都是出于一；因这缘故，祂称他们为弟兄，并不以为耻，说，
refs.text_big5: 因那聖別人的，和那些被聖別的，都是出於一；因這緣故，祂稱他們為弟兄，並不以為恥，說，
refs.text_en: For both He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are all of One, for which cause He is not ashamed to call them brothers,

refs.text_gb: “我要向我的弟兄宣告你的名，在召会中我要歌颂你。”
refs.text_big5: “我要向我的弟兄宣告你的名，在召會中我要歌頌你。”
refs.text_en: Saying, "I will declare Your name to My brothers; in the midst of the church I will sing hymns of praise to You."

verses.text_gb: 因为凡[Fn1][Cra]实行神旨意的，就是[Fn2]我的弟兄、姊妹和母亲了。
verses.text_big5: 因為凡[Fn1][Cra]實行神旨意的，就是[Fn2]我的弟兄、姊妹和母親了。
verses.text_en: For whoever does the will of God, this one is My brother and sister and mother.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为凡实行神旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母亲了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為凡實行神旨意的，就是我的弟兄、姊妹和母親了。

footnotes.zh: 见太十二50注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見太十二50註1。
footnotes.en: 3:35 1 does See note Matt. 12:50 1 .

footnotes.zh: 奴仆救主借着福音的服事，把信祂的罪人作成祂属灵的亲属，成为神家里(来三5)的许多弟兄(罗八29，来二11)，并为着建造祂奥秘身体的许多肢体(弗五30，林前十二12)，以实行神的旨意。
footnotes.zh_big5: 奴僕救主藉著福音的服事，把信祂的罪人作成祂屬靈的親屬，成為神家裏（來三5）的許多弟兄，（羅八29，來二11，）並為著建造祂奧祕身體的許多肢體，（弗五30，林前十二12，）以實行神的旨意。
footnotes.en: 3:35 2 My Through His gospel service the Slave-Savior made the believing sinners His spiritual relatives, who became His many brothers (Rom. 8:29; Heb. 2:11) in the house of God (Heb. 3:5) and His many members for the building up of His mystical Body (Eph. 5:30; 1 Cor. 12:12) to do the will of God.

refs.text_gb: 不是每一个对我说，主啊，主啊的人，都能进诸天的国，唯独实行我诸天之上父旨意的人，才能进去。
refs.text_big5: 不是每一個對我說，主阿，主阿的人，都能進諸天的國，惟獨實行我諸天之上父旨意的人，纔能進去。
refs.text_en: Not everyone who says to Me, Lord, Lord, will enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but he who does the will of My Father who is in the heavens.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]耶稣又[Cra]在[Crb]海边[Fn2]施教；有大批群众聚集到祂那里，祂只得上[Crc]船坐下；船在海里，群众都朝着海站在岸上。

footnotes.zh: 那撒种的表征奴仆救主(太十三37)，祂是神的儿子，在祂的道(14)里将自己当作生命的种子(见26注2)，撒在人的心里，使祂能生长并活在他们里面，且从他们里面彰显出来。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那撒種的表徵奴僕救主，（太十三37，）祂是神的兒子，在祂的道（14）裏將自己當作生命的種子，（見26註2，）撒在人的心裏，使祂能生長並活在他們裏面，且從他們裏面彰顯出來。
footnotes.en: 4:3 1 sower Signifying the Slave-Savior (Matt. 13:37), who was the Son of God coming to sow Himself as the seed of life (see note Mark 4:26 3 ) in His word (v. 14) into men's hearts that He might grow and live in them and be expressed from within them.

footnotes.zh: 这撒种就是奴仆救主传扬神的福音，带进神的国(一14～15)。这与26节一样，乃是撒出奴仆救主所说之道(14)中生命的种子，指明祂福音的服事，是要将神的生命撒在祂所服事的人里面。这生命的长大是按照受服事之人的光景；光景不同，结果就不同，就如这比喻所描绘的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這撒種就是奴僕救主傳揚神的福音，帶進神的國。（一14～15。）這與26節一樣，乃是撒出奴僕救主所說之道（14）中生命的種子，指明祂福音的服事，是要將神的生命撒在祂所服事的人裏面。這生命的長大是按照受服事之人的光景；光景不同，結果就不同，就如這比喻所描繪的。
footnotes.en: 4:3 2 sow This sowing was the Slave-Savior's proclaiming of the gospel of God, which brought in the kingdom of God (Mark 1:14-15). It was, as in v. 26, the sowing of the seed of life in the word (v. 14) spoken by the Slave-Savior, indicating that His gospel service was to sow the divine life into the people whom He served. The growth of this life depends on the condition of the ones served, and its issue differs according to their various conditions, as portrayed in this parable.

footnotes.zh: 神关于祂国的经纶，是个隐藏的奥秘，这奥秘已经向奴仆救主的门徒揭示出来。然而，因着神国的性质和特性完全是神圣的，并且神的国所借以产生的元素，乃是神圣的生命和神圣的光(见3注1，26注1与21注1)，所以神的国，尤其神国的实际，就是今世真正的召会(罗十四17)，对天然的人还全然是个奥秘。这是需要神圣的启示，才能明白的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神關於祂國的經綸，是個隱藏的奧祕，這奧祕已經向奴僕救主的門徒揭示出來。然而，因著神國的性質和特性完全是神聖的，並且神的國所藉以產生的元素，乃是神聖的生命和神聖的光，（見3註1，26註1與21註1，）所以神的國，尤其神國的實際，就是今世真正的召會，（羅十四17，）對天然的人還全然是個奧祕。這是需要神聖的啟示，纔能明白的。
footnotes.en: 4:11 1 mystery God's economy concerning His kingdom was a hidden mystery, which has been unveiled to the Slave-Savior's disciples. Yet since the nature and character of the kingdom of God are wholly divine, and the elements through which it is brought forth are the divine life and the divine light (see note Mark 4:3 1 , note Mark 4:26 1 , and note Mark 4:21 1 ) the kingdom of God, especially in its reality as the genuine church in this age (Rom. 14:17), is still entirely a mystery to the natural man. Divine revelation is required to understand it.

footnotes.zh: 或，成了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，成了。
footnotes.en: 4:11 2 are Or, are done, become.

footnotes.zh: 发光的灯指明奴仆救主福音的服事，不仅把生命撒在祂所服事的人里面，也把光带给他们。因此，这样神圣服事的结果，就使信徒成为发光之体(腓二15)，召会成为灯台(启一20)，照耀在这黑暗的时代，作祂的见证，并完成于具有生命和光之显著特征的新耶路撒冷城(启二二1～2，二一11，23～24)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 發光的燈指明奴僕救主福音的服事，不僅把生命撒在祂所服事的人裏面，也把光帶給他們。因此，這樣神聖服事的結果，就使信徒成為發光之體，（腓二15，）召會成為燈臺，（啟一20，）照耀在這黑暗的時代，作祂的見證，並完成於具有生命和光之顯著特徵的新耶路撒冷城。（啟二二1～2，二一11，23～24。）
footnotes.en: 4:21 1 lamp The lamp here, which shines light, indicates that the Slave-Savior's gospel service not only sows life into the people whom He serves but also brings light to them. Hence, such a divine service issues in the believers as luminaries (Phil. 2:15) and the churches as lampstands (Rev. 1:20) that shine as His testimony in this dark age and consummate in the New Jerusalem, which has the outstanding characteristics of life and light (Rev. 22:1-2; 21:11, 23-24).

footnotes.en: 4:24 1 With In Matt. 7:2 and Luke 6:38 this word is applied to the way we treat others. Here it is applied to the way we hear the word of the Lord. The measure that can be given to us by the Lord depends on the measure of our hearing. As much as we can hear, that much He will give.

verses.text_gb: 因为[Fn1][Cra]有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
verses.text_big5: 因為[Fn1][Cra]有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
verses.text_en: For he who has, it shall be given to him; and he who does not have, even what he has shall be taken away from him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。

footnotes.zh: 这里的话也是说到我们如何听主的话，如在太十三10～13，路八18者。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的話也是說到我們如何聽主的話，如在太十三10～13，路八18者。
footnotes.en: 4:25 1 has The word here, as in Matt. 13:10-13 and Luke 8:18, is concerned with how we hear the word of the Lord.

refs.text_gb: 因为凡有的，还要给他，他就充盈有余；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡有的，還要給他，他就充盈有餘；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: For to everyone who has, more shall be given, and he shall abound; but from him who does not have, even that which he has shall be taken away from him.

refs.text_gb: 主人说，我告诉你们，凡有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。
refs.text_big5: 主人說，我告訴你們，凡有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的，也要從他奪去。
refs.text_en: I tell you that to everyone who has, more shall be given, but from him who does not have, even that which he has shall be taken away.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣又说，[Fn1][Cra]神的国是这样，如同[Fn2]人把[Fn3][Crb]种子撒在地上，
verses.text_big5: 耶穌又說，[Fn1][Cra]神的國是這樣，如同[Fn2]人把[Fn3][Crb]種子撒在地上，
verses.text_en: And He said, So is the kingdom of God: as if a man cast seed on the earth,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣又说，神的国是这样，如同人把种子撒在地上，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌又說，神的國是這樣，如同人把種子撒在地上，

footnotes.zh: 神的国乃是召会的实际，借着福音，由基督复活的生命所产生(林前四15)；重生是其入门(约三5)，而信徒里面神生命的长大是其发展(彼后一3～11)。见一15注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的國乃是召會的實際，藉著福音，由基督復活的生命所產生；（林前四15；）重生是其入門，（約三5，）而信徒裏面神生命的長大是其發展。（彼後一3～11。）見一15註1。
footnotes.en: 4:26 1 kingdom The kingdom of God is the reality of the church, which is brought forth by the resurrection life of Christ through the gospel (1 Cor. 4:15). Regeneration is the entrance to the kingdom (John 3:5), and the growth of the divine life within the believers is the kingdom's development (2 Pet. 1:3-11). See note Mark 1:15 1 .

footnotes.zh: 指奴仆救主作撒种的人。见3注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指奴僕救主作撒種的人。見3註1。
footnotes.en: 4:26 2 man The Slave-Savior as the sower. See note Mark 4:3 1 .

footnotes.zh: 撒在奴仆救主之信徒里面那神圣生命的种子(约壹三9，彼前一23)，指明神的国(奴仆救主福音的结果和目标)，以及今世的召会(罗十四17)，都是生命，就是神生命的事。这生命发芽、长大、结果、成熟并产生收成。神的国和召会，都不是人的智慧和能力所产生无生命的组织。使徒在林前三6～9，以及启十四4、15～16的话，证实这点。
footnotes.zh_big5: 撒在奴僕救主之信徒裏面那神聖生命的種子，（約壹三9，彼前一23，）指明神的國（奴僕救主福音的結果和目標），以及今世的召會，（羅十四17，）都是生命，就是神生命的事。這生命發芽、長大、結果、成熟並產生收成。神的國和召會，都不是人的智慧和能力所產生無生命的組織。使徒在林前三6～9，以及啟十四4、15～16的話，證實這點。
footnotes.en: 4:26 3 seed The seed of the divine life (1 John 3:9; 1 Pet. 1:23) sown into the Slave-Savior's believers, indicating that the kingdom of God, which is the issue and goal of the Slave-Savior's gospel, and the church in this age (Rom. 14:17) are a matter of life, the life of God, which sprouts, grows, bears fruit, matures, and produces a harvest; they are not a matter of lifeless organization produced through man's wisdom and ability. The apostles' words in 1 Cor. 3:6-9 and Rev. 14:4, 15-16 confirm this.

refs.text_gb: 时期满了，神的国已经临近了。你们要悔改，相信福音。
refs.text_big5: 時期滿了，神的國已經臨近了。你們要悔改，相信福音。
refs.text_en: And saying, The time is fulfilled and the kingdom of God has drawn near. Repent and believe in the gospel.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又说，神的国我们可以比作什么？可用什么比喻表明？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又說，神的國我們可以比作甚麼？可用甚麼比喻表明？
refs.text_en: And He said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God, or in what parable shall we present it?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我實實在在的告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見神的國。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered and said to him, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless one is born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和灵生的，就不能进神的国。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我實實在在的告訴你，人若不是從水和靈生的，就不能進神的國。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 祂受害之后，用许多确据，将自己活活地显给使徒看，四十天之久向他们显现，讲说神国的事。
refs.text_big5: 祂受害之後，用許多確據，將自己活活的顯給使徒看，四十天之久向他們顯現，講說神國的事。
refs.text_en: To whom also He presented Himself alive after His suffering by many irrefutable proofs, appearing to them through a period of forty days and speaking the things concerning the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 坚固门徒的魂，劝勉他们恒守信仰，又说，我们进入神的国，必须经历许多患难。
refs.text_big5: 堅固門徒的魂，勸勉他們恆守信仰，又說，我們進入神的國，必須經歷許多患難。
refs.text_en: Establishing the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith and saying that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 全然放胆宣扬神的国，并教导主耶稣基督的事，毫无阻碍。
refs.text_big5: 全然放膽宣揚神的國，並教導主耶穌基督的事，毫無阻礙。
refs.text_en: Proclaiming the kingdom of God and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, unhindered.

refs.text_gb: 因为神的国不在于吃喝，乃在于公义、和平、并圣灵中的喜乐。
refs.text_big5: 因為神的國不在於喫喝，乃在於公義、和平、並聖靈中的喜樂。
refs.text_en: For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

refs.text_gb: 你们岂不知，不义的不能承受神的国么？不要受迷惑，无论是淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、同性恋的、
refs.text_big5: 你們豈不知，不義的不能承受神的國麼？不要受迷惑，無論是淫亂的、拜偶像的、姦淫的、作孌童的、同性戀的、
refs.text_en: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be led astray; neither fornicators nor idolaters nor adulterers nor effeminate nor homosexuals

refs.text_gb: 偷窃的、贪婪的、醉酒的、辱骂的、勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
refs.text_big5: 偷竊的、貪婪的、醉酒的、辱罵的、勒索的，都不能承受神的國。
refs.text_en: Nor thieves nor the covetous, not drunkards, not revilers, not the rapacious will inherit the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣在他们跟前另设一个比喻，说，诸天的国好比人撒好种在他的田里；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌在他們跟前另設一個比喻，說，諸天的國好比人撒好種在他的田裏；
refs.text_en: Another parable He set before them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens has become like a man sowing good seed in his field.

refs.text_gb: 及至人们睡觉的时候，他的仇敌来了，将稗子撒在麦子中间，就走了。
refs.text_big5: 及至人們睡覺的時候，他的仇敵來了，將稗子撒在麥子中間，就走了。
refs.text_en: But while the men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares in the midst of the wheat and went away.

refs.text_gb: 到长苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。
refs.text_big5: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
refs.text_en: And when the blade sprouted and produced fruit, then the tares appeared also.

refs.text_gb: 让这两样一齐长，直到收割。在收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先薅集稗子，捆成捆，好把它们烧了，麦子却要收到我的仓里。
refs.text_big5: 讓這兩樣一齊長，直到收割。在收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先薅集稗子，捆成捆，好把它們燒了，麥子卻要收到我的倉裏。
refs.text_en: Let both grow together until the harvest, and at the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Collect first the tares and bind them into bundles to burn them up, but the wheat gather into my barn.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种子就发芽[Fn2]渐长，怎么会这样，他并不知道。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種子就發芽[Fn2]漸長，怎麼會這樣，他並不知道。
verses.text_en: And sleeps and rises night and day, and the seed sprouts and lengthens-how, he does not know.
verses.text_gb_plain: 黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种子就发芽渐长，怎么会这样，他并不知道。
verses.text_big5_plain: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種子就發芽漸長，怎麼會這樣，他並不知道。

footnotes.zh: “黑夜睡觉，白日起来，”以及“怎么会这样，他并不知道，”这些话不该应用在奴仆救主身上。本节乃是说明种子的长大是自然的(参28)。
footnotes.zh_big5: “黑夜睡覺，白日起來，”以及“怎麼會這樣，他並不知道，”這些話不該應用在奴僕救主身上。本節乃是說明種子的長大是自然的。（參28。）
footnotes.en: 4:27 1 sleeps The words sleeps and rises night and day and how, he does not know should not be applied to the Slave-Savior. This verse illustrates the spontaneity of the growth of the seed (cf. v. 28).

footnotes.zh: 即长大。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即長大。
footnotes.en: 4:27 2 lengthens I.e., grows.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]地生五谷，是[Fn2]出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]地生五穀，是[Fn2]出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒。
verses.text_en: The earth bears fruit by itself: first a blade, then an ear, then full grain in the ear.
verses.text_gb_plain: 地生五谷，是出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒。
verses.text_big5_plain: 地生五穀，是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒。

footnotes.zh: 地，即好土(8)，象征神所创造的好心(创一31)，为着神圣的生命在人里面长大。这样的好心与撒在其中神圣生命的种子合作，使这种子自然的长大并结实，叫神得着彰显。这里的话，使我们对生命这样的自然生长有信心。因此，这里没有说到消极方面的稗子，如在太十三24～30者。
footnotes.zh_big5: 地，即好土，（8，）象徵神所創造的好心，（創一31，）為著神聖的生命在人裏面長大。這樣的好心與撒在其中神聖生命的種子合作，使這種子自然的長大並結實，叫神得著彰顯。這裏的話，使我們對生命這樣的自然生長有信心。因此，這裏沒有說到消極方面的稗子，如在太十三24～30者。
footnotes.en: 4:28 1 earth I.e., the good earth (v. 8), signifying the good heart that was created by God (Gen. 1:31) so that His divine life can grow in man. Such a good heart works together with the seed of the divine life sown into it, allowing the seed to grow and bear fruit spontaneously for the expression of God. The word here enables us to have faith in this spontaneity. Thus, here, in contrast to Matt. 13:24-30, tares are not mentioned, on the negative side.

footnotes.zh: 或，自发的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，自發的。
footnotes.en: 4:28 2 by Or, spontaneously.

verses.text_gb: 谷既熟了，他[Cra]立刻[Fn1]用[Fn2][Crb]镰刀去割，因为收割的时候到了。
verses.text_big5: 穀既熟了，他[Cra]立刻[Fn1]用[Fn2][Crb]鐮刀去割，因為收割的時候到了。
verses.text_en: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he sends forth the sickle, because the harvest has come.
verses.text_gb_plain: 谷既熟了，他立刻用镰刀去割，因为收割的时候到了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 穀既熟了，他立刻用鐮刀去割，因為收割的時候到了。

footnotes.zh: 用镰刀去割，直译，差出镰刀。
footnotes.zh_big5: 用鐮刀去割，直譯，差出鐮刀。
footnotes.en: 4:29 1 sickle Signifying the angels sent by the Lord to reap the harvest (Rev. 14:16; Matt. 13:39).

footnotes.zh: 象征天使受主差遣去收割庄稼(启十四16，太十三39)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 象徵天使受主差遣去收割莊稼。（啟十四16，太十三39。）

refs.text_gb: 但他们里面没有根，不过是暂时的；及至为道遭遇患难或逼迫，就立刻绊跌了。
refs.text_big5: 但他們裏面沒有根，不過是暫時的；及至為道遭遇患難或逼迫，就立刻絆跌了。
refs.text_en: Yet they have no root in themselves, but last only for a time; then when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately they are stumbled.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣一下船，立即有一个污灵附着的人，从坟茔里出来迎着祂。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌一下船，立即有一個污靈附著的人，從墳塋裏出來迎著祂。
refs.text_en: And when He came out of the boat, immediately, from out of the tombs, a man with an unclean spirit met Him,

refs.text_gb: 又有一位天使从殿中出来，向那坐在云上的大声喊着说，伸出你的镰刀来收割，因为收割的时候到了，地上的庄稼已经熟了。
refs.text_big5: 又有一位天使從殿中出來，向那坐在雲上的大聲喊著說，伸出你的鐮刀來收割，因為收割的時候到了，地上的莊稼已經熟了。
refs.text_en: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, Send forth Your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come because the harvest of the earth is ripe.

refs.text_gb: 伸出镰刀吧，因为庄稼熟了；前来践踏吧，因为酒醡满了；酒池盈溢，因为他们的罪恶甚大。
refs.text_big5: 伸出鐮刀罷，因為莊稼熟了；前來踐踏罷，因為酒醡滿了；酒池盈溢，因為他們的罪惡甚大。
refs.text_en: Send forth the sickle, / For the harvest is ripe; / Come, tread, / For the winepress is full; / The wine vats overflow, / For their evil is great.

verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌又說，神的國我們可以比作甚麼？可用甚麼比喻表明？

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又说，神的国是这样，如同人把种子撒在地上，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又說，神的國是這樣，如同人把種子撒在地上，
refs.text_en: And He said, So is the kingdom of God: as if a man cast seed on the earth,

refs.text_gb: 若是你一只眼绊跌你，就去掉它；你只有一只眼进入神的国，比有两只眼被扔在火坑里更好。
refs.text_big5: 若是你一隻眼絆跌你，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入神的國，比有兩隻眼被扔在火坑裏更好。
refs.text_en: And if your eye stumbles you, cast it out; it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into Gehenna,

verses.text_gb: 好像一粒[Cra]芥菜种，种在地里的时候，比地上百种都小，
verses.text_big5: 好像一粒[Cra]芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，比地上百種都小，
verses.text_en: It is like a mustard seed, which, when it is sown on the earth, is smaller than all the seeds on the earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，比地上百种都小，
verses.text_big5_plain: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，比地上百種都小，
