refs.text_gb: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华你的神必亲自和你同去；祂必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。
refs.text_big5: 你們當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要因他們驚恐，因為耶和華你的神必親自和你同去；祂必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
refs.text_en: Be strong and take courage; do not fear, neither be terrified of them, for it is Jehovah your God who goes with you; He will not fail you nor forsake you.

refs.text_gb: 因为我是耶和华你的神，我紧握你的右手，对你说，不要害怕，我必帮助你。
refs.text_big5: 因為我是耶和華你的神，我緊握你的右手，對你說，不要害怕，我必幫助你。
refs.text_en: For I am Jehovah your God, / Who takes hold of your right hand, / Who says to you, Do not be afraid; / I will help you.

refs.text_gb: 雅各啊，创造你的耶和华如此说，以色列啊，塑造你的那位现在如此说，你不要害怕，因为我救赎了你；我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。
refs.text_big5: 雅各阿，創造你的耶和華如此說，以色列阿，塑造你的那位現在如此說，你不要害怕，因為我救贖了你；我曾題你的名召你，你是屬我的。
refs.text_en: But now thus says Jehovah / Who created you, O Jacob, and who formed you, O Israel: / Do not fear, because I have redeemed you; / I have called you by your name; you are Mine.

refs.text_gb: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在；你蹚过江河，水必不漫过你。你从火中行过，必不被烧，火焰必不烧着你。
refs.text_big5: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在；你蹚過江河，水必不漫過你。你從火中行過，必不被燒，火焰必不燒著你。
refs.text_en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, / And through the rivers, they will not flow over you. / And when you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, / And the flame will not consume you.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进前来，摸他们说，起来，不要害怕。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進前來，摸他們說，起來，不要害怕。
refs.text_en: And Jesus came to them and touched them and said, Arise, and do not be afraid.

verses.text_gb: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就[Cra]止住了。他们心里极其[Crb]惊奇，
verses.text_big5: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就[Cra]止住了。他們心裏極其[Crb]驚奇，
verses.text_en: And He went up unto them into the boat, and the wind ceased. And they were greatly astonished in themselves beyond measure,
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就止住了。他们心里极其惊奇，
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就止住了。他們心裏極其驚奇，

refs.text_gb: 耶稣醒来，斥责风，又向海说，安静吧！不要发声！风就止住，大大地平静了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌醒來，斥責風，又向海說，安靜罷！不要發聲！風就止住，大大的平靜了。
refs.text_en: And having awoken, He rebuked the wind and said to the sea, Be silent! Be still! And the wind ceased and there was a great calm.

refs.text_gb: 到了安息日，祂在会堂里施教；许多人听见，就甚惊讶，说，这人从哪里得来这些事？所赐给祂的是什么样的智慧！这样的异能竟然经祂的手行出来！
refs.text_big5: 到了安息日，祂在會堂裏施教；許多人聽見，就甚驚訝，說，這人從那裏得來這些事？所賜給祂的是甚麼樣的智慧！這樣的異能竟然經祂的手行出來！
refs.text_en: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue; and many hearing were astounded, saying, Where did this man get these things? And what is this wisdom given to this man, and how is it that such works of power take place through His hands?

refs.text_gb: 众人分外惊讶，说，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聋的听见，又叫哑的说话。
refs.text_big5: 眾人分外驚訝，說，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聾的聽見，又叫啞的說話。
refs.text_en: And they were utterly astounded, saying, He has done all things well; He makes both the deaf hear and the dumb speak.

verses.text_gb: 因为他们不[Cra]领悟分饼的事，心里还是顽固。
verses.text_big5: 因為他們不[Cra]領悟分餅的事，心裏還是頑固。
verses.text_en: For they did not understand concerning the loaves, but rather their heart was hardened.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为他们不领悟分饼的事，心里还是顽固。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為他們不領悟分餅的事，心裏還是頑固。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道了，就对他们说，你们为什么因为没有饼就议论？你们还不明白，还不领悟么？你们的心还是顽固么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道了，就對他們說，你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論？你們還不明白，還不領悟麼？你們的心還是頑固麼？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning because you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive nor understand? Do you have your heart hardened?

refs.text_gb: 你们有眼睛，看不见么？有耳朵，听不见么？也不记得么？
refs.text_big5: 你們有眼睛，看不見麼？有耳朵，聽不見麼？也不記得麼？
refs.text_en: Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear? And do you not remember?

refs.text_gb: 我擘开那五个饼分给五千人，你们拾起的零碎，装满了多少篮子？他们说，十二个。
refs.text_big5: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們拾起的零碎，裝滿了多少籃子？他們說，十二個。
refs.text_en: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many handbaskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They said to Him, Twelve.

refs.text_gb: 那七个饼分给四千人，你们拾起的零碎，装满了多少筐子？他们说，七个。
refs.text_big5: 那七個餅分給四千人，你們拾起的零碎，裝滿了多少筐子？他們說，七個。
refs.text_en: And when I broke the seven for the four thousand, how many baskets filled with broken pieces did you take up? And they said, Seven.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，你们还是不领悟么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，你們還是不領悟麼？
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Do you not yet understand?

verses.text_gb: 他们既[Cra]渡过去，来到[Crb]革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸。
verses.text_big5: 他們既[Cra]渡過去，來到[Crb]革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸。
verses.text_en: And they crossed over to the land and came to Gennesaret and moored there.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸。

refs.text_big5: 他們既渡過去，就上了岸，來到革尼撒勒。
refs.text_en: And they crossed over and came to land at Gennesaret.

refs.text_gb: 那地方的人一认出是耶稣，就打发人到四周全境，把一切有病的带到祂那里，
refs.text_big5: 那地方的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到四周全境，把一切有病的帶到祂那裏，
refs.text_en: And when the men of that place recognized Him, they sent word into all that surrounding region and brought to Him all who were ill.

refs.text_gb: 求祂让他们只摸祂的衣服穗子，凡摸着的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_big5: 求祂讓他們只摸祂的衣服繸子，凡摸著的，都完全得了拯救。
refs.text_en: And they begged Him that they might only touch the fringe of His garment. And as many as touched were completely healed.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，群众拥挤祂，要听神的话。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌站在革尼撒勒湖邊，群眾擁擠祂，要聽神的話。
refs.text_en: And as the crowd pressed upon Him to hear the word of God, He was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

verses.text_big5: 一下船，眾人[Cra]立刻[Crb]認出祂來，
verses.text_en: And when they came out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,
verses.text_gb_plain: 一下船，众人立刻认出祂来，
verses.text_big5_plain: 一下船，眾人立刻認出祂來，

refs.text_gb: 有一个妇人，她的小女儿有污灵附着，听见耶稣的事，立即来俯伏在祂脚前。
refs.text_big5: 有一個婦人，她的小女兒有污靈附著，聽見耶穌的事，立即來俯伏在祂腳前。
refs.text_en: But a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit heard about Him, and immediately she came and fell at His feet.

refs.text_gb: 许多人看见他们去，认出了他们，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先到。
refs.text_big5: 許多人看見他們去，認出了他們，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裏，比他們先到。
refs.text_en: And many saw them going away and recognized them, and they ran together there on foot from all the cities and got there before them.

verses.text_big5: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見祂在何處，便將有病的人，用[Cra]褥子抬到那裏。
verses.text_en: And they ran about that whole region and began to carry around on mats those who were ill to any place where they heard that He was.
verses.text_gb_plain: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见祂在何处，便将有病的人，用褥子抬到那里。
verses.text_big5_plain: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見祂在何處，便將有病的人，用褥子抬到那裏。

refs.text_gb: 看哪，人用卧榻抬着一个瘫痪的人，想要抬进去，放在耶稣面前。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，人用臥榻抬著一個癱瘓的人，想要抬進去，放在耶穌面前。
refs.text_en: And behold, some men brought on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they sought a way to carry him in and lay him before Him.

verses.text_gb: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或[Cra]村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病弱的放在[Crb]市场上，求耶稣准他们至少[Crc]摸[Fn1]祂的衣服穗子；凡摸着祂的人，都得了[Fn2]拯救。
verses.text_big5: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或[Cra]村中，或城裏，或鄉間，他們都將病弱的放在[Crb]市場上，求耶穌准他們至少[Crc]摸[Fn1]祂的衣服繸子；凡摸著祂的人，都得了[Fn2]拯救。
verses.text_en: And wherever He entered into villages or into cities or into the countryside, they laid those who were sick in the marketplaces and begged Him that they might touch if even the fringe of His garment; and as many as touched Him were healed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病弱的放在市场上，求耶稣准他们至少摸祂的衣服穗子；凡摸着祂的人，都得了拯救。

refs.text_gb: 祂也希奇他们不信，就周游四围乡村施教去了。
refs.text_big5: 祂也希奇他們不信，就周遊四圍鄉村施教去了。
refs.text_en: And He marveled because of their unbelief; and He went around the villages in a circuit, teaching.

refs.text_gb: 甚至有人将病人抬到街上，放在小榻或褥子上，指望彼得过来的时候，或者他的影子可以荫庇他们一些人。

refs.text_en: So that they even carried the sick out into the streets and placed them on cots and mats, in order that when Peter came, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

refs.text_gb: 因为祂治好了许多人，以致凡有灾病的，都挤过来要摸祂。
refs.text_big5: 因為祂治好了許多人，以致凡有災病的，都擠過來要摸祂。

refs.text_big5: 她聽見耶穌的事，就從群眾後面來摸耶穌的衣服。

refs.text_big5: 因為她說，我只要摸著祂的衣服，就必得拯救。
refs.text_en: For she said, If I touch even His garments, I will be healed.

refs.text_gb: 群众都想要摸祂，因为有能力从祂身上发出来，医治了众人。
refs.text_big5: 群眾都想要摸祂，因為有能力從祂身上發出來，醫治了眾人。
refs.text_en: And all the crowd sought to touch Him, because power was going out from Him and healing all.

refs.text_gb: 甚至有人从保罗身上拿手巾或围裙，放在病人身上，疾病就离开他们，恶灵也出去了。
refs.text_big5: 甚至有人從保羅身上拿手巾或圍裙，放在病人身上，疾病就離開他們，惡靈也出去了。
refs.text_en: So that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and their diseases left them, and the evil spirits went out.

verses.text_big5_plain: 有法利賽人和幾個經學家，從耶路撒冷來到耶穌那裏聚集。

refs.text_gb: 那时，有法利赛人和经学家从耶路撒冷来到耶稣跟前，说，
refs.text_big5: 那時，有法利賽人和經學家從耶路撒冷來到耶穌跟前，說，
refs.text_en: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

refs.text_gb: 你的门徒为什么违犯古人的传统？因为他们吃饭的时候不洗手。
refs.text_big5: 你的門徒為甚麼違犯古人的傳統？因為他們喫飯的時候不洗手。
refs.text_en: Why do Your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread.

refs.text_gb: 祂就回答他们说，你们为什么因着你们的传统，违犯神的诫命？
refs.text_big5: 祂就回答他們說，你們為甚麼因著你們的傳統，違犯神的誡命？
refs.text_en: And He answered and said to them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?

refs.text_gb: 原来神说，“当孝敬父母，”又说，“咒骂父母的，要被处死。”
refs.text_big5: 原來神說，“當孝敬父母，”又說，“咒罵父母的，要被處死。”
refs.text_en: For God said, "Honor your father and your mother," and, "He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death."

refs.text_gb: 你们倒说，无论谁对父母说，我所当供养你的，已经作了礼物，
refs.text_big5: 你們倒說，無論誰對父母說，我所當供養你的，已經作了禮物，
refs.text_en: But you say, Whoever says to his father or his mother, Whatever you would have been profited by me is now a gift to God,

refs.text_gb: 他就可以不孝敬父母。这就是你们因着你们的传统，使神的话失去效力和权柄。
refs.text_big5: 他就可以不孝敬父母。這就是你們因著你們的傳統，使神的話失去效力和權柄。
refs.text_en: Shall by no means honor his father or his mother; and you have deprived the word of God of its authority because of your tradition.

refs.text_gb: 假冒为善的人哪，以赛亚指着你们所申言的是对的；他说，
refs.text_big5: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指著你們所申言的是對的；他說，
refs.text_en: Hypocrites! Well has Isaiah prophesied concerning you, saying,

refs.text_gb: “这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心却远离我；
refs.text_big5: “這百姓用嘴脣尊敬我，心卻遠離我；
refs.text_en: "This people honors Me with their lips, but their heart stays far away from Me;

refs.text_gb: 他们敬拜我也是徒然，因为他们将人的吩咐当作教训教导人。”
refs.text_big5: 他們敬拜我也是徒然，因為他們將人的吩咐當作教訓教導人。”
refs.text_en: But in vain do they worship Me, teaching as teachings the commandments of men."

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣叫了群众来，对他们说，你们要听，也要领悟：
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌叫了群眾來，對他們說，你們要聽，也要領悟：
refs.text_en: And He called the crowd to Him and said to them, Hear and understand:

refs.text_gb: 入口的不能污秽人，出口的乃能污秽人。
refs.text_big5: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。
refs.text_en: It is not that which enters into the mouth that defiles the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.

refs.text_gb: 当时，门徒进前来，对祂说，法利赛人听见这话，被绊跌了，你知道么？
refs.text_big5: 當時，門徒進前來，對祂說，法利賽人聽見這話，被絆跌了，你知道麼？
refs.text_en: Then the disciples came and said to Him, Do You know that the Pharisees were stumbled when they heard this word?

refs.text_gb: 祂就回答说，凡不是我天父所栽种的植物，必要连根拔出来。
refs.text_big5: 祂就回答說，凡不是我天父所栽種的植物，必要連根拔出來。
refs.text_en: And He answered and said, Every plant which My heavenly Father has not planted shall be rooted up.

refs.text_gb: 任凭他们吧，他们是瞎子的瞎眼领路者；若是瞎子领瞎子，两个都要掉在坑里。
refs.text_big5: 任憑他們罷，他們是瞎子的瞎眼領路者；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個都要掉在坑裏。
refs.text_en: Let them be. They are blind guides of the blind; and if a blind man guides a blind man, both will fall into a pit.

refs.text_gb: 彼得就回答祂说，请给我们讲讲这比喻。
refs.text_big5: 彼得就回答祂說，請給我們講講這比喻。
refs.text_en: And Peter answered and said to Him, Explain this parable to us.

refs.text_gb: 祂就说，连你们到如今还不领悟么？
refs.text_big5: 祂就說，連你們到如今還不領悟麼？
refs.text_en: And He said, Are you also still without understanding?

refs.text_gb: 岂不知凡入口的，是进到肚腹，又排泄到茅厕么？
refs.text_big5: 豈不知凡入口的，是進到肚腹，又排泄到茅廁麼？
refs.text_en: Do you not understand that everything that goes into the mouth passes into the stomach and is expelled into the drain?

refs.text_gb: 唯独出口的，是从心里发出来的，那才污秽人。
refs.text_big5: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，那纔污穢人。
refs.text_en: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and those defile the man.

refs.text_gb: 因为从心里发出恶念、凶杀、奸淫、淫乱、偷窃、假见证和谤讟，
refs.text_big5: 因為從心裏發出惡念、兇殺、姦淫、淫亂、偷竊、假見證和謗讟，
refs.text_en: For out of the heart come evil reasonings, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witnessings, blasphemies.

refs.text_gb: 这些都是污秽人的；至于不洗手吃饭，却不污秽人。
refs.text_big5: 這些都是污穢人的；至於不洗手喫飯，卻不污穢人。
refs.text_en: These are the things which defile the man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile the man.

refs.text_gb: 从耶路撒冷下来的经学家说，祂有别西卜附着；又说，祂是靠着鬼王赶鬼。
refs.text_big5: 從耶路撒冷下來的經學家說，祂有別西卜附著；又說，祂是靠著鬼王趕鬼。
refs.text_en: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebul, and by the ruler of the demons He casts out the demons.

verses.text_gb: 他们曾看见祂的门徒中，有人用俗手，就是[Cra]没有洗的手吃饭[Fn1]。
verses.text_big5: 他們曾看見祂的門徒中，有人用俗手，就是[Cra]沒有洗的手喫飯[Fn1]。
verses.text_en: And had seen that some of His disciples ate bread with common hands, that is, unwashed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们曾看见祂的门徒中，有人用俗手，就是没有洗的手吃饭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們曾看見祂的門徒中，有人用俗手，就是沒有洗的手喫飯。

footnotes.zh: 饭，直译，饼。后文同。有些古卷下加，他们就挑毛病。
footnotes.zh_big5: 飯，直譯，餅。後文同。有些古卷下加，他們就挑毛病。
footnotes.en: 7:2 1 had Some MSS read, seeing...unwashed, they found fault.

refs.text_gb: 这法利赛人看见耶稣饭前不先洗手，就希奇。
refs.text_big5: 這法利賽人看見耶穌飯前不先洗手，就希奇。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisee, seeing it, marveled that He had not first washed before the meal.

verses.text_gb: （原来法利赛人和所有的犹太人，都拘守[Fn1]古人的[Cra]传统，若不[Fn2]仔细洗手，就不吃饭；
verses.text_big5: （原來法利賽人和所有的猶太人，都拘守[Fn1]古人的[Cra]傳統，若不[Fn2]仔細洗手，就不喫飯；
verses.text_en: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews, unless they carefully wash their hands, do not eat, holding the tradition of the elders;
verses.text_gb_plain: （原来法利赛人和所有的犹太人，都拘守古人的传统，若不仔细洗手，就不吃饭；
verses.text_big5_plain: （原來法利賽人和所有的猶太人，都拘守古人的傳統，若不仔細洗手，就不喫飯；

footnotes.zh: 即前人，前代的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即前人，前代的人。
footnotes.en: 7:3 1 carefully Lit., with the fist.

footnotes.zh: 仔细，直译，用拳。
footnotes.zh_big5: 仔細，直譯，用拳。
footnotes.en: 7:3 2 elders I.e., ancients, people of the previous generations.

refs.text_gb: 我又在犹太教中，比我本族许多同岁的人更有长进，为我祖宗的传统格外热心。
refs.text_big5: 我又在猶太教中，比我本族許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的傳統格外熱心。
refs.text_en: And I advanced in Judaism beyond many contemporaries in my race, being more abundantly a zealot for the traditions of my fathers.

refs.text_gb: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的哲学，和虚空的欺骗，照着人的传统，照着世上的蒙学，不照着基督，把你们掳去；
refs.text_big5: 你們要謹慎，恐怕有人用他的哲學，和虛空的欺騙，照著人的傳統，照著世上的蒙學，不照著基督，把你們擄去；
refs.text_en: Beware that no one carries you off as spoil through his philosophy and empty deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the elements of the world, and not according to Christ;

verses.text_gb: 从市场上来，若不[Fn1]洗浴，也不吃饭；他们所沿袭拘守的，还有[Cra]好些别的事，就如[Crb]浸洗杯、罐、铜器[Fn2]等。）
verses.text_big5: 從市場上來，若不[Fn1]洗浴，也不喫飯；他們所沿襲拘守的，還有[Cra]好些別的事，就如[Crb]浸洗杯、罐、銅器[Fn2]等。）
verses.text_en: And when they come from the marketplace, unless they wash themselves, they do not eat. And there are many other things which they have received to hold, the dipping of cups and pitchers and copper vessels.)
verses.text_gb_plain: 从市场上来，若不洗浴，也不吃饭；他们所沿袭拘守的，还有好些别的事，就如浸洗杯、罐、铜器等。）
verses.text_big5_plain: 從市場上來，若不洗浴，也不喫飯；他們所沿襲拘守的，還有好些別的事，就如浸洗杯、罐、銅器等。）

footnotes.zh_big5: 洗浴，直譯，浸（動詞）。有些古卷作，灑。

refs.text_gb: 这就是你们借着所传授的传统，使神的话失去效力和权柄。你们还作许多这类的事。
refs.text_big5: 這就是你們藉著所傳授的傳統，使神的話失去效力和權柄。你們還作許多這類的事。
refs.text_en: Thus you deprive the word of God of its authority by your tradition which you have handed down. And many things similar to these you do.

refs.text_gb: 这些不过是在于饮食和各样的浸洗，都是属肉体的章则，制定到更正的时期。
refs.text_big5: 這些不過是在於飲食和各樣的浸洗，都是屬肉體的章則，制定到更正的時期。
refs.text_en: Consisting only of foods and drinks and various washings, being ordinances of the flesh, imposed until the time of setting things right.

refs.text_gb: 假冒为善的经学家和法利赛人，你们有祸了！因为你们洁净杯盘的外面，里面却盛满了勒索和放荡。
refs.text_big5: 假冒為善的經學家和法利賽人，你們有禍了！因為你們潔淨杯盤的外面，裏面卻盛滿了勒索和放蕩。
refs.text_en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you cleanse the outside of the cup and the dish, but inwardly they are full of extortion and self-indulgence.

refs.text_gb: 主对他说，如今你们法利赛人洁净杯盘的外面，你们里面却满了勒索和邪恶。
refs.text_big5: 主對他說，如今你們法利賽人潔淨杯盤的外面，你們裏面卻滿了勒索和邪惡。
refs.text_en: But the Lord said to him, Again, you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inside is full of extortion and wickedness.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]法利赛人和经学家就问祂说，你的门徒为什么不照古人的传统行事，用俗手吃饭？
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]法利賽人和經學家就問祂說，你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的傳統行事，用俗手喫飯？
verses.text_en: And the Pharisees and the scribes questioned Him, Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with common hands?

verses.text_big5_plain: 法利賽人和經學家就問祂說，你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的傳統行事，用俗手喫飯？

refs.text_gb: 主说，因为这百姓用口亲近我，用嘴唇尊敬我，心却远离我；他们敬畏我，不过是领受人的吩咐。
refs.text_big5: 主說，因為這百姓用口親近我，用嘴脣尊敬我，心卻遠離我；他們敬畏我，不過是領受人的吩咐。
refs.text_en: And the Lord said, / Because this people draws near with their mouth, / And with their lips they honor Me, / Yet they remove their heart far from Me, / And their fear for Me / Is a commandment of men merely learned;

refs.text_gb: 他们来到你这里如同民来聚会，坐在你面前仿佛是我的民，他们听你的话却不去行；因为他们用口多显爱情，他们的心却追随财利。
refs.text_big5: 他們來到你這裏如同民來聚會，坐在你面前彷彿是我的民，他們聽你的話卻不去行；因為他們用口多顯愛情，他們的心卻追隨財利。
refs.text_en: And they come to you just as people come, and they sit before you as My people, and they hear your words but do not do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

verses.text_gb: 他们[Fn1]敬拜我也是徒然，因为他们将[Cra]人的吩咐当作教训教导人。”
verses.text_big5: 他們[Fn1]敬拜我也是徒然，因為他們將[Cra]人的吩咐當作教訓教導人。”
verses.text_en: But in vain do they worship Me, teaching as teachings the commandments of men."
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们敬拜我也是徒然，因为他们将人的吩咐当作教训教导人。”
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們敬拜我也是徒然，因為他們將人的吩咐當作教訓教導人。”

footnotes.zh: 指尊崇，强调惧怕或虔诚的感觉。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指尊崇，強調懼怕或虔誠的感覺。
footnotes.en: 7:7 1 worship Revere. The feeling of awe or devotion is stressed.

refs.text_gb: 这些都是照着人的吩咐和教导，一经使用，就都败坏了。
refs.text_big5: 這些都是照著人的吩咐和教導，一經使用，就都敗壞了。
refs.text_en: (Regarding things which are all to perish when used) according to the commandments and teachings of men?

refs.text_gb: 不注意犹太人虚构无稽之事，和转离真理之人的诫命。
refs.text_big5: 不注意猶太人虛構無稽之事，和轉離真理之人的誡命。
refs.text_en: Not paying attention to Jewish myths and the commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

verses.text_gb: 你们是离弃神的诫命，拘守人的传统[Fn1]。
verses.text_big5: 你們是離棄神的誡命，拘守人的傳統[Fn1]。
verses.text_en: While leaving the commandment of God, you hold the tradition of men.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们是离弃神的诫命，拘守人的传统。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們是離棄神的誡命，拘守人的傳統。

verses.text_gb: 祂又说，你们巧妙的[Fn1][Cra]废弃神的诫命，为要遵守自己的传统。
verses.text_big5: 祂又說，你們巧妙的[Fn1][Cra]廢棄神的誡命，為要遵守自己的傳統。
verses.text_en: And He said to them, You nicely set aside the commandment of God that you may keep your tradition.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂又说，你们巧妙的废弃神的诫命，为要遵守自己的传统。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂又說，你們巧妙的廢棄神的誡命，為要遵守自己的傳統。

footnotes.zh: 遵守传统的结果，乃是废弃神的诫命，而且传统是叫人“巧妙的”废弃！
footnotes.zh_big5: 遵守傳統的結果，乃是廢棄神的誡命，而且傳統是叫人“巧妙的”廢棄！
footnotes.en: 7:9 1 set The result of the keeping of tradition is the setting aside of the commandment of God. Furthermore, tradition causes people to set aside the commandment of God "nicely"!

refs.text_gb: 但法利赛人和律法师，没有受过约翰的浸，竟为自己废弃了神的旨意。
refs.text_big5: 但法利賽人和律法師，沒有受過約翰的浸，竟為自己廢棄了神的旨意。
refs.text_en: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God for themselves since they had not been baptized by him.

verses.text_gb: 摩西说，“当[Fn1][Cra]孝敬父母，”又说，“[Crb]咒骂父母的，[Fn2]要被处死。”
verses.text_big5: 摩西說，“當[Fn1][Cra]孝敬父母，”又說，“[Crb]咒罵父母的，[Fn2]要被處死。”
verses.text_en: For Moses said, "Honor your father and your mother," and, "He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death."
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西说，“当孝敬父母，”又说，“咒骂父母的，要被处死。”
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西說，“當孝敬父母，”又說，“咒罵父母的，要被處死。”

footnotes.zh: 直译，尊敬。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，尊敬。

refs.text_gb: 当孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华你神所赐你的地上，得以长久。
refs.text_big5: 當孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華你神所賜你的地上，得以長久。
refs.text_en: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be extended upon the land which Jehovah your God is giving you.

refs.text_gb: 当照耶和华你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华你神所赐你的地上，得以长久，并使你可以得福。
refs.text_big5: 當照耶和華你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華你神所賜你的地上，得以長久，並使你可以得福。
refs.text_en: Honor your father and your mother, as Jehovah your God has commanded you, that your days may be extended and that it may be well with you upon the land which Jehovah your God is giving you.

refs.text_gb: 咒骂父母的，必要被处死。
refs.text_big5: 咒罵父母的，必要被處死。
refs.text_en: And he who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

refs.text_gb: 凡咒骂父母的，必要被处死；他咒骂了父母，流他血的罪要归到他身上。
refs.text_big5: 凡咒罵父母的，必要被處死；他咒罵了父母，流他血的罪要歸到他身上。
refs.text_en: If there is anyone who curses his father or his mother, he shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother; his blood is upon him.

refs.text_gb: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必熄灭在幽暗中。
refs.text_big5: 咒罵父母的，他的燈必熄滅在幽暗中。
refs.text_en: Whoever curses his father or his mother, / His lamp will go out in deep darkness.

verses.text_gb: 你们倒说，人若对父母说，[Fn1]我所当供养你的，已经作了[Fn2]各耳板，（就是[Cra]礼物，）
verses.text_big5: 你們倒說，人若對父母說，[Fn1]我所當供養你的，已經作了[Fn2]各耳板，（就是[Cra]禮物，）
verses.text_en: But you say: If a man says to his father or his mother, Whatever you would have been profited by me is now corban (that is, a gift to God),
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们倒说，人若对父母说，我所当供养你的，已经作了各耳板，（就是礼物，）
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們倒說，人若對父母說，我所當供養你的，已經作了各耳板，（就是禮物，）

footnotes.zh: 或，你可从我受益之物。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，你可從我受益之物。
footnotes.en: 7:11 1 corban For the Hebrew word qorban, meaning an offering. Signifying anything offered to God.

footnotes.zh: 希伯来文，qorban，各耳板，意奉献，表明献给神之物。
footnotes.zh_big5: 希伯來文，qorban，各耳板，意奉獻，表明獻給神之物。

refs.text_gb: 你要对以色列人说，你们中间若有人献供物给耶和华，要从牛群羊群中献牲畜为供物。
refs.text_big5: 你要對以色列人說，你們中間若有人獻供物給耶和華，要從牛群羊群中獻牲畜為供物。
refs.text_en: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, When any one of you presents an offering to Jehovah, you shall present your offering from the cattle, of the herd or of the flock.

verses.text_gb: 你们就不容许他再为父母作任何事。
verses.text_big5: 你們就不容許他再為父母作任何事。
verses.text_en: Allow him to no longer do anything for his father or his mother.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们就不容许他再为父母作任何事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們就不容許他再為父母作任何事。

verses.text_gb: 这就是你们借着所传授的传统，使神的话失去效力和权柄。你们还作[Cra]许多这类的事。
verses.text_big5: 這就是你們藉著所傳授的傳統，使神的話失去效力和權柄。你們還作[Cra]許多這類的事。
verses.text_en: Thus you deprive the word of God of its authority by your tradition which you have handed down. And many things similar to these you do.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这就是你们借着所传授的传统，使神的话失去效力和权柄。你们还作许多这类的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這就是你們藉著所傳授的傳統，使神的話失去效力和權柄。你們還作許多這類的事。

refs.text_gb: 从市场上来，若不洗浴，也不吃饭；他们所沿袭拘守的，还有好些别的事，就如浸洗杯、罐、铜器等。）
refs.text_big5: 從市場上來，若不洗浴，也不喫飯；他們所沿襲拘守的，還有好些別的事，就如浸洗杯、罐、銅器等。）
refs.text_en: And when they come from the marketplace, unless they wash themselves, they do not eat. And there are many other things which they have received to hold, the dipping of cups and pitchers and copper vessels.)

verses.text_gb: 耶稣又叫了群众来，对他们说，你们众人要听我，也要[Cra]领悟。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌又叫了群眾來，對他們說，你們眾人要聽我，也要[Cra]領悟。
verses.text_en: And He called the crowd to Him again and said to them, Hear Me, all of you, and understand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣又叫了群众来，对他们说，你们众人要听我，也要领悟。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌又叫了群眾來，對他們說，你們眾人要聽我，也要領悟。

refs.text_gb: 这一切的事，你们都领悟了么？他们对祂说，是的。
refs.text_big5: 這一切的事，你們都領悟了麼？他們對祂說，是的。
refs.text_en: Have you understood all these things? They said to Him, Yes.

verses.text_gb: 从人外面进去的，没有一样能[Fn1]污秽人，唯有从人里面出来的，乃能污秽人。
verses.text_big5: 從人外面進去的，沒有一樣能[Fn1]污穢人，惟有從人裏面出來的，乃能污穢人。
verses.text_en: There is nothing outside of a man which entering into him can defile him, but the things coming out of a man are the things which defile a man.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从人外面进去的，没有一样能污秽人，唯有从人里面出来的，乃能污秽人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從人外面進去的，沒有一樣能污穢人，惟有從人裏面出來的，乃能污穢人。

footnotes.zh: 使人成为俗的、不洁的(徒十一8)。下文同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使人成為俗的、不潔的。（徒十一8。）下文同。
footnotes.en: 7:15 1 defile Make him common, unclean (Acts 11:8). So in the succeeding verses.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]凡有耳可听的，就应当听。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]凡有耳可聽的，就應當聽。
verses.text_en: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡有耳可听的，就应当听。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡有耳可聽的，就應當聽。

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷无本节。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷無本節。
footnotes.en: 7:16 1 If Some MSS omit this verse.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣离开群众，进了[Cra]屋子，门徒就将这[Crb]比喻问祂。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌離開群眾，進了[Cra]屋子，門徒就將這[Crb]比喻問祂。
verses.text_en: And when He entered into a house from the crowd, His disciples questioned Him concerning the parable.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣离开群众，进了屋子，门徒就将这比喻问祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌離開群眾，進了屋子，門徒就將這比喻問祂。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣从那里起身，往推罗、西顿的境内去。进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌從那裏起身，往推羅、西頓的境內去。進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
refs.text_en: And He rose up from there and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And entering into a house, He wanted no one to know about it; yet He could not escape notice.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了一个屋子，群众又聚在一起，以致他们连吃饭都不能。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了一個屋子，群眾又聚在一起，以致他們連喫飯都不能。
refs.text_en: And He came into a house, and again a crowd came together, so that they could not even eat bread.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒暗暗地问祂说，我们为什么不能赶出它去？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒暗暗的問祂說，我們為甚麼不能趕出牠去？
refs.text_en: And when He entered into the house, His disciples questioned Him privately, Why were we not able to cast it out?

refs.text_gb: 当下，耶稣离开群众，进了屋里，祂的门徒到祂跟前来，说，请把田间稗子的比喻，给我们讲解清楚。
refs.text_big5: 當下，耶穌離開群眾，進了屋裏，祂的門徒到祂跟前來，說，請把田間稗子的比喻，給我們講解清楚。
refs.text_en: Then, leaving the crowds, He went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, Make the parable of the tares of the field clear to us.

verses.text_gb: 祂对他们说，连你们也是这样不[Cra]领悟么？岂不知凡从外面进入的，不能污秽人？
verses.text_big5: 祂對他們說，連你們也是這樣不[Cra]領悟麼？豈不知凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人？
verses.text_en: And He said to them, Are you also in the same manner without understanding? Do you not understand that everything that enters from outside into a man is not able to defile him,
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂对他们说，连你们也是这样不领悟么？岂不知凡从外面进入的，不能污秽人？
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂對他們說，連你們也是這樣不領悟麼？豈不知凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人？

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道了，就对他们说，你们为什么因为没有饼就议论？你们还不明白，还不领悟么？你们的心还是顽固么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道了，就對他們說，你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論？你們還不明白，還不領悟麼？你們的心還是頑固麼？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning because you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive nor understand? Do you have your heart hardened?

verses.text_gb: 因为不是进入他的心，乃是进入他的[Cra]肚腹，又排到茅厕里。祂这样说，就把各样的食物都[Crb]洁净了。
verses.text_big5: 因為不是進入他的心，乃是進入他的[Cra]肚腹，又排到茅廁裏。祂這樣說，就把各樣的食物都[Crb]潔淨了。
verses.text_en: Because it does not enter into his heart, but into the stomach, and goes out into the drain? (In saying this, He made all foods clean.)
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为不是进入他的心，乃是进入他的肚腹，又排到茅厕里。祂这样说，就把各样的食物都洁净了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為不是進入他的心，乃是進入他的肚腹，又排到茅廁裏。祂這樣說，就把各樣的食物都潔淨了。

refs.text_gb: 食物是为肚腹，肚腹是为食物；但这两样，神都要废掉。可是身体不是为淫乱，乃是为主，主也是为身体。
refs.text_big5: 食物是為肚腹，肚腹是為食物；但這兩樣，神都要廢掉。可是身體不是為淫亂，乃是為主，主也是為身體。
refs.text_en: Foods are for the stomach, and the stomach for foods; but God will bring to nought both it and them. But the body is not for fornication but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

refs.text_gb: 只要把里面的施舍给人，看哪，凡物于你们就都洁净了。
refs.text_big5: 只要把裏面的施捨給人，看哪，凡物於你們就都潔淨了。
refs.text_en: But give the things which are within as alms, and behold, all things are clean to you.

refs.text_gb: 第二次又有声音向他说，神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。
refs.text_big5: 第二次又有聲音向他說，神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。
refs.text_en: And a voice came to him again a second time: The things that God has cleansed, do not make common.

refs.text_gb: 第二次有声音从天上说，神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。
refs.text_big5: 第二次有聲音從天上說，神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。
refs.text_en: And a voice answered a second time out of heaven, The things that God has cleansed, do not make common.

refs.text_gb: 不可因食物拆毁神的工程。凡物固然洁净，但人吃了，以致成了绊脚石，就是他的恶了。
refs.text_big5: 不可因食物拆毀神的工程。凡物固然潔淨，但人喫了，以致成了絆腳石，就是他的惡了。
refs.text_en: Do not break down the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but it is evil for a man to eat while stumbling others.

verses.text_gb: 祂又说，从人里面出来的，那才[Cra]污秽人。
verses.text_big5: 祂又說，從人裏面出來的，那纔[Cra]污穢人。
verses.text_en: And He said, That which goes out of the man, that defiles the man.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂又说，从人里面出来的，那才污秽人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂又說，從人裏面出來的，那纔污穢人。

refs.text_gb: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，是个不义的世界，污秽全身，也把生命的轮子点起来，且是给火坑的火点着的。
refs.text_big5: 舌頭就是火，在我們百體中，是個不義的世界，污穢全身，也把生命的輪子點起來，且是給火坑的火點著的。
refs.text_en: And the tongue is a fire; the very world of unrighteousness, the tongue is set among our members as that which contaminates the whole body and sets on fire the course of life and is set on fire by Gehenna.

verses.text_gb: 因为从里面，就是从人[Cra]心里，发出恶念、淫乱、偷窃、[Crb]凶杀、
verses.text_big5: 因為從裏面，就是從人[Cra]心裏，發出惡念、淫亂、偷竊、[Crb]兇殺、
verses.text_en: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil reasonings, fornications, thefts, murders,
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为从里面，就是从人心里，发出恶念、淫乱、偷窃、凶杀、
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為從裏面，就是從人心裏，發出惡念、淫亂、偷竊、兇殺、

refs.text_gb: 耶和华闻了那怡爽的香气，就心里说，我不再因人的缘故咒诅地，（人从小时心里怀着恶念，）也不再按着我才行的，灭各种的活物了。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華聞了那怡爽的香氣，就心裏說，我不再因人的緣故咒詛地，（人從小時心裏懷著惡念，）也不再按著我纔行的，滅各種的活物了。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah smelled the satisfying fragrance; and Jehovah said in His heart, I will never again curse the ground on account of man, for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; nor will I ever again smite everything living as I have done.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就说，你们为什么心里思念恶事？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說，你們為甚麼心裏思念惡事？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why are you thinking evil things in your hearts?

refs.text_gb: 毒蛇之种，你们既是恶的，怎能说出善来？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。
refs.text_big5: 毒蛇之種，你們既是惡的，怎能說出善來？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
refs.text_en: Offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

refs.text_gb: 不可杀人。
refs.text_big5: 不可殺人。
refs.text_en: You shall not kill.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]奸淫、[Crb]贪婪、邪恶、[Fn1]诡诈、淫荡、[Fn2]嫉妒、[Crc]谤讟、狂傲、愚妄；
verses.text_big5: [Cra]姦淫、[Crb]貪婪、邪惡、[Fn1]詭詐、淫蕩、[Fn2]嫉妒、[Crc]謗讟、狂傲、愚妄；
verses.text_en: Adulteries, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, licentiousness, envy, blasphemy, arrogance, foolishness.

refs.text_gb: 不可奸淫。
refs.text_big5: 不可姦淫。
refs.text_en: You shall not commit adultery.

refs.text_gb: 你们听见有话说，“不可奸淫。”
refs.text_big5: 你們聽見有話說，“不可姦淫。”
refs.text_en: You have heard that it was said, "You shall not commit adultery."

refs.text_gb: 但是我告诉你们，凡看妇女，有意贪恋她的，心里已经与她犯奸淫了。
refs.text_big5: 但是我告訴你們，凡看婦女，有意貪戀她的，心裏已經與她犯姦淫了。
refs.text_en: But I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman in order to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

refs.text_gb: 你们岂不知，不义的不能承受神的国么？不要受迷惑，无论是淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、同性恋的、
refs.text_big5: 你們豈不知，不義的不能承受神的國麼？不要受迷惑，無論是淫亂的、拜偶像的、姦淫的、作孌童的、同性戀的、
refs.text_en: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be led astray; neither fornicators nor idolaters nor adulterers nor effeminate nor homosexuals

refs.text_gb: 不可贪爱邻舍的房屋；也不可贪爱邻舍的妻子、仆人、婢女、牛、驴、并他一切所有的。
refs.text_big5: 不可貪愛鄰舍的房屋；也不可貪愛鄰舍的妻子、僕人、婢女、牛、驢、並他一切所有的。
refs.text_en: You shall not covet your neighbor's house; you shall not covet your neighbor's wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that belongs to your neighbor.

refs.text_gb: 但如今我写给你们说，若有人称为弟兄，是行淫乱的、或贪婪的、或拜偶像的、或辱骂的、或醉酒的、或勒索的，这样的人不可与他交往，甚至与他一同吃饭都不可。
refs.text_big5: 但如今我寫給你們說，若有人稱為弟兄，是行淫亂的、或貪婪的、或拜偶像的、或辱罵的、或醉酒的、或勒索的，這樣的人不可與他交往，甚至與他一同喫飯都不可。
refs.text_en: But now I have written to you not to mingle with anyone who is called a brother, if he is a fornicator or a covetous man or an idolater or a reviler or a drunkard or a rapacious man, with such a one not even to eat.

refs.text_gb: 偷窃的、贪婪的、醉酒的、辱骂的、勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
refs.text_big5: 偷竊的、貪婪的、醉酒的、辱罵的、勒索的，都不能承受神的國。
refs.text_en: Nor thieves nor the covetous, not drunkards, not revilers, not the rapacious will inherit the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 但现在你们要脱去这一切的事，就是忿怒、恼恨、恶毒、毁谤，并你们口中所出可耻的秽语。
refs.text_big5: 但現在你們要脫去這一切的事，就是忿怒、惱恨、惡毒、毀謗，並你們口中所出可恥的穢語。
refs.text_en: But now, you also, put away all these things: wrath, anger, malice, blasphemy, foul abusive language out of your mouth.

verses.text_gb: 这一切的[Fn1]恶，都是从里面发出来，且能污秽人。
verses.text_big5: 這一切的[Fn1]惡，都是從裏面發出來，且能污穢人。
verses.text_en: All these wicked things proceed from within and defile the man.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这一切的恶，都是从里面发出来，且能污秽人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這一切的惡，都是從裏面發出來，且能污穢人。

footnotes.zh: 从里面发出的恶，乃是人堕落和有罪的性情所产生的恶果(21，罗七18)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從裏面發出的惡，乃是人墮落和有罪的性情所產生的惡果。（21，羅七18。）
footnotes.en: 7:23 1 wicked The wicked things that proceed from within are the evil issues of man's fallen and sinful nature (v. 21; Rom. 7:18).

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]耶稣从那里起身，[Cra]往[Crb]推罗、[Fn2]西顿的境内去。进了一[Crc]家，[Fn3]不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]耶穌從那裏起身，[Cra]往[Crb]推羅、[Fn2]西頓的境內去。進了一[Crc]家，[Fn3]不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
verses.text_en: And He rose up from there and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And entering into a house, He wanted no one to know about it; yet He could not escape notice.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣从那里起身，往推罗、西顿的境内去。进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌從那裏起身，往推羅、西頓的境內去。進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。

footnotes.en: 7:24 1 And For vv. 24-30, see notes in Matt. 15:21-28.

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷无，西顿。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷無，西頓。
footnotes.en: 7:24 2 and Some MSS omit, and Sidon.

footnotes.zh: 主总是不愿意显扬自己。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主總是不願意顯揚自己。
footnotes.en: 7:24 3 no The Lord never wanted publicity for Himself.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣离开那里，退到推罗、西顿的境内去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌離開那裏，退到推羅、西頓的境內去。
refs.text_en: And Jesus went from there and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，有一个迦南妇人从那地区出来，喊着说，主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我！我女儿被鬼附得很苦。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，有一個迦南婦人從那地區出來，喊著說，主阿，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得很苦。
refs.text_en: And behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried out, saying, Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David! My daughter suffers terribly from demon possession.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣却一言不答。门徒就进前来，求祂说，请打发她走吧，因为她在我们后面直喊。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒就進前來，求祂說，請打發她走罷，因為她在我們後面直喊。
refs.text_en: But He did not answer her a word. And His disciples came and implored Him, saying, Send her away, for she is crying out after us.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我奉差遣，不过是到以色列家迷失的羊那里去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我奉差遣，不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。
refs.text_en: But He answered and said, I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 那妇人来拜祂，说，主啊，帮助我！
refs.text_big5: 那婦人來拜祂，說，主阿，幫助我！
refs.text_en: But she came and worshipped Him, saying, Lord, help me!

refs.text_gb: 祂回答说，不好拿儿女的饼丢给小狗。
refs.text_big5: 祂回答說，不好拿兒女的餅丟給小狗。
refs.text_en: But He answered and said, It is not good to take the children's bread and throw it to the little dogs.

refs.text_gb: 妇人说，主啊，是的，就是小狗也吃主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣。
refs.text_big5: 婦人說，主阿，是的，就是小狗也喫主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣。
refs.text_en: And she said, Yes, Lord, for even the little dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣回答她说，妇人，你的信心真大！照你所愿的给你成全吧。从那时候，她的女儿就得了医治。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌回答她說，婦人，你的信心真大！照你所願的給你成全罷。從那時候，她的女兒就得了醫治。
refs.text_en: Then Jesus answered and said to her, O woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you as you wish. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又离开推罗的境界，经过西顿，来到低加波利境内的加利利海。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又離開推羅的境界，經過西頓，來到低加波利境內的加利利海。
refs.text_en: And again He came out of the borders of Tyre and came through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee in the midst of the borders of Decapolis.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣离开群众，进了屋子，门徒就将这比喻问祂。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌離開群眾，進了屋子，門徒就將這比喻問祂。
refs.text_en: And when He entered into a house from the crowd, His disciples questioned Him concerning the parable.

verses.text_gb: 有一个妇人，她的小女儿有[Cra]污灵附着，听见耶稣的事，[Crb]立即来俯伏在祂脚前。
verses.text_big5: 有一個婦人，她的小女兒有[Cra]污靈附著，聽見耶穌的事，[Crb]立即來俯伏在祂腳前。
verses.text_en: But a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit heard about Him, and immediately she came and fell at His feet.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有一个妇人，她的小女儿有污灵附着，听见耶稣的事，立即来俯伏在祂脚前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有一個婦人，她的小女兒有污靈附著，聽見耶穌的事，立即來俯伏在祂腳前。

refs.text_gb: 即时在他们的会堂里，有一个人被污灵附着，喊叫说，
refs.text_big5: 即時在他們的會堂裏，有一個人被污靈附著，喊叫說，
refs.text_en: And immediately, there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out, saying,

refs.text_gb: 一下船，众人立刻认出祂来，
refs.text_big5: 一下船，眾人立刻認出祂來，
refs.text_en: And when they came out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,

refs.text_gb: 他的耳朵立即开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。
refs.text_big5: 他的耳朵立即開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
refs.text_en: And immediately his ears were opened, and the bond on his tongue was released and he spoke clearly.

verses.text_gb: 这妇人是[Cra]希利尼人，属[Fn1]叙利腓尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼，离开她的女儿。
verses.text_big5: 這婦人是[Cra]希利尼人，屬[Fn1]敘利腓尼基族。她求耶穌趕出那鬼，離開她的女兒。
verses.text_en: Now the woman was a Greek, Syrophoenician by race. And she asked Him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这妇人是希利尼人，属叙利腓尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼，离开她的女儿。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這婦人是希利尼人，屬敘利腓尼基族。她求耶穌趕出那鬼，離開她的女兒。

footnotes.zh: 这妇人说叙利亚话，属腓尼基族(参徒二一2～3)，因腓尼基族是迦南人的后裔，所以她也是迦南妇人(太十五22)。很难查出是因宗教、婚姻或别的因素，使她成为希利尼人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這婦人說敘利亞話，屬腓尼基族，（參徒二一2～3，）因腓尼基族是迦南人的後裔，所以她也是迦南婦人。（太十五22。）很難查出是因宗教、婚姻或別的因素，使她成為希利尼人。
footnotes.en: 7:26 1 Syrophoenician Syrian by tongue, Phoenician by race (cf. Acts 21:2-3). Since the Phoenicians were descendants of the Canaanites, she was a Canaanite woman (Matt. 15:22). What made her a Greek — religion, marriage, or some other factor — is difficult to determine.

refs.text_gb: 那时，上来过节敬拜的人中，有几个希利尼人。
refs.text_big5: 那時，上來過節敬拜的人中，有幾個希利尼人。
refs.text_en: And there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

refs.text_gb: 因为我们不拘是犹太人或希利尼人，是为奴的或自主的，都已经在一位灵里受浸，成了一个身体，且都得以喝一位灵。
refs.text_big5: 因為我們不拘是猶太人或希利尼人，是為奴的或自主的，都已經在一位靈裏受浸，成了一個身體，且都得以喝一位靈。
refs.text_en: For also in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and were all given to drink one Spirit.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣对她说，让[Cra]儿女们[Crb]先吃饱，因为不好拿儿女的[Crc]饼丢给[Fn1]小[Crd]狗。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌對她說，讓[Cra]兒女們[Crb]先喫飽，因為不好拿兒女的[Crc]餅丟給[Fn1]小[Crd]狗。
verses.text_en: And He said to her, First let the children be satisfied, for it is not good to take the children's bread and throw it to the little dogs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣对她说，让儿女们先吃饱，因为不好拿儿女的饼丢给小狗。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌對她說，讓兒女們先喫飽，因為不好拿兒女的餅丟給小狗。

footnotes.zh: 指宠物狗，家犬。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指寵物狗，家犬。
footnotes.en: 7:27 1 little Pet dogs, house dogs.

refs.text_gb: 你要对法老说，耶和华这样说，以色列是我的儿子，我的长子。
refs.text_big5: 你要對法老說，耶和華這樣說，以色列是我的兒子，我的長子。
refs.text_en: Then you shall say to Pharaoh, Thus says Jehovah, Israel is My son, My firstborn.

refs.text_gb: 愚昧不智慧的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华么？祂岂不是你的父，将你买来的么？祂岂不是造你，建立你的么？
refs.text_big5: 愚昧不智慧的民哪，你們這樣報答耶和華麼？祂豈不是你的父，將你買來的麼？祂豈不是造你，建立你的麼？
refs.text_en: Do you repay Jehovah with this, / Foolish and unwise people? / Is He not your Father who bought you? / Was it not He who made you and established you?

refs.text_gb: 所以，大卫在全会众眼前颂赞耶和华，说，耶和华以色列的神，我们的父，你是当受颂赞的，从亘古直到永远。
refs.text_big5: 所以，大衛在全會眾眼前頌讚耶和華，說，耶和華以色列的神，我們的父，你是當受頌讚的，從亙古直到永遠。
refs.text_en: And David blessed Jehovah in the sight of all the assembly. And David said, You are blessed, O Jehovah, God of Israel, our father, from eternity to eternity.

refs.text_gb: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们，以色列也不承认我们，你却是我们的父。耶和华啊，你是我们的父；从亘古以来，你的名称为我们的救赎主。
refs.text_big5: 亞伯拉罕雖然不認識我們，以色列也不承認我們，你卻是我們的父。耶和華阿，你是我們的父；從亙古以來，你的名稱為我們的救贖主。
refs.text_en: For You are our Father, / Since Abraham does not know us, / And Israel does not acknowledge us. / You, Jehovah, are our Father; / Our Redeemer from eternity is Your name.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华啊，现在你仍是我们的父；我们是泥土，你是窑匠；我们都是你手的工作。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華阿，現在你仍是我們的父；我們是泥土，你是窯匠；我們都是你手的工作。
refs.text_en: But now, Jehovah, You are our Father; / We are the clay; and You, our Potter; / And all of us are the work of Your hand.

refs.text_gb: 神既兴起祂的仆人，就先差祂到你们这里来，祝福你们，叫你们各人回转，离开邪恶。
refs.text_big5: 神既興起祂的僕人，就先差祂到你們這裏來，祝福你們，叫你們各人回轉，離開邪惡。
refs.text_en: To you first, God, having raised up His Servant, has sent Him to bless you in turning each of you away from your wicked deeds.

refs.text_gb: 我不以福音为耻；这福音本是神的大能，要救一切信的人，先是犹太人，后是希利尼人。
refs.text_big5: 我不以福音為恥；這福音本是神的大能，要救一切信的人，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人。
refs.text_en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God unto salvation to everyone who believes, both to Jew first and to Greek.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，我就是生命的粮，到我这里来的，必永远不饿；信入我的，必永远不渴。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，我就是生命的糧，到我這裏來的，必永遠不餓；信入我的，必永遠不渴。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life; he who comes to Me shall by no means hunger, and he who believes into Me shall by no means ever thirst.

refs.text_gb: 我就是生命的粮。
refs.text_big5: 我就是生命的糧。
refs.text_en: I am the bread of life.

refs.text_gb: 不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，免得它们用脚践踏珍珠，并且转过来撕裂你们。
refs.text_big5: 不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，免得牠們用腳踐踏珍珠，並且轉過來撕裂你們。
refs.text_en: Do not give that which is holy to the dogs, neither cast your pearls before the hogs, lest they trample them with their feet, and turn and tear you.

verses.text_gb: 妇人回答祂说，主啊，是的，就是小狗在[Cra]桌子底下，也吃孩子们的碎渣。
verses.text_big5: 婦人回答祂說，主阿，是的，就是小狗在[Cra]桌子底下，也喫孩子們的碎渣。
verses.text_en: And she answered and said to Him, Yes, Lord, but even the little dogs under the table eat of the little children's crumbs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 妇人回答祂说，主啊，是的，就是小狗在桌子底下，也吃孩子们的碎渣。
verses.text_big5_plain: 婦人回答祂說，主阿，是的，就是小狗在桌子底下，也喫孩子們的碎渣。

refs.text_gb: 巴不得从财主桌子上掉下来的东西得饱足；不但如此，连狗也来舔他的疮。
refs.text_big5: 巴不得從財主桌子上掉下來的東西得飽足；不但如此，連狗也來舔他的瘡。
refs.text_en: And longing to be satisfied with the things falling from the rich man's table; moreover, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣对她说，因这句话，你[Cra]去吧，[Fn1]鬼已经离开你的女儿了。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌對她說，因這句話，你[Cra]去罷，[Fn1]鬼已經離開你的女兒了。
verses.text_en: And He said to her, Because of this word, go. The demon has gone out of your daughter.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣对她说，因这句话，你去吧，鬼已经离开你的女儿了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌對她說，因這句話，你去罷，鬼已經離開你的女兒了。

footnotes.zh_big5: 見一23註1。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，去吧，你的儿子活了。那人信耶稣对他所说的话，就去了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，去罷，你的兒子活了。那人信耶穌對他所說的話，就去了。
refs.text_en: Jesus said to him, Go, your son lives. The man believed the word which Jesus said to him and went his way.

verses.text_gb: 她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床榻上，鬼已经出去了。
verses.text_big5: 她就回家去，見小孩子躺在床榻上，鬼已經出去了。
verses.text_en: And she went away to her house and found the little child lying on the couch and the demon gone out.
verses.text_gb_plain: 她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床榻上，鬼已经出去了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 她就回家去，見小孩子躺在床榻上，鬼已經出去了。

verses.text_big5: 耶穌又[Cra]離開[Crb]推羅的境界，經過西頓，來到[Fn1][Crc]低加波利境內的[Fn2][Crd]加利利海。
verses.text_en: And again He came out of the borders of Tyre and came through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee in the midst of the borders of Decapolis.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣又离开推罗的境界，经过西顿，来到低加波利境内的加利利海。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌又離開推羅的境界，經過西頓，來到低加波利境內的加利利海。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣遂离开那里，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山，在那里坐下。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌遂離開那裏，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山，在那裏坐下。
refs.text_en: And Jesus departed from there and came beside the Sea of Galilee; and He went up to the mountain and sat there.

refs.text_gb: 好多群众到祂跟前来，带着瘸子、瞎子、残废的、哑巴和好些别种病人，都放在祂的脚前，祂就治好了他们，
refs.text_big5: 好多群眾到祂跟前來，帶著瘸子、瞎子、殘廢的、啞吧和好些別種病人，都放在祂的腳前，祂就治好了他們，
refs.text_en: And great crowds came to Him, having with them the lame, the blind, the crippled, the dumb, and many other sick ones; and they laid them at His feet, and He healed them,

refs.text_gb: 以致群众都希奇，因看见哑巴说话，残废的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见；他们就荣耀以色列的神。
refs.text_big5: 以致群眾都希奇，因看見啞吧說話，殘廢的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看見；他們就榮耀以色列的神。
refs.text_en: So that the crowd marveled, because they saw the dumb speaking, the crippled healthy and the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣从那里起身，往推罗、西顿的境内去。进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌從那裏起身，往推羅、西頓的境內去。進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
refs.text_en: And He rose up from there and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And entering into a house, He wanted no one to know about it; yet He could not escape notice.

refs.text_gb: 那人走了，就在低加波利，传扬耶稣为他作了何等大的事，众人就都希奇。
refs.text_big5: 那人走了，就在低加波利，傳揚耶穌為他作了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。
refs.text_en: And he departed and began to proclaim in Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him, and all marveled.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见两个兄弟，就是那称呼彼得的西门，和他的兄弟安得烈，向海里撒网；他们本是渔夫。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌在加利利海邊行走，看見兩個兄弟，就是那稱呼彼得的西門，和他的兄弟安得烈，向海裏撒網；他們本是漁夫。
refs.text_en: And while He was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

refs.text_gb: 这事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比哩亚海。
refs.text_big5: 這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。
refs.text_en: After these things Jesus went away across the Sea of Galilee, which is the Sea of Tiberias.

verses.text_gb: 有人带着一个[Fn1][Cra]耳聋[Crb]舌结的人，来就耶稣，求祂[Crc]按手在他身上。
verses.text_big5: 有人帶著一個[Fn1][Cra]耳聾[Crb]舌結的人，來就耶穌，求祂[Crc]按手在他身上。
verses.text_en: And they brought to Him one who was deaf and who spoke with difficulty, and they entreated Him to lay His hand on him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有人带着一个耳聋舌结的人，来就耶稣，求祂按手在他身上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有人帶著一個耳聾舌結的人，來就耶穌，求祂按手在他身上。

footnotes.zh: 象征人在属灵上又聋又哑，不能听见神的声音，不能赞美神(赛三五6)，也不能为神说话(赛五六10)。口哑是由于耳聋。奴仆救主医治的救恩，先是对付他的耳朵，而后抹他的舌头，这样足能治好这人的耳聋舌结。
footnotes.zh_big5: 象徵人在屬靈上又聾又啞，不能聽見神的聲音，不能讚美神，（賽三五6，）也不能為神說話。（賽五六10。）口啞是由於耳聾。奴僕救主醫治的救恩，先是對付他的耳朵，而後抹他的舌頭，這樣足能治好這人的耳聾舌結。
footnotes.en: 7:32 1 one Signifying one who is spiritually deaf and dumb, unable to hear the voice of God and to praise Him (Isa. 35:6) and speak for Him (Isa. 56:10). The dumbness of such a person is due to his deafness. The Slave-Savior's healing salvation is well able to heal the deafness and dumbness of such a one, first by dealing with his ears and then by touching his tongue.

refs.text_gb: 那时瞎子的眼必睁开，聋子的耳必开通。
refs.text_big5: 那時瞎子的眼必睜開，聾子的耳必開通。
refs.text_en: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, / And the ears of the deaf will be unstopped;

refs.text_gb: 那时瘸子必跳跃像鹿，哑巴的舌头必欢呼；在旷野必有水发出，在沙漠必有河涌流。
refs.text_big5: 那時瘸子必跳躍像鹿，啞吧的舌頭必歡呼；在曠野必有水發出，在沙漠必有河湧流。
refs.text_en: Then the lame will leap like a hart, / And the tongue of the dumb will give a ringing shout; / For water will break forth in the wilderness, / And streams in the desert.

refs.text_gb: 你要将有眼而瞎、有耳而聋的民都带出来。
refs.text_big5: 你要將有眼而瞎、有耳而聾的民都帶出來。
refs.text_en: Bring out the people who are blind yet have eyes, / And those who are deaf yet have ears.

refs.text_gb: 任凭万国聚集，任凭众民会合；其中谁能将这说明，并将先前的事说给我们听？他们可以带出见证人来，好得称为义，或者他们听见便说，这是真的。
refs.text_big5: 任憑萬國聚集，任憑眾民會合；其中誰能將這說明，並將先前的事說給我們聽？他們可以帶出見證人來，好得稱為義，或者他們聽見便說，這是真的。
refs.text_en: Let all the nations be gathered together, / And let the peoples assemble. / Who among them can declare this / And relate to us the former things? / Let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified, / And let them hear and say, It is true.

refs.text_gb: 他们出去的时候，看哪，有人将一个被鬼附的哑巴，带到耶稣跟前来。
refs.text_big5: 他們出去的時候，看哪，有人將一個被鬼附的啞吧，帶到耶穌跟前來。
refs.text_en: And as they were going out, behold, they brought to Him a dumb man possessed with a demon.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣赶出一个哑巴鬼，鬼出去了，哑巴就说出话来，群众都希奇。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌趕出一個啞吧鬼，鬼出去了，啞吧就說出話來，群眾都希奇。
refs.text_en: And once He was casting out a demon, and it was dumb. And when the demon had gone out, the dumb man spoke, and the crowds marveled.

refs.text_gb: 再三地求祂说，我的小女儿快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她得拯救，可以活着。
refs.text_big5: 再三的求祂說，我的小女兒快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她得拯救，可以活著。
refs.text_en: And he entreated Him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay Your hands on her that she may be healed and live.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣暗暗地领他离开群众，到一边去，就用指头[Fn1]探入他的耳朵，[Cra]吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
verses.text_big5: 耶穌暗暗的領他離開群眾，到一邊去，就用指頭[Fn1]探入他的耳朵，[Cra]吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，
verses.text_en: And He took him aside from the crowd privately and put His fingers into his ears, and He spat and touched his tongue.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣暗暗地领他离开群众，到一边去，就用指头探入他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌暗暗的領他離開群眾，到一邊去，就用指頭探入他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，

footnotes.zh: 或，插入。奴仆救主将指头探入聋子的耳朵，表征对付他听话的器官(参赛五十4～5，伯三三14～16)；用唾沫抹他的舌头，表征用祂口里出来的话，涂抹哑吧说话的器官。这就是祂的医治(见一31注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，插入。奴僕救主將指頭探入聾子的耳朵，表徵對付他聽話的器官；（參賽五十4～5，伯三三14～16；）用唾沫抹他的舌頭，表徵用祂口裏出來的話，塗抹啞吧說話的器官。這就是祂的醫治。（見一31註1。）
footnotes.en: 7:33 1 put Or, thrust. The Slave-Savior's thrusting of His fingers into the deaf one's ears signifies His dealing with his hearing organ (cf. Isa. 50:4-5; Job 33:14-16), and His touching of his tongue with His spittle signifies His anointing of the dumb one's speaking organ with the word that proceeds out of His mouth. This was a healing (see note Mark 1:31 1 ).

refs.text_gb: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说，你看见什么没有？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌拉著瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說，你看見甚麼沒有？
refs.text_en: And He took hold of the hand of the blind man and led him forth outside the village. And He spat on his eyes and laid His hands on him and asked him, Do you see anything?

refs.text_gb: 祂说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥，抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
refs.text_big5: 祂說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥，抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
refs.text_en: When He had said this, He spat on the ground and made clay of the spittle and anointed his eyes with the clay,

verses.text_gb: [Cra]望天[Crb]叹息，对他说，[Fn1]以法大！就是，开了吧！
verses.text_big5: [Cra]望天[Crb]歎息，對他說，[Fn1]以法大！就是，開了罷！
verses.text_en: And looking up to heaven, He groaned and said to him, Ephphatha! that is, Be opened!
verses.text_gb_plain: 望天叹息，对他说，以法大！就是，开了吧！
verses.text_big5_plain: 望天歎息，對他說，以法大！就是，開了罷！

footnotes.zh: 亚兰文。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞蘭文。
footnotes.en: 7:34 1 Ephphatha Aramaic.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣拿着五个饼两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌拿著五個餅兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
refs.text_en: And He took the five loaves and the two fish and, looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples to set before them; and the two fish He divided among all.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣灵里深深地叹息说，这世代为什么寻求神迹？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌靈裏深深的歎息說，這世代為甚麼尋求神蹟？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代了。
refs.text_en: And He groaned deeply in His spirit and said, Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly I tell you, No sign shall be given to this generation.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣看见她哭，并看见与她同来的犹太人也哭，就灵里悲愤，又受搅扰，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌看見她哭，並看見與她同來的猶太人也哭，就靈裏悲憤，又受攪擾，
refs.text_en: Then Jesus, when He saw her weeping and the Jews who came with her weeping, was moved with indignation in His spirit and was troubled,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又灵里悲愤，来到坟墓前；那坟墓是个洞，有一块石头挡着。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又靈裏悲憤，來到墳墓前；那墳墓是個洞，有一塊石頭擋著。
refs.text_en: Jesus therefore, moved with indignation again in Himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.

verses.text_gb: 他的耳朵[Cra]立即开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。
verses.text_big5: 他的耳朵[Cra]立即開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
verses.text_en: And immediately his ears were opened, and the bond on his tongue was released and he spoke clearly.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他的耳朵立即开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他的耳朵立即開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。

refs.text_gb: 有一个妇人，她的小女儿有污灵附着，听见耶稣的事，立即来俯伏在祂脚前。
refs.text_big5: 有一個婦人，她的小女兒有污靈附著，聽見耶穌的事，立即來俯伏在祂腳前。
refs.text_en: But a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit heard about Him, and immediately she came and fell at His feet.

refs.text_gb: 立即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。
refs.text_big5: 立即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。
refs.text_en: And immediately He got into the boat with His disciples and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣嘱咐他们，[Fn1][Cra]不要告诉人。但祂越发嘱咐他们，他们越发大大地[Crb]传扬开了。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌囑咐他們，[Fn1][Cra]不要告訴人。但祂越發囑咐他們，他們越發大大的[Crb]傳揚開了。
verses.text_en: And He charged them not to tell anyone. But the more He charged them, so much the more they proclaimed it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣嘱咐他们，不要告诉人。但祂越发嘱咐他们，他们越发大大地传扬开了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌囑咐他們，不要告訴人。但祂越發囑咐他們，他們越發大大的傳揚開了。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌再三的囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西喫。
refs.text_en: And He strongly commanded them that no one should know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

refs.text_gb: 他们下山的时候，耶稣嘱咐他们说，除非人子从死人中复活，你们不要将所看见的对人述说。
refs.text_big5: 他們下山的時候，耶穌囑咐他們說，除非人子從死人中復活，你們不要將所看見的對人述說。
refs.text_en: And as they were coming down from the mountain, He ordered them not to relate to anyone the things which they had seen, except when the Son of Man has risen from the dead.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，你要当心，不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，并且献上摩西所规定的礼物，对他们作证据。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，你要當心，不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，並且獻上摩西所規定的禮物，對他們作證據。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to him, See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

refs.text_gb: 但那人出去，广事宣扬，把这事传开了，以致耶稣不能再明明地进城，只好在外面旷野地方，人从各处都就了祂来。
refs.text_big5: 但那人出去，廣事宣揚，把這事傳開了，以致耶穌不能再明明的進城，只好在外面曠野地方，人從各處都就了祂來。
refs.text_en: But he went out and began to proclaim it much and to spread the matter abroad, so that He could no longer enter openly into a city, but He stayed outside in deserted places. And they came to Him from everywhere.

verses.text_gb: 众人分外[Cra]惊讶，说，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聋的听见，又叫哑的说话。
verses.text_big5: 眾人分外[Cra]驚訝，說，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聾的聽見，又叫啞的說話。
verses.text_en: And they were utterly astounded, saying, He has done all things well; He makes both the deaf hear and the dumb speak.
verses.text_gb_plain: 众人分外惊讶，说，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聋的听见，又叫哑的说话。
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾人分外驚訝，說，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聾的聽見，又叫啞的說話。

refs.text_gb: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就止住了。他们心里极其惊奇，
refs.text_big5: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就止住了。他們心裏極其驚奇，
refs.text_en: And He went up unto them into the boat, and the wind ceased. And they were greatly astonished in themselves beyond measure,

refs.text_gb: 他们就分外惊讶，彼此说，这样谁能得救？
refs.text_big5: 他們就分外驚訝，彼此說，這樣誰能得救？
refs.text_en: But they were astonished beyond measure and said among themselves, Then who can be saved?

verses.text_en: In those days, since there was again a great crowd and they did not have anything to eat, He called the disciples to Him and said to them,

verses.text_big5_plain: 那些日子，又有大批的群眾，他們沒有甚麼喫的；耶穌叫門徒來，對他們說，

refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫祂的門徒來，說，我對這群眾動了慈心，因為他們同我在一起已經三天，也沒有甚麼喫的了。我不願意叫他們餓著散去，恐怕他們在路上困乏。
refs.text_en: And Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, I am moved with compassion for the crowd, because for three days now they have remained with Me and they do not have anything to eat. And I am not willing to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way.

refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, How many loaves do you have? And they said, Seven, and a few small fish.

refs.text_en: And after He commanded the crowd to recline on the ground,

refs.text_big5: 拿著這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給群眾。
refs.text_en: He took the seven loaves and the fish, and giving thanks, He broke them and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds.

refs.text_gb: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了。他们拾起剩下的零碎，装满了七筐子。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都喫，並且喫飽了。他們拾起剩下的零碎，裝滿了七筐子。
refs.text_en: And they all ate and were satisfied. And they took up what was left over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.

refs.text_gb: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，共有四千。
refs.text_big5: 喫的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。
refs.text_en: And those who ate were four thousand men, apart from women and children.

refs.text_gb: 祂既解散了群众，就上船，来到马加丹的境界。
refs.text_big5: 祂既解散了群眾，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
refs.text_en: And after He sent the crowds away, He stepped into the boat and came to the borders of Magadan.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣出来，看见大批的群众，就对他们动了慈心，因为他们如同羊没有牧人一样；祂就开始教训他们许多事。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌出來，看見大批的群眾，就對他們動了慈心，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一樣；祂就開始教訓他們許多事。
refs.text_en: And getting out, He saw a great crowd, and He was moved with compassion for them because they were like sheep not having a shepherd, and He began to teach them many things.

refs.text_gb: 时候已经晚了，门徒到祂跟前来，说，这是野地，时候也晚了，
refs.text_big5: 時候已經晚了，門徒到祂跟前來，說，這是野地，時候也晚了，
refs.text_en: And when the hour had already become late, His disciples came to Him and said, This place is deserted, and the hour is already late;

refs.text_gb: 请解散群众，他们好往周围田舍村庄里去，为自己买吃的。
refs.text_big5: 請解散群眾，他們好往周圍田舍村莊裏去，為自己買喫的。
refs.text_en: Send them away so that they may go into the surrounding countryside and villages and buy for themselves something to eat.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，你们给他们吃吧。他们说，要我们去买二百银币的饼，给他们吃么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，你們給他們喫罷。他們說，要我們去買二百銀幣的餅，給他們喫麼？
refs.text_en: But He answered and said to them, You give them something to eat. And they said to Him, Shall we go away and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give it to them to eat?

refs.text_gb: 祂说，你们有多少饼？去看看。他们知道了，就说，五个，还有两条鱼。
refs.text_big5: 祂說，你們有多少餅？去看看。他們知道了，就說，五個，還有兩條魚。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, How many loaves do you have? Go and see. And when they found out, they said, Five, and two fish.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣吩咐他们叫众人一组一组的，坐在青草地上。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌吩咐他們叫眾人一組一組的，坐在青草地上。
refs.text_en: And He ordered them to have all recline by companies on the green grass.

refs.text_gb: 众人就一班一班地坐下，有一百一班的，有五十一班的。
refs.text_big5: 眾人就一班一班的坐下，有一百一班的，有五十一班的。
refs.text_en: And they sat down in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣拿着五个饼两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌拿著五個餅兩條魚，望著天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
refs.text_en: And He took the five loaves and the two fish and, looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples to set before them; and the two fish He divided among all.

refs.text_gb: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都喫，並且喫飽了。
refs.text_en: And they all ate and were satisfied.

refs.text_gb: 门徒就拾起零碎，装满了十二篮子，还有鱼的零碎。
refs.text_big5: 門徒就拾起零碎，裝滿了十二籃子，還有魚的零碎。
refs.text_en: And they took up twelve full handbaskets of the broken pieces of bread and of the fish.

refs.text_gb: 吃饼的男人，共有五千。
refs.text_big5: 喫餅的男人，共有五千。
refs.text_en: And those who had eaten the loaves were five thousand men.

verses.text_gb: 我对这群众[Fn1]动了慈心，因为他们同我在一起已经三天，也没有什么吃的了。
verses.text_big5: 我對這群眾[Fn1]動了慈心，因為他們同我在一起已經三天，也沒有甚麼喫的了。
verses.text_en: I am moved with compassion for the crowd, because for three days now they have remained with Me and they do not have anything to eat.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我对这群众动了慈心，因为他们同我在一起已经三天，也没有什么吃的了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我對這群眾動了慈心，因為他們同我在一起已經三天，也沒有甚麼喫的了。

footnotes.zh: 在这里，奴仆救主慈怜、同情和亲切顾人的美德，生动且甜美地显示在祂的人性里。
footnotes.en: 8:2 1 moved; remained; not The Slave-Savior's virtues of compassion, sympathy, and tender care were vividly and sweetly displayed here in His humanity.

verses.text_gb: 我若解散他们饿着回家，他们必在路上[Fn1]困乏，况且其中有些是从远处来的。
verses.text_big5: 我若解散他們餓著回家，他們必在路上[Fn1]困乏，況且其中有些是從遠處來的。
verses.text_en: And if I send them away to their home hungry, they will faint on the way; and some of them have come from a distance.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我若解散他们饿着回家，他们必在路上困乏，况且其中有些是从远处来的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我若解散他們餓著回家，他們必在路上困乏，況且其中有些是從遠處來的。

footnotes.zh: 见2注1。
footnotes.en: 8:3 1 faint; come See note Mark 8:2 1 .

verses.text_gb: 门徒回答祂说，在这旷野，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱？
verses.text_big5: 門徒回答祂說，在這曠野，從那裏能得餅，叫這些人喫飽？
verses.text_en: And His disciples answered Him, Where will anyone be able to get enough to satisfy these people with bread here in this desolate place?
verses.text_gb_plain: 门徒回答祂说，在这旷野，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱？
verses.text_big5_plain: 門徒回答祂說，在這曠野，從那裏能得餅，叫這些人喫飽？

verses.text_gb: 耶稣问他们说，你们有多少饼？他们说，七个。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌問他們說，你們有多少餅？他們說，七個。
verses.text_en: And He asked them, How many loaves do you have? And they said, Seven.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣问他们说，你们有多少饼？他们说，七个。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌問他們說，你們有多少餅？他們說，七個。

verses.text_gb: 祂吩咐群众坐在地上，就拿着七个饼，[Cra]祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，他们就摆在群众面前。
verses.text_big5: 祂吩咐群眾坐在地上，就拿著七個餅，[Cra]祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，他們就擺在群眾面前。
verses.text_en: And He charged the crowd to recline on the ground. And taking the seven loaves, He gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before them, and they set them before the crowd.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂吩咐群众坐在地上，就拿着七个饼，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，他们就摆在群众面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂吩咐群眾坐在地上，就拿著七個餅，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，他們就擺在群眾面前。

refs.text_gb: 又拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给他们，说，这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们要如此行，为的是记念我。
refs.text_big5: 又拿起餅來，祝謝了，就擘開，遞給他們，說，這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們要如此行，為的是記念我。
refs.text_en: And He took a loaf and gave thanks, and He broke it and gave it to them, saying, This is My body which is being given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人，分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐著的人，分魚也是這樣，都隨著他們所要的。
refs.text_en: Jesus then took the loaves, and when He had given thanks, He distributed to those who were reclining; likewise also of the fish, as much as they wanted.

refs.text_gb: 保罗说了这话，就拿着饼，在众人面前感谢了神，然后擘开来吃。
refs.text_big5: 保羅說了這話，就拿著餅，在眾人面前感謝了神，然後擘開來喫。
refs.text_en: And when he had said these things and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God before all; and he broke it and began to eat.

verses.text_gb: 他们还有几条小鱼，耶稣祝福了，就吩咐这些也要摆开。
verses.text_big5: 他們還有幾條小魚，耶穌祝福了，就吩咐這些也要擺開。
verses.text_en: And they had a few small fish, and having blessed them, He said that these also should be set before them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们还有几条小鱼，耶稣祝福了，就吩咐这些也要摆开。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們還有幾條小魚，耶穌祝福了，就吩咐這些也要擺開。

verses.text_gb: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，拾起[Cra]剩下的零碎，有[Fn1]七筐子。
verses.text_big5: 眾人都喫，並且喫飽了，拾起[Cra]剩下的零碎，有[Fn1]七筐子。
verses.text_en: And they ate and were satisfied. And they took up the surplus of broken pieces, seven baskets.
verses.text_gb_plain: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，拾起剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾人都喫，並且喫飽了，拾起剩下的零碎，有七筐子。

footnotes.zh: 见六43注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見六43註1。
footnotes.en: 8:8 1 seven See note Mark 6:43 1 .

refs.text_gb: 他的仆人说，我怎能把这一点摆在一百人面前呢？以利沙说，你只管给众人吃吧；因为耶和华如此说，众人必吃了，还剩下。
refs.text_big5: 他的僕人說，我怎能把這一點擺在一百人面前呢？以利沙說，你只管給眾人喫罷；因為耶和華如此說，眾人必喫了，還剩下。
refs.text_en: And his servant said, How can I set this before a hundred people? And he said, Give it to the people that they may eat; for thus says Jehovah, They shall eat and have some left.

refs.text_gb: 仆人就摆在众人面前，他们吃了，果然还剩下，正如耶和华所说的。
refs.text_big5: 僕人就擺在眾人面前，他們喫了，果然還剩下，正如耶和華所說的。
refs.text_en: So he set it before them; and they ate, and there was some left, according to the word of Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]人数约有四千。耶稣解散了他们，
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]人數約有四千。耶穌解散了他們，
verses.text_en: And there were about four thousand people. And He sent them away.
verses.text_gb_plain: 人数约有四千。耶稣解散了他们，
verses.text_big5_plain: 人數約有四千。耶穌解散了他們，

footnotes.zh: 人数，直译，他们。有些古卷作，他们已经吃过的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 人數，直譯，他們。有些古卷作，他們已經喫過的。
footnotes.en: 8:9 1 there Some MSS read, those who had eaten.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]立即同门徒上船，来到[Fn1]大玛努他境内。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]立即同門徒上船，來到[Fn1]大瑪努他境內。
verses.text_en: And immediately He got into the boat with His disciples and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.text_gb_plain: 立即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。
verses.text_big5_plain: 立即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。

footnotes.zh: 也许是马加丹境内的一个村庄(太十五39)，可能位于加利利海以西。
footnotes.zh_big5: 也許是馬加丹境內的一個村莊，（太十五39，）可能位於加利利海以西。
footnotes.en: 8:10 1 Dalmanutha Dalmanutha was probably a village in the districts of Magadan (Matt. 15:39). It was likely a place west of the Sea of Galilee.

refs.text_gb: 他的耳朵立即开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。
refs.text_big5: 他的耳朵立即開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
refs.text_en: And immediately his ears were opened, and the bond on his tongue was released and he spoke clearly.

refs.text_gb: 群众一看见耶稣，都甚吃惊，就跑上去问祂的安。
refs.text_big5: 群眾一看見耶穌，都甚喫驚，就跑上去問祂的安。
refs.text_en: And immediately, when all the crowd saw Him, they were amazed, and they ran to Him and greeted Him.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1][Fn2][Cra]法利赛人出来，同耶稣辩论，向祂寻求一个从天上来的[Fn3][Crb]神迹，想要[Crc]试诱祂。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1][Fn2][Cra]法利賽人出來，同耶穌辯論，向祂尋求一個從天上來的[Fn3][Crb]神蹟，想要[Crc]試誘祂。
verses.text_en: And the Pharisees came out and began to dispute with Him, seeking from Him a sign from heaven and tempting Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 法利赛人出来，同耶稣辩论，向祂寻求一个从天上来的神迹，想要试诱祂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 法利賽人出來，同耶穌辯論，向祂尋求一個從天上來的神蹟，想要試誘祂。

footnotes.en: 8:11 1 And For vv. 11-21, see notes in Matt. 16:1-12.

footnotes.zh: 见二6注1。后文同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二6註1。後文同。
footnotes.en: 8:11 2 Pharisees See note Mark 2:6 1 . So in v. 15.

footnotes.zh: 直译，表号，兆头。指带着属灵意义的神迹。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，表號，兆頭。指帶著屬靈意義的神蹟。
footnotes.en: 8:11 3 sign A sign is a miracle that has some spiritual significance.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人和撒都该人进前来，试诱耶稣，求祂从天上显个神迹给他们看。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人和撒都該人進前來，試誘耶穌，求祂從天上顯個神蹟給他們看。
refs.text_en: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing Him asked Him to show them a sign out of heaven.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就回答他们说，黄昏到了，你们说，天要晴，因为天发红；
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就回答他們說，黃昏到了，你們說，天要晴，因為天發紅；
refs.text_en: But He answered and said to them, When evening falls, you say, There will be fair weather, for the sky is red;

refs.text_gb: 在早晨，你们说，今天要有风雨，因为天发红，变阴暗。你们知道分辨天色，倒不能分辨这时期的神迹。
refs.text_big5: 在早晨，你們說，今天要有風雨，因為天發紅，變陰暗。你們知道分辨天色，倒不能分辨這時期的神蹟。
refs.text_en: And in the morning, It will be stormy today, for the sky is red and gloomy. The face of the sky you know how to discern, but you cannot discern the signs of the times.

refs.text_gb: 邪恶淫乱的世代寻求神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给它。耶稣就撇开他们走了。
refs.text_big5: 邪惡淫亂的世代尋求神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給它。耶穌就撇開他們走了。
refs.text_en: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah. And He left them and went away.

refs.text_gb: 门徒来到对岸，忘了带饼。
refs.text_big5: 門徒來到對岸，忘了帶餅。
refs.text_en: And when the disciples came to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，你们要当心，提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，你們要當心，提防法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, Watch and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

refs.text_gb: 门徒就彼此议论说，这是因为我们没有带饼吧。
refs.text_big5: 門徒就彼此議論說，這是因為我們沒有帶餅罷。
refs.text_en: But they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we did not take bread.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣知道了，就说，小信的人哪，为什么因为没有饼就彼此议论？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌知道了，就說，小信的人哪，為甚麼因為沒有餅就彼此議論？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, knowing it, said, Why are you reasoning among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have no bread?

refs.text_gb: 你们还不明白么？不记得那分给五千人的五个饼，和你们拾取了多少篮子？
refs.text_big5: 你們還不明白麼？不記得那分給五千人的五個餅，和你們拾取了多少籃子？
refs.text_en: Do you not yet understand nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand and how many handbaskets you took up?

refs.text_gb: 也不记得那分给四千人的七个饼，和你们拾取了多少筐子？
refs.text_big5: 也不記得那分給四千人的七個餅，和你們拾取了多少筐子？
refs.text_en: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand and how many baskets you took up?

refs.text_gb: 你们怎么不明白？我对你们所说的，不是指着饼，乃是指着要提防法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。
refs.text_big5: 你們怎麼不明白？我對你們所說的，不是指著餅，乃是指著要提防法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。
refs.text_en: How is it that you do not understand that it was not about bread that I spoke to you? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

refs.text_gb: 门徒这才领悟祂所说的，不是叫他们提防饼的酵，乃是叫他们提防法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。
refs.text_big5: 門徒這纔領悟祂所說的，不是叫他們提防餅的酵，乃是叫他們提防法利賽人和撒都該人的教訓。
refs.text_en: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
