refs.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，你们若不回转，变成像小孩子一样，绝不能进诸天的国。
refs.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成像小孩子一樣，絕不能進諸天的國。
refs.text_en: And said, Truly I say to you, Unless you turn and become like little children, you shall by no means enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，在领悟上不要作小孩子，但在恶事上要作婴孩，在领悟上却要成熟。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，在領悟上不要作小孩子，但在惡事上要作嬰孩，在領悟上卻要成熟。
refs.text_en: Brothers, do not be children in your understanding, but in malice be babes and in your understanding be full-grown.

refs.text_gb: 像才生的婴孩一样，切慕那纯净的话奶，叫你们靠此长大，以致得救；
refs.text_big5: 像纔生的嬰孩一樣，切慕那純淨的話奶，叫你們靠此長大，以致得救；
refs.text_en: As newborn babes, long for the guileless milk of the word in order that by it you may grow unto salvation,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我實實在在的告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見神的國。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered and said to him, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless one is born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和灵生的，就不能进神的国。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，我實實在在的告訴你，人若不是從水和靈生的，就不能進神的國。
refs.text_en: Jesus answered, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.text_gb: 于是[Cra]抱着小孩子，给他们[Crb]按手，为他们热切地祝福。
verses.text_big5: 於是[Cra]抱著小孩子，給他們[Crb]按手，為他們熱切的祝福。
verses.text_en: And taking them into His arms, He fervently blessed them, laying His hands on them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是抱着小孩子，给他们按手，为他们热切地祝福。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是抱著小孩子，給他們按手，為他們熱切的祝福。

refs.text_big5: 於是領過一個小孩子來，叫他站在他們中間，又抱起他來，對他們說，
refs.text_en: And He took a little child and set him in their midst; and taking him into His arms, He said to them,

refs.text_gb: 再三地求祂说，我的小女儿快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她得拯救，可以活着。
refs.text_big5: 再三的求祂說，我的小女兒快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她得拯救，可以活著。

refs.text_big5: 耶穌看著他們說，在人是不能的，在神卻不然，因為在神凡事都能。
refs.text_en: Looking upon them, Jesus said, With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.

refs.text_gb: 于是领他到耶稣那里。耶稣看着他说，你是约翰的儿子西门，你要称为矶法。（矶法翻出来，就是彼得。）
refs.text_big5: 於是領他到耶穌那裏。耶穌看著他說，你是約翰的兒子西門，你要稱為磯法。（磯法繙出來，就是彼得。）
refs.text_en: He led him to Jesus. Looking at him, Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; you shall be called Cephas (which is interpreted, Peter).

refs.text_gb: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得便想起主对他所说的话：今日鸡叫以前，你要三次否认我。
refs.text_big5: 主轉過身來看彼得，彼得便想起主對他所說的話：今日雞叫以前，你要三次否認我。
refs.text_en: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter, and Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, Before a rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣素来爱马大，和她妹妹，并拉撒路。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌素來愛馬大，和她妹妹，並拉撒路。
refs.text_en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

refs.text_gb: 有一个门徒，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣的怀里。
refs.text_big5: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裏。
refs.text_en: One of His disciples, whom Jesus loved, was reclining on Jesus' bosom.

refs.text_gb: 并且卖了田产家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。
refs.text_big5: 並且賣了田產家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。
refs.text_en: And they sold their properties and possessions and divided them to all, as anyone had need.

refs.text_gb: 他们中间没有一个缺乏的，因为凡有田产房屋的都卖了，把所卖的价银拿来，放在使徒脚前，
refs.text_big5: 他們中間沒有一個缺乏的，因為凡有田產房屋的都賣了，把所賣的價銀拿來，放在使徒腳前，
refs.text_en: For neither was anyone among them in need; for as many as were owners of lands or of houses sold them and brought the proceeds of the things which were sold

refs.text_gb: 只要为自己积蓄财宝在天上，天上没有虫蛀、锈蚀，也没有贼挖洞偷窃。
refs.text_big5: 只要為自己積蓄財寶在天上，天上沒有蟲蛀、銹蝕，也沒有賊挖洞偷竊。
refs.text_en: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes and where thieves do not dig through nor steal.

refs.text_gb: 要变卖你们的家业，施舍给人；为自己预备永不旧的钱袋，用不尽的财宝在诸天之上，就是贼不能近，虫不能蛀的地方。
refs.text_big5: 要變賣你們的家業，施捨給人；為自己豫備永不舊的錢袋，用不盡的財寶在諸天之上，就是賊不能近，蟲不能蛀的地方。
refs.text_en: Sell your possessions and give alms; make for yourselves purses which do not become old, an unfailing treasure in the heavens, where thief does not come near nor even moth corrupts;

refs.text_gb: 彼得就对祂说，看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从了你。
refs.text_big5: 彼得就對祂說，看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從了你。
refs.text_en: Peter began to say to Him, Behold, we have left all and followed You.

refs.text_gb: 他们就立刻撇下网，跟从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 他們就立刻撇下網，跟從了祂。
refs.text_en: And immediately leaving the nets, they followed Him.

verses.text_gb: 他因着这话，就面显愁容，忧忧郁郁地走了，因为他[Cra]有很多产业。
verses.text_big5: 他因著這話，就面顯愁容，憂憂鬱鬱的走了，因為他[Cra]有很多產業。
verses.text_en: And at the word his countenance fell, and he went away sorrowing, for he had many possessions.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他因着这话，就面显愁容，忧忧郁郁地走了，因为他有很多产业。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他因著這話，就面顯愁容，憂憂鬱鬱的走了，因為他有很多產業。

refs.text_gb: 他们来到你这里如同民来聚会，坐在你面前仿佛是我的民，他们听你的话却不去行；因为他们用口多显爱情，他们的心却追随财利。
refs.text_big5: 他們來到你這裏如同民來聚會，坐在你面前彷彿是我的民，他們聽你的話卻不去行；因為他們用口多顯愛情，他們的心卻追隨財利。
refs.text_en: And they come to you just as people come, and they sit before you as My people, and they hear your words but do not do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣[Cra]周围一看，对门徒说，有[Crb]钱财的人要进[Crc]神的国，是何等的难！
verses.text_big5: 耶穌[Cra]周圍一看，對門徒說，有[Crb]錢財的人要進[Crc]神的國，是何等的難！
verses.text_en: And Jesus, looking around, said to His disciples, How difficult it will be for those who have riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说，有钱财的人要进神的国，是何等的难！
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說，有錢財的人要進神的國，是何等的難！

refs.text_gb: 耶稣怒目环视他们，因他们的心刚硬而甚忧愁，就对那人说，伸出手来。他一伸，手就复了原。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌怒目環視他們，因他們的心剛硬而甚憂愁，就對那人說，伸出手來。他一伸，手就復了原。
refs.text_en: And looking around at them with anger and being greatly grieved with the hardness of their heart, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.

refs.text_gb: 后来有今世的思虑、钱财的迷惑、以及其他的贪欲，进来把道全然挤住了，道就不能结实。
refs.text_big5: 後來有今世的思慮、錢財的迷惑、以及其他的貪慾，進來把道全然擠住了，道就不能結實。
refs.text_en: And the anxieties of the age and the deceitfulness of riches and the lusts for other things enter in and utterly choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 但那些想要发财的人，就陷在试诱、网罗、和许多无知有害的私欲里，叫人沉溺在败坏和灭亡中。
refs.text_big5: 但那些想要發財的人，就陷在試誘、網羅、和許多無知有害的私慾裏，叫人沉溺在敗壞和滅亡中。
refs.text_en: But those who intend to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and many foolish and harmful desires, which plunge men into destruction and ruin.

refs.text_gb: 因为贪财是万恶之根，有人贪恋钱财，就受迷惑，离弃了信仰，用许多苦痛把自己刺透了。
refs.text_big5: 因為貪財是萬惡之根，有人貪戀錢財，就受迷惑，離棄了信仰，用許多苦痛把自己刺透了。
refs.text_en: For the love of money is a root of all evils, because of which some, aspiring after money, have been led away from the faith and pierced themselves through with many pains.

refs.text_gb: 你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要心思高傲，也不要寄望于无定的钱财，只要寄望于那将百物丰富的供给我们享受的神；
refs.text_big5: 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人，不要心思高傲，也不要寄望於無定的錢財，只要寄望於那將百物豐富的供給我們享受的神；
refs.text_en: Charge those who are rich in the present age not to be high-minded, nor to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches but on God, who affords us all things richly for our enjoyment;

refs.text_gb: 我若以金子为指望，对精金说，你是我的倚靠；
refs.text_big5: 我若以金子為指望，對精金說，你是我的倚靠；
refs.text_en: If I have made gold my hope, / And have called fine gold my confidence;

refs.text_gb: 我若因财物丰裕，因我手所得的甚多而欢喜；
refs.text_big5: 我若因財物豐裕，因我手所得的甚多而歡喜；
refs.text_en: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great / And because my hand had acquired much;

refs.text_gb: 若是你一只眼绊跌你，就去掉它；你只有一只眼进入神的国，比有两只眼被扔在火坑里更好。
refs.text_big5: 若是你一隻眼絆跌你，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入神的國，比有兩隻眼被扔在火坑裏更好。
refs.text_en: And if your eye stumbles you, cast it out; it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into Gehenna,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣看见就恼怒，对门徒说，让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为神的国正是这等人的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌看見就惱怒，對門徒說，讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們，因為神的國正是這等人的。
refs.text_en: But Jesus, seeing it, was indignant and said to them, Allow the little children to come to Me. Do not forbid them, for of such is the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，凡不像小孩子一样接受神国的，绝不能进去。
refs.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，凡不像小孩子一樣接受神國的，絕不能進去。
refs.text_en: Truly I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child shall by no means enter into it.

refs.text_gb: 偷窃的、贪婪的、醉酒的、辱骂的、勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
refs.text_big5: 偷竊的、貪婪的、醉酒的、辱罵的、勒索的，都不能承受神的國。
refs.text_en: Nor thieves nor the covetous, not drunkards, not revilers, not the rapacious will inherit the kingdom of God.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们晓得这事，知道凡是淫乱的，或是污秽的，或是贪婪的，（就是拜偶像的，）在基督和神的国里，都得不到基业。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們曉得這事，知道凡是淫亂的，或是污穢的，或是貪婪的，（就是拜偶像的，）在基督和神的國裏，都得不到基業。
refs.text_en: For this you realize, knowing that every fornicator or unclean person or greedy person (who is an idolator) has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

verses.text_gb: 门徒就[Cra]希奇祂的话。耶稣又对他们说，[Crb]孩子们，[Fn1]倚靠钱财的人[Crc]进神的国，是何等的难！
verses.text_big5: 門徒就[Cra]希奇祂的話。耶穌又對他們說，[Crb]孩子們，[Fn1]倚靠錢財的人[Crc]進神的國，是何等的難！
verses.text_en: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus again answered and said to them, Children, how difficult it is for those who trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.text_gb_plain: 门徒就希奇祂的话。耶稣又对他们说，孩子们，倚靠钱财的人进神的国，是何等的难！
verses.text_big5_plain: 門徒就希奇祂的話。耶穌又對他們說，孩子們，倚靠錢財的人進神的國，是何等的難！

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷无，倚靠钱财的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷無，倚靠錢財的人。
footnotes.en: 10:24 1 for Some MSS omit, for those who trust in riches.

refs.text_gb: 他们行路上耶路撒冷去，耶稣在他们前头走，他们就希奇，跟从的人也害怕。祂又把十二个门徒带到一边，把自己将要遭遇的事，告诉他们说，
refs.text_big5: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去，耶穌在他們前頭走，他們就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。祂又把十二個門徒帶到一邊，把自己將要遭遇的事，告訴他們說，
refs.text_en: Now they were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus led the way before them. And they were amazed, and those who followed were afraid. And He took the twelve aside again and began to tell them the things that were about to happen to Him:

refs.text_gb: 众人都希奇，以致彼此讨论说，这是什么事？是个新鲜的教训！祂用权柄命令污灵，污灵就听从了祂。
refs.text_big5: 眾人都希奇，以致彼此討論說，這是甚麼事？是個新鮮的教訓！祂用權柄命令污靈，污靈就聽從了祂。
refs.text_en: And they were all amazed, so that they discussed among themselves, saying, What is this? A new teaching! With authority He orders even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him.

refs.text_gb: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当着众人面前出去了，以致众人都惊奇，荣耀神说，我们从来没有见过这样的事。
refs.text_big5: 那人就起來，立刻拿著褥子，當著眾人面前出去了，以致眾人都驚奇，榮耀神說，我們從來沒有見過這樣的事。
refs.text_en: And he rose and immediately took up the mat and went out before them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, We have never seen anything like this!

refs.text_gb: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说，孩子，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說，孩子，你的罪赦了。
refs.text_en: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Child, your sins are forgiven.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对他们说，孩子们，你们有鱼吃么？他们回答祂说，没有。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對他們說，孩子們，你們有魚喫麼？他們回答祂說，沒有。
refs.text_en: Then Jesus said to them, Little children, you do not have any fish to eat, do you? They answered Him, No.

refs.text_gb: 若是你一只眼绊跌你，就去掉它；你只有一只眼进入神的国，比有两只眼被扔在火坑里更好。
refs.text_big5: 若是你一隻眼絆跌你，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入神的國，比有兩隻眼被扔在火坑裏更好。
refs.text_en: And if your eye stumbles you, cast it out; it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into Gehenna,

verses.text_gb: 骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易。
verses.text_big5: 駱駝穿過鍼的眼，比財主進神的國還容易。
verses.text_en: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易。
verses.text_big5_plain: 駱駝穿過鍼的眼，比財主進神的國還容易。

verses.text_gb: 他们就分外[Cra]惊讶，[Fn1]彼此说，这样谁能得救？
verses.text_big5: 他們就分外[Cra]驚訝，[Fn1]彼此說，這樣誰能得救？
verses.text_en: But they were astonished beyond measure and said among themselves, Then who can be saved?
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们就分外惊讶，彼此说，这样谁能得救？
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們就分外驚訝，彼此說，這樣誰能得救？

footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷作，對祂說。

refs.text_gb: 众人分外惊讶，说，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聋的听见，又叫哑的说话。
refs.text_big5: 眾人分外驚訝，說，祂所有的事都作得好；祂既叫聾的聽見，又叫啞的說話。
refs.text_en: And they were utterly astounded, saying, He has done all things well; He makes both the deaf hear and the dumb speak.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣[Cra]看着他们说，在人是不能的，在神却不然，因为在神凡事都[Crb]能。

verses.text_en: Looking upon them, Jesus said, With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.

verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌看著他們說，在人是不能的，在神卻不然，因為在神凡事都能。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说，你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上，你还要来跟从我。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌看著他，就愛他，對他說，你還缺少一件：去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上，你還要來跟從我。
refs.text_en: And Jesus, looking upon him, was moved with love for him and said to him, One thing you lack: go; the things you have, sell and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.

refs.text_gb: 祂说，阿爸，父啊，在你凡事都能，求你将这杯从我撤去；然而不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。
refs.text_big5: 祂說，阿爸，父阿，在你凡事都能，求你將這杯從我撤去；然而不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。
refs.text_en: And He said, Abba Father, all things are possible to You; remove this cup from Me; yet not what I will, but what You will.

refs.text_gb: 我知道你万事都能作，你的定旨是不能拦阻的。
refs.text_big5: 我知道你萬事都能作，你的定旨是不能攔阻的。
refs.text_en: I know that You can do all things / And that no purpose of Yours can be restrained.

verses.text_gb: 彼得就对祂说，看哪，我们已经撇下所有的[Cra]跟从了你。
verses.text_big5: 彼得就對祂說，看哪，我們已經撇下所有的[Cra]跟從了你。
verses.text_en: Peter began to say to Him, Behold, we have left all and followed You.

refs.text_en: And Jesus, looking upon him, was moved with love for him and said to him, One thing you lack: go; the things you have, sell and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣说，我实在告诉你们，人为我和[Cra]福音，撇下房屋、或是弟兄、姊妹、母亲、父亲、儿女、田地，
verses.text_big5: 耶穌說，我實在告訴你們，人為我和[Cra]福音，撇下房屋、或是弟兄、姊妹、母親、父親、兒女、田地，
verses.text_en: Jesus said, Truly I say to you, There is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel's sake,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣说，我实在告诉你们，人为我和福音，撇下房屋、或是弟兄、姊妹、母亲、父亲、儿女、田地，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌說，我實在告訴你們，人為我和福音，撇下房屋、或是弟兄、姊妹、母親、父親、兒女、田地，

refs.text_gb: 因为凡要救自己魂生命的，必丧失魂生命；凡为我和福音丧失自己魂生命的，必救了魂生命。

footnotes.zh: 奴仆救主已经两次预言过祂的死与复活(八31，九31)。祂受死的时候既然到了(见1注1)，就甘愿上耶路撒冷去，甚至走在跟从祂的人前头；祂的迅速和勇敢，令他们希奇(32)。这是祂按神的定议(徒二23)，顺从神以致于死(腓二8)，为要完成神救赎的计划(赛五三10)。祂知道祂要借着死，在复活里得荣耀(路二四25～26)，并要释放出祂神圣的生命，产生许多弟兄作祂的彰显(约十二23～24，罗八29)。祂为那摆在前面的喜乐，就轻看羞辱(来十二2)，自愿被交与撒但所霸占的犹太首领，给他们定罪以致于死。为此神将祂升到天上，使祂坐在自己右边(十六19，徒二33～35)，赐给祂那超乎万名之上的名(腓二9～10)，立祂为主为基督(徒二36)，并赐祂荣耀尊贵为冠冕(来二9)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 奴僕救主已經兩次豫言過祂的死與復活。（八31，九31。）祂受死的時候既然到了，（見1註1，）就甘願上耶路撒冷去，甚至走在跟從祂的人前頭；祂的迅速和勇敢，令他們希奇。（32。）這是祂按神的定議，（徒二23，）順從神以至於死，（腓二8，）為要完成神救贖的計畫。（賽五三10。）祂知道祂要藉著死，在復活裏得榮耀，（路二四25～26，）並要釋放出祂神聖的生命，產生許多弟兄作祂的彰顯。（約十二23～24，羅八29。）祂為那擺在前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，（來十二2，）自願被交與撒但所霸佔的猶太首領，給他們定罪以至於死。為此神將祂升到天上，使祂坐在自己右邊，（十六19，徒二33～35，）賜給祂那超乎萬名之上的名，（腓二9～10，）立祂為主為基督，（徒二36，）並賜祂榮耀尊貴為冠冕。（來二9。）
footnotes.en: 10:33 1 delivered The Slave-Savior had predicted His death and resurrection twice already (Mark 8:31; 9:31). Since the time for His death was at hand (see note Mark 10:1 1 ) He went to Jerusalem willingly, even going before His followers with a speed and boldness that amazed them (v. 32). This was His obedience to God unto death (Phil. 2:8), according to the counsel of God (Acts 2:23), for the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan (Isa. 53:10). The Slave-Savior knew that through His death He would be glorified in resurrection (Luke 24:25-26) and that His divine life would be released to produce many brothers for His expression (John 12:23-24; Rom. 8:29). For the joy set before Him, He despised the shame (Heb. 12:2) and volunteered to be delivered to the Satan-usurped leaders of the Jews and to be condemned by them to death. For this, God exalted Him to the heavens, seated Him at His right hand (16:19; Acts 2:33-35), bestowed on Him the name which is above every name (Phil. 2:9-10), made Him both Lord and Christ (Acts 2:36), and crowned Him with glory and honor (Heb. 2:9).

verses.text_en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Him, saying to Him, Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask You.
verses.text_gb_plain: 西庇太的儿子雅各和约翰到耶稣跟前来，对祂说，夫子，我们无论向你求什么，愿你给我们作。
verses.text_big5_plain: 西庇太的兒子雅各和約翰到耶穌跟前來，對祂說，夫子，我們無論向你求甚麼，願你給我們作。

footnotes.en: 10:35 1 And For vv. 35-45, see notes in Matt. 20:20-28.

refs.text_gb: 祂稍往前走，又看见西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，在船上补网。
refs.text_big5: 祂稍往前走，又看見西庇太的兒子雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，在船上補網。
refs.text_en: And going on a little, He saw James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, who also were in their boat, mending the nets.

refs.text_gb: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲，同她儿子们进前来拜耶稣，求祂一件事。
refs.text_big5: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親，同她兒子們進前來拜耶穌，求祂一件事。
refs.text_en: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to Him with her sons, worshipping and asking something of Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对她说，你要什么？她说，请叫我这两个儿子在你国里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對她說，你要甚麼？她說，請叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。
refs.text_en: And He said to her, What do you want? She said to Him, Say that these two sons of mine will sit, one on Your right and one on Your left, in Your kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，你们不知道所求的是什么。我将要喝的杯，你们能喝么？他们说，我们能。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我將要喝的杯，你們能喝麼？他們說，我們能。
refs.text_en: But Jesus answered and said to them, You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup which I am about to drink? They said to Him, We are able.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，我的杯你们必要喝，只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的；乃是我父为谁预备的，就赐给谁。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，我的杯你們必要喝，只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的；乃是我父為誰豫備的，就賜給誰。
refs.text_en: He said to them, My cup you shall indeed drink, but to sit on My right and on My left, this is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by My Father.

refs.text_gb: 那十个听见，就恼怒这两个兄弟。
refs.text_big5: 那十個聽見，就惱怒這兩個兄弟。
refs.text_en: And when the ten heard this, they were indignant concerning the two brothers.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣叫了他们来，说，你们知道外邦人有君王为主治理他们，也有大臣操权管辖他们。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌叫了他們來，說，你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，也有大臣操權管轄他們。
refs.text_en: But Jesus called them to Him and said, You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and the great exercise authority over them.

refs.text_gb: 但你们中间不是这样；反倒你们中间无论谁想要为大，就必作你们的仆役；
refs.text_big5: 但你們中間不是這樣；反倒你們中間無論誰想要為大，就必作你們的僕役；
refs.text_en: It shall not be so among you; but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant,

refs.text_gb: 你们中间无论谁想要为首，就必作你们的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間無論誰想要為首，就必作你們的奴僕。
refs.text_en: And whoever wants to be first among you shall be your slave;

refs.text_gb: 正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。
refs.text_big5: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。
refs.text_en: Just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve and to give His life as a ransom for many.

verses.text_gb: 祂说，要我为你们[Cra]作什么？
verses.text_big5: 祂說，要我為你們[Cra]作甚麼？
verses.text_en: And He said to them, What do you want Me to do for you?
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂说，要我为你们作什么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂說，要我為你們作甚麼？

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，你要我为你作什么？瞎子说，拉波尼，我要能看见。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，你要我為你作甚麼？瞎子說，拉波尼，我要能看見。
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered him and said, What do you want Me to do for you? And the blind man said to Him, Rabboni, that I may receive my sight!

verses.text_gb: 他们说，赐我们在你的[Cra]荣耀里，一个[Crb]坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。
verses.text_big5: 他們說，賜我們在你的[Cra]榮耀裏，一個[Crb]坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。
verses.text_en: And they said to Him, Grant to us to sit, one on Your right and one on Your left, in Your glory.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们说，赐我们在你的荣耀里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們說，賜我們在你的榮耀裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。

refs.text_gb: 但是，当人子在祂的荣耀里，所有的天使同着祂来的时候，祂要坐在祂荣耀的宝座上；
refs.text_big5: 但是，當人子在祂的榮耀裏，所有的天使同著祂來的時候，祂要坐在祂榮耀的寶座上；
refs.text_en: But when the Son of Man comes in His glory and all the angels with Him, at that time He will sit on the throne of His glory.

refs.text_gb: 凡把我和我的话当作可耻的，人子在祂与父并圣天使的荣耀里来临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。
refs.text_big5: 凡把我和我的話當作可恥的，人子在祂與父並聖天使的榮耀裏來臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。
refs.text_en: For whoever is ashamed of Me and of My words, of this one will the Son of Man be ashamed when He comes in His glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对他们说，我实在告诉你们，你们这些跟从过我的人，在复兴的时候，当人子坐在祂荣耀的宝座上，你们也要坐在十二个宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對他們說，我實在告訴你們，你們這些跟從過我的人，在復興的時候，當人子坐在祂榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that you who have followed Me, in the restoration, when the Son of Man sits on the throne of His glory, you also shall sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣说，你们[Cra]不知道所求的是什么。我所喝的[Fn1][Crb]杯，你们能喝么？我所受的浸，你们能受么？
verses.text_big5: 耶穌說，你們[Cra]不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的[Fn1][Crb]杯，你們能喝麼？我所受的浸，你們能受麼？
verses.text_en: But Jesus said to them, You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup which I drink, or to be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized?
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣说，你们不知道所求的是什么。我所喝的杯，你们能喝么？我所受的浸，你们能受么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌說，你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝麼？我所受的浸，你們能受麼？

footnotes.zh: 杯和浸都是指奴仆救主的死(约十八11，路十二50)。杯象征祂的死是神赐给祂的分，就是祂为着神救赎罪人所领受的分；浸指明祂的死是神命定祂要经过的路，以完成神为罪人所预备的救赎。为着我们，祂甘心喝了这杯，也受了这浸。
footnotes.en: 10:38 1 cup; baptism Both the cup and the baptism refer to the Slave-Savior's death (John 18:11; Luke 12:50). The cup signifies that His death was the portion given to Him by God, the portion He took to redeem sinners for God. Baptism denotes that His death was ordained by God as the way for Him to pass through for the accomplishing of God's redemption for sinners. For us He willingly drank this cup and was baptized with this baptism.

refs.text_gb: 二人正要和耶稣分离的时候，彼得对耶稣说，夫子，我们在这里真好，可以搭三座帐棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。他却不知道所说的是什么。
refs.text_big5: 二人正要和耶穌分離的時候，彼得對耶穌說，夫子，我們在這裏真好，可以搭三座帳棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。他卻不知道所說的是甚麼。
refs.text_en: And as they were departing from Him, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tents, one for You and one for Moses and one for Elijah-not knowing what he was saying.

refs.text_gb: 祂说，阿爸，父啊，在你凡事都能，求你将这杯从我撤去；然而不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。
refs.text_big5: 祂說，阿爸，父阿，在你凡事都能，求你將這杯從我撤去；然而不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。
refs.text_en: And He said, Abba Father, all things are possible to You; remove this cup from Me; yet not what I will, but what You will.

verses.text_gb: 他们说，我们能。耶稣说，我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；我所受的浸，你们必要受。
verses.text_big5: 他們說，我們能。耶穌說，我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；我所受的浸，你們必要受。
verses.text_en: And they said to Him, We are able. And Jesus said to them, The cup which I drink you shall drink, and with the baptism with which I am baptized, you shall be baptized.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们说，我们能。耶稣说，我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；我所受的浸，你们必要受。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們說，我們能。耶穌說，我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；我所受的浸，你們必要受。

verses.text_gb: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是为谁预备的，就赐给谁。
verses.text_big5: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰豫備的，就賜給誰。
verses.text_en: But to sit on My right or on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是为谁预备的，就赐给谁。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰豫備的，就賜給誰。

verses.text_gb: 那十个听见，就开始恼怒雅各和约翰。
verses.text_big5: 那十個聽見，就開始惱怒雅各和約翰。
verses.text_en: And when the ten heard this, they began to be indignant concerning James and John.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那十个听见，就开始恼怒雅各和约翰。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那十個聽見，就開始惱怒雅各和約翰。

verses.text_gb: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们[Cra]说，你们知道外邦人有尊为君王的，为主治理他们，也有大臣操权管辖他们。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們[Cra]說，你們知道外邦人有尊為君王的，為主治理他們，也有大臣操權管轄他們。
verses.text_en: And Jesus called them to Him and said to them, You know that those who are esteemed as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们说，你们知道外邦人有尊为君王的，为主治理他们，也有大臣操权管辖他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說，你們知道外邦人有尊為君王的，為主治理他們，也有大臣操權管轄他們。

refs.text_gb: 还有，门徒中间也起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。
refs.text_big5: 還有，門徒中間也起了爭論，他們中間那一個可算為大。
refs.text_en: And a contention also occurred among them as to which of them seemed to be greatest.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，外邦人有君王为主治理他们，那掌权管辖他们的称为恩主。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，外邦人有君王為主治理他們，那掌權管轄他們的稱為恩主。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called benefactors.

refs.text_gb: 但你们不是这样；反倒你们中间为大的，要像年幼的；为首领的，要像服事人的。
refs.text_big5: 但你們不是這樣；反倒你們中間為大的，要像年幼的；為首領的，要像服事人的。
refs.text_en: But you shall not be so; but let the greatest among you become like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.

refs.text_gb: 是谁为大？是坐席的，还是服事人的？不是坐席的大么？然而我在你们中间，如同服事人的。
refs.text_big5: 是誰為大？是坐席的，還是服事人的？不是坐席的大麼？然而我在你們中間，如同服事人的。
refs.text_en: For who is greater, the one who reclines at table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines at table? But I am in your midst as the one who serves.

verses.text_gb: 但你们中间不是这样；反倒你们中间无论谁想要为[Cra]大，就必作你们的仆役；
verses.text_big5: 但你們中間不是這樣；反倒你們中間無論誰想要為[Cra]大，就必作你們的僕役；
verses.text_en: But it is not so among you; but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant,
verses.text_gb_plain: 但你们中间不是这样；反倒你们中间无论谁想要为大，就必作你们的仆役；
verses.text_big5_plain: 但你們中間不是這樣；反倒你們中間無論誰想要為大，就必作你們的僕役；

refs.text_gb: 你们中间谁为大，谁就要作你们的仆役。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的僕役。
refs.text_en: And the greatest among you shall be your servant.

verses.text_gb: 你们中间无论谁想要为首，就必作众人的[Cra]奴仆。
verses.text_big5: 你們中間無論誰想要為首，就必作眾人的[Cra]奴僕。
verses.text_en: And whoever wants to be first among you shall be the slave of all.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们中间无论谁想要为首，就必作众人的奴仆。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們中間無論誰想要為首，就必作眾人的奴僕。

refs.text_gb: 因为我们不是传自己，乃是传基督耶稣为主，也传自己为耶稣的缘故，作你们的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 因為我們不是傳自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為主，也傳自己為耶穌的緣故，作你們的奴僕。
refs.text_en: For we do not preach ourselves but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake.

verses.text_gb: 因为[Fn1]人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要[Cra]服事人，并且要[Crb]舍[Fn2]命，作[Crc]多人的[Fn3][Crd]赎价。
verses.text_big5: 因為[Fn1]人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要[Cra]服事人，並且要[Crb]捨[Fn2]命，作[Crc]多人的[Fn3][Crd]贖價。
verses.text_en: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve and to give His life as a ransom for many.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。

footnotes.zh: 这是最强的说法，说出奴仆救主这位在人性里的人子，乃是神的奴仆，甚至用祂的生命服事罪人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是最強的說法，說出奴僕救主這位在人性裏的人子，乃是神的奴僕，甚至用祂的生命服事罪人。
footnotes.en: 10:45 1 Son This is the strongest expression stating that the Slave-Savior, as the Son of Man in His humanity, was a Slave of God to serve sinners even by giving His life.

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，魂。
footnotes.en: 10:45 2 life Or, soul.

footnotes.zh: 这指明连奴仆救主的救赎，也是祂为着神的计划所给罪人的服事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明連奴僕救主的救贖，也是祂為著神的計畫所給罪人的服事。
footnotes.en: 10:45 3 ransom This indicates that even the Slave-Savior's redemption was His service rendered to sinners for God's plan.

refs.text_gb: 反而倒空自己，取了奴仆的形状，成为人的样式；
refs.text_big5: 反而倒空自己，取了奴僕的形狀，成為人的樣式；
refs.text_en: But emptied Himself, taking the form of a slave, becoming in the likeness of men;

refs.text_gb: 就起身离席，脱了外衣，拿一条手巾束腰。
refs.text_big5: 就起身離席，脫了外衣，拿一條手巾束腰。
refs.text_en: Rose from supper and laid aside His outer garments; and taking a towel, He girded Himself;

refs.text_gb: 随后把水倒在盆里，就开始洗门徒的脚，并用自己所束的手巾擦干。
refs.text_big5: 隨後把水倒在盆裏，就開始洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
refs.text_en: Then He poured water into the basin and began to wash the disciples' feet and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.

refs.text_gb: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。
refs.text_big5: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。
refs.text_en: Even as the Father knows Me and I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.

refs.text_gb: 主为我们舍命，在此我们就知道何为爱；我们也当为弟兄舍命。
refs.text_big5: 主為我們捨命，在此我們就知道何為愛；我們也當為弟兄捨命。
refs.text_en: In this we know love, that He laid down His life on our behalf, and we ought to lay down our lives on behalf of the brothers.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，这是我立约的血，为多人流出来的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，這是我立約的血，為多人流出來的。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, This is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many.

refs.text_gb: 基督也是这样，既一次被献，担当了多人的罪，将来还要向那热切等待祂的人第二次显现，并与罪无关，乃为拯救他们。
refs.text_big5: 基督也是這樣，既一次被獻，擔當了多人的罪，將來還要向那熱切等待祂的人第二次顯現，並與罪無關，乃為拯救他們。
refs.text_en: So Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time to those who eagerly await Him, apart from sin, unto salvation.

refs.text_gb: 祂必看见自己劳苦的果效，便心满意足；那义者我的仆人要使许多人因认识祂而成为义的；并且祂要担当他们的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 祂必看見自己勞苦的果效，便心滿意足；那義者我的僕人要使許多人因認識祂而成為義的；並且祂要擔當他們的罪孽。
refs.text_en: He will see the fruit of the travail of His soul, / And He will be satisfied; / By the knowledge of Him, the righteous One, My Servant, will make the / many righteous, / And He will bear their iniquities.

refs.text_gb: 所以我要使祂与至大者同分，祂要与至强者均分掳物；因为祂将命倾倒，以至于死，且被算在罪犯之中；唯独祂担当多人的罪，又为罪犯代求。
refs.text_big5: 所以我要使祂與至大者同分，祂要與至強者均分擄物；因為祂將命傾倒，以至於死，且被算在罪犯之中；惟獨祂擔當多人的罪，又為罪犯代求。
refs.text_en: Therefore I will divide to Him a portion with the Great, / And He will divide the spoil with the Strong; / Because He poured out His life unto death / And was numbered with the transgressors, / Yet He alone bore the sin of many / And interceded for the transgressors.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华却喜悦将祂压伤，使祂受痛苦。祂使自己成了为着罪的祭，祂必看见后裔，并且延长年日；耶和华所喜悦的事，必在祂手中亨通。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華卻喜悅將祂壓傷，使祂受痛苦。祂使自己成了為著罪的祭，祂必看見後裔，並且延長年日；耶和華所喜悅的事，必在祂手中亨通。
refs.text_en: But Jehovah was pleased to crush Him, to afflict Him with grief. / When He makes Himself an offering for sin, / He will see a seed, He will extend His days, / And the pleasure of Jehovah will prosper in His hand.

refs.text_gb: 祂舍了自己，为万人作赎价，在适当的时期，这事就证明出来；

refs.text_en: Who gave Himself as a ransom for all, the testimony to be borne in its own times.

footnotes.zh: 象征人的行为和人的行为所显出的美德(见赛六四6，启十九8)。门徒把自己的衣服搭在驴驹上，给主骑上，并有许多人把衣服铺在路上，给主行过(8)，表征一面他们对主的崇敬，一面他们表显人性美德的行为，也是主所能安坐之处，并通行之路(见太二一7与注1)。凡我们所行所为，都该为主铺路，且该作主的安坐之处。
footnotes.zh_big5: 象徵人的行為和人的行為所顯出的美德。（見賽六四6，啟十九8。）門徒把自己的衣服搭在驢駒上，給主騎上，並有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，給主行過，（8，）表徵一面他們對主的崇敬，一面他們表顯人性美德的行為，也是主所能安坐之處，並通行之路。（見太二一7與註1。）凡我們所行所為，都該為主鋪路，且該作主的安坐之處。
footnotes.en: 11:7 2 garments Signifying people's conduct and the virtues expressed in people's conduct (see Isa. 64:6; Rev. 19:8). The disciples put their garments on the colt for the Lord to ride on, and many spread their garments in the road for Him to pass through (v. 8), signifying, on the one hand, that they revered Him and, on the other hand, that their conduct, which was an expression of their human virtues, was a seat on which He could rest and a way that He could pass through (see Matt. 21:7 and note 1). Our deeds and our conduct should pave the way for the Lord and serve as a seat on which He can rest.

refs.text_gb: 锡安的女子啊，应当大大欢腾；耶路撒冷的女子啊，应当欢呼！看哪，你的王来到你这里。祂是公义的，并且施行拯救，卑微柔和地骑着驴，骑着驴驹，就是驴的崽子。
refs.text_big5: 錫安的女子阿，應當大大歡騰；耶路撒冷的女子阿，應當歡呼！看哪，你的王來到你這裏。祂是公義的，並且施行拯救，卑微柔和的騎著驢，騎著驢駒，就是驢的崽子。
refs.text_en: Exult greatly, O daughter of Zion; / Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem! / Now your King comes to you. / He is righteous and bears salvation, / Lowly and riding upon a donkey, / Even upon a colt, the foal of a donkey,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣得了一匹小驴，就骑上，如经上所记：
refs.text_big5: 耶穌得了一匹小驢，就騎上，如經上所記：
refs.text_en: And Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it, as it is written,

refs.text_gb: “锡安的女儿，不要惧怕，看哪，你的王骑着驴驹来了。”
refs.text_big5: “錫安的女兒，不要懼怕，看哪，你的王騎著驢駒來了。”
refs.text_en: "Fear not, daughter of Zion; behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey's colt."

refs.text_gb: 他们就急忙各将自己的衣服铺在台阶上，使耶户坐在其上；他们吹角，说，耶户作王了！
refs.text_big5: 他們就急忙各將自己的衣服鋪在臺階上，使耶戶坐在其上；他們吹角，說，耶戶作王了！
refs.text_en: Then they moved quickly; and every man took his garment and put it under him on the bare steps; and they blew the trumpet and said, Jehu is king!

verses.text_gb: 有许多人把衣服铺在路上，另有人从田间砍下[Fn1]满带[Fn2]嫩叶的树枝，一[Fn3]层一层的铺在路上。
verses.text_big5: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，另有人從田間砍下[Fn1]滿帶[Fn2]嫩葉的樹枝，一[Fn3]層一層的鋪在路上。
verses.text_en: And many spread their garments in the road, and others spread layers of branches full of tender leaves, having cut them out of the fields.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有许多人把衣服铺在路上，另有人从田间砍下满带嫩叶的树枝，一层一层的铺在路上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，另有人從田間砍下滿帶嫩葉的樹枝，一層一層的鋪在路上。

footnotes.zh: 原文指用树叶、嫩枝、芦苇和草类所铺，可供人走卧其上的一层一层，转指满带嫩叶的树枝。在此群众就是把这种树枝在路上铺成一层一层，犹如地毡，给他们所敬爱的奴仆救主在其上行过，进入京城。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文指用樹葉、嫩枝、蘆葦和草類所鋪，可供人走臥其上的一層一層，轉指滿帶嫩葉的樹枝。在此群眾就是把這種樹枝在路上鋪成一層一層，猶如地氈，給他們所敬愛的奴僕救主在其上行過，進入京城。
footnotes.en: 11:8 1 layers This shows not only that the branches were many and thick but also that people could walk on them securely.

footnotes.zh: 象征人生命的丰盛与新鲜，恰与枯竭的干叶相反(诗一3)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 象徵人生命的豐盛與新鮮，恰與枯竭的乾葉相反。（詩一3。）
footnotes.en: 11:8 2 branches The Greek word denoted primarily layers of leaves, twigs, reeds, or straw spread for people to walk on or lie on, and, by extension, branches full of tender leaves. Here the crowd spread layers of this kind of branch as a carpet on the road so that the Slave-Savior, whom they revered and loved, could walk on them as He entered the capital.

footnotes.zh: 这不只表明多而厚，也表明人可稳适的行在其上。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這不只表明多而厚，也表明人可穩適的行在其上。
footnotes.en: 11:8 3 tender Signifying the abundance and freshness of the human life; the opposite of withering, dry leaves (Psa. 1:3).

verses.text_gb: 前行后随的人喊着说，和散那！在主[Cra]名里来的，是当受颂赞的！
verses.text_big5: 前行後隨的人喊著說，和散那！在主[Cra]名裏來的，是當受頌讚的！
verses.text_en: And those who went before and those who followed cried out, Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
verses.text_gb_plain: 前行后随的人喊着说，和散那！在主名里来的，是当受颂赞的！
verses.text_big5_plain: 前行後隨的人喊著說，和散那！在主名裏來的，是當受頌讚的！

refs.text_gb: 在耶和华名里来的，是当受颂赞的；我们从耶和华的殿中，为你们祝福。
refs.text_big5: 在耶和華名裏來的，是當受頌讚的；我們從耶和華的殿中，為你們祝福。
refs.text_en: Blessed is He who comes in the name of Jehovah; / We bless you from the house of Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 我告诉你们，从今以后，你们不得再见我，直等到你们说，在主名里来的，是当受颂赞的！
refs.text_big5: 我告訴你們，從今以後，你們不得再見我，直等到你們說，在主名裏來的，是當受頌讚的！
refs.text_en: For I say to you, You shall by no means see Me from now on until you say, Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.

refs.text_gb: 我在我父的名里来，你们并不接受我；若有别人在自己的名里来，你们倒要接受他。
refs.text_big5: 我在我父的名裏來，你們並不接受我；若有別人在自己的名裏來，你們倒要接受他。
refs.text_en: I have come in the name of My Father, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

verses.text_gb: 那将要来的我们祖宗[Cra]大卫的[Crb]国，是当受颂赞的！[Crc]至高之处的和散那！
verses.text_big5: 那將要來的我們祖宗[Cra]大衛的[Crb]國，是當受頌讚的！[Crc]至高之處的和散那！
verses.text_en: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!
verses.text_gb_plain: 那将要来的我们祖宗大卫的国，是当受颂赞的！至高之处的和散那！
verses.text_big5_plain: 那將要來的我們祖宗大衛的國，是當受頌讚的！至高之處的和散那！

refs.text_gb: 我的仆人大卫必作他们的王，他们众人必归一个牧人。他们必遵行我的典章，谨守遵行我的律例。
refs.text_big5: 我的僕人大衛必作他們的王，他們眾人必歸一個牧人。他們必遵行我的典章，謹守遵行我的律例。
refs.text_en: And My Servant David will be King over them, and they all will have one Shepherd. They will also walk in My ordinances and observe My statutes and do them.

refs.text_gb: 他们必住在我赐给我仆人雅各的地上，就是你们列祖所住之地；他们和他们的子孙，并子孙的子孙，都必住在那里，直到永远。我的仆人大卫必作他们的首领，直到永远。
refs.text_big5: 他們必住在我賜給我僕人雅各的地上，就是你們列祖所住之地；他們和他們的子孫，並子孫的子孫，都必住在那裏，直到永遠。我的僕人大衛必作他們的首領，直到永遠。
refs.text_en: And they will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob My servant, in which your fathers dwelt; and they will dwell in it, they, their children, and their children's children, forever. And David My Servant will be their Prince forever.

refs.text_gb: 祂要为大，称为至高者的儿子，主神要把祂祖大卫的宝座给祂，
refs.text_big5: 祂要為大，稱為至高者的兒子，主神要把祂祖大衛的寶座給祂，
refs.text_en: He will be great and will be called Son of the Most High; and the Lord God will give to Him the throne of David His father,

refs.text_gb: 诸位，弟兄们，先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说，他死了，也葬了，并且他的坟墓直到今日还在我们这里。
refs.text_big5: 諸位，弟兄們，先祖大衛的事，我可以明明的對你們說，他死了，也葬了，並且他的墳墓直到今日還在我們這裏。
refs.text_en: Men, brothers, I can say to you plainly concerning the patriarch David that he both deceased and was buried, and his tomb is among us until this day.

refs.text_gb: 大卫既是申言者，又晓得神曾用誓言向他起誓，要从他的后裔中，立一位坐在他的宝座上，
refs.text_big5: 大衛既是申言者，又曉得神曾用誓言向他起誓，要從他的後裔中，立一位坐在他的寶座上，
refs.text_en: Therefore, being a prophet and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him to seat One from the fruit of his loins upon his throne,

refs.text_gb: 你的家和你的国必在你面前永远坚立；你的国位必永远坚定。
refs.text_big5: 你的家和你的國必在你面前永遠堅立；你的國位必永遠堅定。
refs.text_en: And your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you; your throne will be established forever.

refs.text_gb: 那些聚在一起的人问耶稣说，主啊，你复兴以色列国，就在这时候么？
refs.text_big5: 那些聚在一起的人問耶穌說，主阿，你復興以色列國，就在這時候麼？
refs.text_en: So the ones who came together asked Him, saying, Lord, are You at this time restoring the kingdom to Israel?

refs.text_gb: 在至高之处荣耀归与神，在地上平安临及祂所喜悦的人。
refs.text_big5: 在至高之處榮耀歸與神，在地上平安臨及祂所喜悅的人。
refs.text_en: Glory in the highest places to God, and on earth peace among men of His good pleasure.

refs.text_gb: 阿利路亚！你们要从天上赞美耶和华，要在高处赞美祂。
refs.text_big5: 阿利路亞！你們要從天上讚美耶和華，要在高處讚美祂。
refs.text_en: Hallelujah! / Praise Jehovah from the heavens; / Praise Him in the heights.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣进了[Cra]耶路撒冷，入了殿，周围看了各样物件；时候已晚，就和十二个门徒[Crb]出城，往[Crc]伯大尼去。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌進了[Cra]耶路撒冷，入了殿，周圍看了各樣物件；時候已晚，就和十二個門徒[Crb]出城，往[Crc]伯大尼去。
verses.text_en: And He entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and when He had looked around at all things, since the hour was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了殿，周围看了各样物件；时候已晚，就和十二个门徒出城，往伯大尼去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了殿，周圍看了各樣物件；時候已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里，耶稣就打发两个门徒，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏，耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
refs.text_en: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, at Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples,

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，全城都震动了，说，这是谁？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，全城都震動了，說，這是誰？
refs.text_en: And when He entered into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, Who is this?

refs.text_gb: 每到晚上，他们就出城去。
refs.text_big5: 每到晚上，他們就出城去。
refs.text_en: And every day when evening fell, they went outside the city.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里，耶稣就打发两个门徒，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏，耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
refs.text_en: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, at Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples,

refs.text_gb: 于是撇开他们，出城到伯大尼去，在那里住宿。
refs.text_big5: 於是撇開他們，出城到伯大尼去，在那裏住宿。
refs.text_en: And leaving them, He went out of the city to Bethany and lodged there.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]第二天，[Cra]他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣[Crb]饿了。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]第二天，[Cra]他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌[Crb]餓了。
verses.text_en: And on the next day, when they had gone out from Bethany, He became hungry.
verses.text_gb_plain: 第二天，他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。

footnotes.en: 11:12 1 And For vv. 12-14, see notes in Matt. 21:18-19.

refs.text_gb: 早晨回城的时候，耶稣饿了；
refs.text_big5: 早晨回城的時候，耶穌餓了；
refs.text_en: Now in the morning as He returned to the city, He became hungry.

refs.text_gb: 看见路旁一棵无花果树，就走到跟前，在树上找不着什么，不过有叶子；就对树说，你不再结果子，直到永远。那无花果树就立刻枯干了。
refs.text_big5: 看見路旁一棵無花果樹，就走到跟前，在樹上找不著甚麼，不過有葉子；就對樹說，你不再結果子，直到永遠。那無花果樹就立刻枯乾了。
refs.text_en: And seeing a fig tree on the way, He came to it and found nothing on it except leaves only. And He said to it, May there no longer be fruit from you forever! And the fig tree was instantly dried up.

refs.text_gb: 祂禁食了四十昼四十夜，后来就饿了。
refs.text_big5: 祂禁食了四十晝四十夜，後來就餓了。
refs.text_en: And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, afterward He became hungry.

verses.text_gb: 远远地看见一棵[Cra]无花果树，树上有叶子，就走过去，或者在树上可以找着什么；到了树下，除了[Crb]叶子以外，什么也找不着，因为不是收无花果的时节。
verses.text_big5: 遠遠的看見一棵[Cra]無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就走過去，或者在樹上可以找著甚麼；到了樹下，除了[Crb]葉子以外，甚麼也找不著，因為不是收無花果的時節。
verses.text_en: And seeing at a distance a fig tree having leaves, He came to see if perhaps He would find anything on it. And when He came to it, He found nothing except leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就走过去，或者在树上可以找着什么；到了树下，除了叶子以外，什么也找不着，因为不是收无花果的时节。
verses.text_big5_plain: 遠遠的看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就走過去，或者在樹上可以找著甚麼；到了樹下，除了葉子以外，甚麼也找不著，因為不是收無花果的時節。

refs.text_gb: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见那无花果树连根都枯干了。
refs.text_big5: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見那無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
refs.text_en: And as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.

refs.text_gb: 于是祂说了这个比喻：一个人有一棵无花果树，栽在他的葡萄园里。他来，在树上找果子，却找不着。
refs.text_big5: 於是祂說了這個比喻：一個人有一棵無花果樹，栽在他的葡萄園裏。他來，在樹上找果子，卻找不著。
refs.text_en: And He told this parable: A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard. And he came seeking fruit on it and did not find any.

refs.text_gb: 就对管园的说，看哪，这三年我来，在这无花果树上找果子，竟找不着，把它砍了吧，何必还白占地土？
refs.text_big5: 就對管園的說，看哪，這三年我來，在這無花果樹上找果子，竟找不著，把它砍了罷，何必還白佔地土？
refs.text_en: And he said to the vinedresser, Behold, for three years I have come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and I have not found any. Cut it down therefore. Why does it also make the ground useless?

refs.text_gb: 管园的回答他说，主啊，今年且留着，等我周围掘开土，堆上肥；
refs.text_big5: 管園的回答他說，主阿，今年且留著，等我周圍掘開土，堆上肥；
refs.text_en: But he answered and said to him, Master, leave it this year also, until I dig around it and throw on manure.

refs.text_gb: 将来若真结果子便罢，不然再把它砍了。
refs.text_big5: 將來若真結果子便罷，不然再把它砍了。
refs.text_en: And if it produces fruit in the future, good; otherwise, cut it down.

refs.text_gb: 但是你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了；
refs.text_big5: 但是你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了；
refs.text_en: But learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch has become tender and puts forth its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

verses.text_gb: 耶稣就对树说，[Fn1]不再有人吃你的果子，直到永远。祂的门徒也听见了。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌就對樹說，[Fn1]不再有人喫你的果子，直到永遠。祂的門徒也聽見了。
verses.text_en: And He answered and said to it, May no one eat fruit from you forever! And His disciples heard it.

footnotes.zh: 12～26节这一段，把奴仆救主咒诅无花果树和祂洁净殿的事放在一起，指明祂同时在不同方面，对付败坏并背叛的以色列国。无花果树是以色列国的象征(耶二四2，5，8)，殿是以色列国与神关系的中心。以色列国是神所栽种的无花果树，却不为神结果子；殿作以色列国与神关系的中心，却满了败坏。因此奴仆救主咒诅不结果子的无花果树，并洁净受玷污的殿。这样的对付，可视为十二9和十三2所预言之毁灭的先声。
footnotes.zh_big5: 12～26節這一段，把奴僕救主咒詛無花果樹和祂潔淨殿的事放在一起，指明祂同時在不同方面，對付敗壞並背叛的以色列國。無花果樹是以色列國的象徵，（耶二四2，5，8，）殿是以色列國與神關係的中心。以色列國是神所栽種的無花果樹，卻不為神結果子；殿作以色列國與神關係的中心，卻滿了敗壞。因此奴僕救主咒詛不結果子的無花果樹，並潔淨受玷污的殿。這樣的對付，可視為十二9和十三2所豫言之毀滅的先聲。
footnotes.en: 11:14 1 no In this section, vv. 12-26, the record of the Slave-Savior's cursing of the fig tree and the record of His cleansing of the temple were merged, indicating His dealing simultaneously with different aspects of the corrupted and rebellious nation of Israel. The fig tree was the symbol of the nation of Israel (Jer. 24:2, 5, 8), and the temple was the center of Israel's relationship with God. As a fig tree planted by God, the nation of Israel did not bear fruit for Him, and as the center of Israel's relationship with God, the temple was filled with corruption. Hence, the Slave-Savior cursed the fruitless fig tree and cleansed the contaminated temple. Such a dealing can be considered a harbinger of the destruction foretold in Mark 12:9 and Mark 13:2.

footnotes.zh: 一14～十52奴仆救主在加利利尽职开展福音时，祂的工作是传扬福音、教训真理、赶鬼、医病。在那工作中，祂人性的美德同祂神圣的属性，在祂为着神而给罪人的神圣服事上，显出祂的资格和美丽。祂在耶路撒冷为着救赎工作而有的预备(15～十四42)，主要的就是面对抵挡祂的犹太首领；他们本该是神建筑的匠人(十二9～10)，却被神的仇敌撒但霸占，并受他鼓动，图谋杀害祂。在这样的遭遇中，在他们诡诈和邪恶的质问、试验并察验下，祂人性之真，显出祂人性的尊严(15～18)，并且祂属人的行为和完美，也显出祂神圣的智慧和权柄(27～十二37)；所以至终，那些找祂毛病的人，反成了证明祂资格的人。这为祂铺了路，向那些盲目的反对者指出，祂这位基督，大卫的子孙，乃是大卫的主，也就是神(十二35～37)，使他们能在祂的人性里认识祂的神性，知道祂就是神活在人里面。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一14～十52奴僕救主在加利利盡職開展福音時，祂的工作是傳揚福音、教訓真理、趕鬼、醫病。在那工作中，祂人性的美德同祂神聖的屬性，在祂為著神而給罪人的神聖服事上，顯出祂的資格和美麗。祂在耶路撒冷為著救贖工作而有的豫備，（15～十四42，）主要的就是面對抵擋祂的猶太首領；他們本該是神建築的匠人，（十二9～10，）卻被神的仇敵撒但霸佔，並受他鼓動，圖謀殺害祂。在這樣的遭遇中，在他們詭詐和邪惡的質問、試驗並察驗下，祂人性之真，顯出祂人性的尊嚴，（15～18，）並且祂屬人的行為和完美，也顯出祂神聖的智慧和權柄；（27～十二37；）所以至終，那些找祂毛病的人，反成了證明祂資格的人。這為祂鋪了路，向那些盲目的反對者指出，祂這位基督，大衛的子孫，乃是大衛的主，也就是神，（十二35～37，）使他們能在祂的人性裏認識祂的神性，知道祂就是神活在人裏面。
footnotes.en: 11:15 1 cast In His ministry for the spreading of the gospel in Galilee in 1:14—10:52, the Slave-Savior's work was to proclaim the gospel, teach the truth, cast out demons, and heal the sick. In that work His human virtues with His divine attributes were expressed as His qualification for and beauty in His divine service rendered to sinners for God. In His preparation in Jerusalem for His redemptive work (11:15—14:42), His major work was to confront the opposing Jewish leaders, who should have been the builders of God's building (Mark 12:9-10) but had actually been usurped by God's enemy, Satan, and instigated by him to plot to kill Him. In this confrontation, under their subtle and evil questioning, testing, and examining, His human dignity was expressed in His human genuineness (vv. 15-18), and His divine wisdom and authority were expressed in His human conduct and perfection (Mark 11:27-33; 12:1-37), so that eventually His faultfinders became His quality-provers. This paved the way for Him to point out to these blind opposers that He, the Christ, the Son of David, was the Lord of David, that is, the very God (Mark 12:35-37), that they might know His deity in His humanity, that is, that He was God living in man.

refs.text_gb: 他们都惊讶祂的教训，因为祂的话带着权柄。
refs.text_big5: 他們都驚訝祂的教訓，因為祂的話帶著權柄。
refs.text_en: And they were astounded at His teaching, because His word was with authority.

verses.text_gb: 每到晚上，他们就[Cra]出城去。
verses.text_big5: 每到晚上，他們就[Cra]出城去。
verses.text_en: And every day when evening fell, they went outside the city.
verses.text_gb_plain: 每到晚上，他们就出城去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 每到晚上，他們就出城去。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了殿，周围看了各样物件；时候已晚，就和十二个门徒出城，往伯大尼去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了殿，周圍看了各樣物件；時候已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去。
refs.text_en: And He entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and when He had looked around at all things, since the hour was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣每日在殿里施教，每夜出城，在一座山，名叫橄榄山住宿。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌每日在殿裏施教，每夜出城，在一座山，名叫橄欖山住宿。
refs.text_en: Now during the day He was in the temple teaching, but during the night He went out and stayed on the mountain called Olivet.

verses.text_gb: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见那[Cra]无花果树连根都[Crb]枯干了。
verses.text_big5: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見那[Cra]無花果樹連根都[Crb]枯乾了。
verses.text_en: And as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
verses.text_gb_plain: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见那无花果树连根都枯干了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見那無花果樹連根都枯乾了。

refs.text_gb: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就走过去，或者在树上可以找着什么；到了树下，除了叶子以外，什么也找不着，因为不是收无花果的时节。
refs.text_big5: 遠遠的看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就走過去，或者在樹上可以找著甚麼；到了樹下，除了葉子以外，甚麼也找不著，因為不是收無花果的時節。
refs.text_en: And seeing at a distance a fig tree having leaves, He came to see if perhaps He would find anything on it. And when He came to it, He found nothing except leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

refs.text_gb: 门徒看见了，便希奇说，这无花果树怎么立刻就枯干了？
refs.text_big5: 門徒看見了，便希奇說，這無花果樹怎麼立刻就枯乾了？
refs.text_en: And when the disciples saw this, they marveled, saying, How did the fig tree instantly dry up?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行无花果树上所发生的事，就是对这座山说，你得挪开，投在海里，也必成就。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行無花果樹上所發生的事，就是對這座山說，你得挪開，投在海裏，也必成就。
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, Be taken up and cast into the sea, it will happen.

refs.text_gb: 你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。
refs.text_big5: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得著。
refs.text_en: And all that you ask in prayer, if you believe, you will receive.

verses.text_gb: 彼得想起来，就对祂说，[Cra]拉比，请看，你所咒诅的无花果树，已经枯干了。
verses.text_big5: 彼得想起來，就對祂說，[Cra]拉比，請看，你所咒詛的無花果樹，已經枯乾了。
verses.text_en: And Peter remembered and said to Him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which You cursed has withered.
verses.text_gb_plain: 彼得想起来，就对祂说，拉比，请看，你所咒诅的无花果树，已经枯干了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 彼得想起來，就對祂說，拉比，請看，你所咒詛的無花果樹，已經枯乾了。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问他们说，你们寻求什么？他们说，拉比，你住在哪里？（拉比翻出来，就是夫子。）
refs.text_big5: 耶穌轉過身來，看見他們跟著，就問他們說，你們尋求甚麼？他們說，拉比，你住在那裏？（拉比繙出來，就是夫子。）
refs.text_en: And Jesus, turning and beholding them following, said to them, What are you seeking? And they said to Him, Rabbi (which translated means Teacher), where are You staying?

verses.text_gb: 耶稣回答说，你们要[Cra]信神。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌回答說，你們要[Cra]信神。
verses.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to them, Have faith in God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣回答说，你们要信神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌回答說，你們要信神。

refs.text_gb: 你们心里不要受搅扰，你们当信入神，也当信入我。
refs.text_big5: 你們心裏不要受攪擾，你們當信入神，也當信入我。
refs.text_en: Do not let your heart be troubled; believe into God, believe also into Me.

verses.text_gb: 我实在告诉你们，无论谁对这座[Cra]山说，你得挪开，投在[Crb]海里，他若心里不[Crc]疑惑，只信他所说的成了，就必给他成了。
verses.text_big5: 我實在告訴你們，無論誰對這座[Cra]山說，你得挪開，投在[Crb]海裏，他若心裏不[Crc]疑惑，只信他所說的成了，就必給他成了。
verses.text_en: Truly I say to you that whoever says to this mountain, Be taken up and cast into the sea, and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says happens, he will have it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我实在告诉你们，无论谁对这座山说，你得挪开，投在海里，他若心里不疑惑，只信他所说的成了，就必给他成了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我實在告訴你們，無論誰對這座山說，你得挪開，投在海裏，他若心裏不疑惑，只信他所說的成了，就必給他成了。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，因为你们的信心小；我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说，从这边挪到那边，它也必挪去；并且在你们就没有一件事是不可能的。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，因為你們的信心小；我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說，從這邊挪到那邊，它也必挪去；並且在你們就沒有一件事是不可能的。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Because of your little faith; for truly I say to you, If you have faith like a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Move from here to there, and it will move; and nothing will be impossible to you.

refs.text_gb: 我若有申言的恩赐，也明白一切的奥秘，和一切的知识，并有全备的信，以致能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得什么。
refs.text_big5: 我若有申言的恩賜，也明白一切的奧祕，和一切的知識，並有全備的信，以致能彀移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
refs.text_en: And if I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

refs.text_gb: 主说，你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说，你得连根拔起，栽在海里，它也必听从你们。
refs.text_big5: 主說，你們若有信心像一粒芥菜種，就是對這棵桑樹說，你得連根拔起，栽在海裏，它也必聽從你們。
refs.text_en: But the Lord said, If you have faith like a mustard seed, you would have said to this sycamine tree, Be uprooted and be planted in the sea; and it would have obeyed you.

refs.text_gb: 总没有因不信而疑惑神的应许，反倒因信得着加力，将荣耀归与神，
refs.text_big5: 總沒有因不信而疑惑神的應許，反倒因信得著加力，將榮耀歸與神，
refs.text_en: But with regard to the promise of God, he did not doubt in unbelief, but was empowered by faith, giving glory to God

refs.text_gb: 只是要凭着信心求，一点不疑惑；因为那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被风吹动翻腾。
refs.text_big5: 只是要憑著信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。
refs.text_en: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing, for he who doubts is like the surge of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed about.

verses.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告[Cra]祈求的，无论是什么，只要信已经得着了，就必得着。
verses.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告[Cra]祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信已經得著了，就必得著。
verses.text_en: For this reason I say to you, All things that you pray and ask, believe that you have received them, and you will have them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信已经得着了，就必得着。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信已經得著了，就必得著。

crossrefs.label: a
crossrefs.raw: 太七7，路十一9，约十四13，十五7，十六24，雅一5

refs.text_gb: 求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
refs.text_big5: 求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
refs.text_en: Ask and it shall be given to you; seek and you shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

refs.text_gb: 我又告诉你们，求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
refs.text_big5: 我又告訴你們，求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
refs.text_en: And I say to you, Ask and it shall be given to you; seek and you shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

refs.text_gb: 你们在我的名里无论求什么，我必作成，叫父在子身上得荣耀。
refs.text_big5: 你們在我的名裏無論求甚麼，我必作成，叫父在子身上得榮耀。
refs.text_en: And whatever you ask in My name, that I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

refs.text_gb: 你们若住在我里面，我的话也住在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求就给你们成就。
refs.text_big5: 你們若住在我裏面，我的話也住在你們裏面，凡你們所願意的，祈求就給你們成就。
refs.text_en: If you abide in Me and My words abide in you, ask whatever you will, and it shall be done for you.

refs.text_gb: 向来你们没有在我的名里求什么，现在你们求，就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。
refs.text_big5: 向來你們沒有在我的名裏求甚麼，現在你們求，就必得著，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
refs.text_en: Until now you have asked for nothing in My name; ask and you shall receive, that your joy may be made full.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，就当求那厚赐众人，也不斥责人的神，就必有赐给他的。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，就當求那厚賜眾人，也不斥責人的神，就必有賜給他的。
refs.text_en: But if any one of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and does not reproach, and it will be given to him.

verses.text_gb: 你们[Cra]站着祷告的时候，若向什么人[Fn1][Crb]怀怨，要[Fn2][Crc]赦免他，好叫你们在诸天之上的[Crd]父，也赦免你们的过犯。
verses.text_big5: 你們[Cra]站著禱告的時候，若向甚麼人[Fn1][Crb]懷怨，要[Fn2][Crc]赦免他，好叫你們在諸天之上的[Crd]父，也赦免你們的過犯。
verses.text_en: And when you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who is in the heavens may also forgive you your offenses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们站着祷告的时候，若向什么人怀怨，要赦免他，好叫你们在诸天之上的父，也赦免你们的过犯。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們站著禱告的時候，若向甚麼人懷怨，要赦免他，好叫你們在諸天之上的父，也赦免你們的過犯。

footnotes.zh: 这是由于别人的过犯。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是由於別人的過犯。
footnotes.en: 11:25 1 forgive Forgiving another's offense is the ground for our heavenly Father to forgive us. This is true especially in our prayer time. In a strict sense, we cannot pray with a heart that holds anything against anyone, i.e., that feels offended by anyone or is unable to forget another's offense.

footnotes.zh: 我们赦免人的过犯乃是天父赦免我们的根据，在我们祷告时，更是如此。严格说来，我们心中若向什么人怀怨，感觉被人冒犯，或不忘记别人的冒犯，我们就无法祷告。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們赦免人的過犯乃是天父赦免我們的根據，在我們禱告時，更是如此。嚴格說來，我們心中若向甚麼人懷怨，感覺被人冒犯，或不忘記別人的冒犯，我們就無法禱告。
footnotes.en: 11:25 2 anything Because of another's offense.

refs.text_gb: 你们祷告的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，因为他们爱站在会堂里，并十字街口祷告，为要叫人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经充分的得了他们的赏赐。
refs.text_big5: 你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，因為他們愛站在會堂裏，並十字街口禱告，為要叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經充分的得了他們的賞賜。
refs.text_en: And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners, so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward in full.

refs.text_gb: 法利赛人站着，自言自语地祷告说，神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人，勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。
refs.text_big5: 法利賽人站著，自言自語的禱告說，神阿，我感謝你，我不像別人，勒索、不義、姦淫，也不像這個稅吏。
refs.text_en: The Pharisee stood and prayed these things to himself: God, I thank You that I am not like the rest of men-extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

refs.text_gb: 所以你在祭坛前献礼物，若想起你的弟兄向你怀怨，
refs.text_big5: 所以你在祭壇前獻禮物，若想起你的弟兄向你懷怨，
refs.text_en: Therefore if you are offering your gift at the altar and there you remember that your brother has something against you,

refs.text_gb: 因为你们若赦免人的过犯，你们的天父也必赦免你们；
refs.text_big5: 因為你們若赦免人的過犯，你們的天父也必赦免你們；
refs.text_en: For if you forgive men their offenses, your heavenly Father will forgive you also;

refs.text_gb: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此容忍，彼此饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要怎样饶恕人。
refs.text_big5: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此容忍，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人。
refs.text_en: Bearing one another and forgiving one another, if anyone should have a complaint against anyone; even as the Lord forgave you, so also should you forgive.

refs.text_gb: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道把好东西给儿女，何况你们在诸天之上的父，岂不更把好东西给求祂的人么？
refs.text_big5: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道把好東西給兒女，何況你們在諸天之上的父，豈不更把好東西給求祂的人麼？
refs.text_en: If you then being evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in the heavens give good things to those who ask Him!

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]你们若不赦免人，你们在诸天之上的父，也不赦免你们的过犯。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]你們若不赦免人，你們在諸天之上的父，也不赦免你們的過犯。
verses.text_en: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in the heavens forgive your offenses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们若不赦免人，你们在诸天之上的父，也不赦免你们的过犯。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們若不赦免人，你們在諸天之上的父，也不赦免你們的過犯。

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷无本节。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷無本節。
footnotes.en: 11:26 1 But Some MSS omit this verse.

verses.text_gb: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在[Cra]殿里行走的时候，祭司长、经学家和长老来到祂那里，
verses.text_big5: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在[Cra]殿裏行走的時候，祭司長、經學家和長老來到祂那裏，
verses.text_en: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to Him,
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长、经学家和长老来到祂那里，
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裏行走的時候，祭司長、經學家和長老來到祂那裏，

refs.text_gb: 耶稣进了殿，正施教的时候，祭司长和民间的长老到祂跟前来，说，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌進了殿，正施教的時候，祭司長和民間的長老到祂跟前來，說，你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？給你這權柄的是誰？
refs.text_en: And when He came into the temple, the chief priests and elders of the people came to Him as He was teaching and said, By what authority do You do these things? And who gave You this authority?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，我也要问你们一句话，你们若告诉我，我就告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
refs.text_en: And Jesus answered and said to them, I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell Me, I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.

refs.text_gb: 约翰的浸是从哪里来的？是从天上来的，还是从人来的？他们就彼此议论说，我们若说从天上来的，祂必对我们说，这样，你们为什么不信他？
refs.text_big5: 約翰的浸是從那裏來的？是從天上來的，還是從人來的？他們就彼此議論說，我們若說從天上來的，祂必對我們說，這樣，你們為甚麼不信他？
refs.text_en: The baptism of John, from where did it come, from heaven or from men? And they reasoned among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven, He will say to us, Why then did you not believe him?

refs.text_gb: 若说从人来的，我们又怕群众，因为他们都以约翰为申言者。
refs.text_big5: 若說從人來的，我們又怕群眾，因為他們都以約翰為申言者。
refs.text_en: But if we say, From men, we fear the crowd, for all hold John as a prophet.

refs.text_gb: 于是回答耶稣说，我们不知道。耶稣也对他们说，我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
refs.text_big5: 於是回答耶穌說，我們不知道。耶穌也對他們說，我也不告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
refs.text_en: And they answered Jesus and said, We do not know. He too said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

refs.text_gb: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教训百姓，传福音的时候，祭司长和经学家同长老上前来，
refs.text_big5: 有一天，耶穌在殿裏教訓百姓，傳福音的時候，祭司長和經學家同長老上前來，
refs.text_en: And on one of the days, as He was teaching the people in the temple and announcing the good news, the chief priests and the scribes with the elders came upon Him,

refs.text_gb: 对祂发言说，告诉我们，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁？
refs.text_big5: 對祂發言說，告訴我們，你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？給你這權柄的是誰？
refs.text_en: And spoke, saying to Him, Tell us by what authority You do these things, or who is the one who gave You this authority?

refs.text_gb: 耶稣回答他们说，我也要问你们一句话，你们且告诉我，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌回答他們說，我也要問你們一句話，你們且告訴我，
refs.text_en: And He answered and said to them, I also will ask you one thing, and you tell Me:

refs.text_gb: 约翰的浸，是从天上来的，还是从人来的？
refs.text_big5: 約翰的浸，是從天上來的，還是從人來的？
refs.text_en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men?

refs.text_gb: 他们就彼此商议说，我们若说从天上来的，祂必说，你们为什么不信他？
refs.text_big5: 他們就彼此商議說，我們若說從天上來的，祂必說，你們為甚麼不信他？
refs.text_en: And they reasoned together among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven, He will say, Why did you not believe him?

refs.text_gb: 若说从人来的，众百姓都要用石头打死我们，因为他们深信约翰是申言者。
refs.text_big5: 若說從人來的，眾百姓都要用石頭打死我們，因為他們深信約翰是申言者。
refs.text_en: But if we say, From men, all the people will stone us to death, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

refs.text_gb: 于是回答说，不知道是从哪里来的。
refs.text_big5: 於是回答說，不知道是從那裏來的。
refs.text_en: And they answered that they did not know where it was from.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣便对他们说，我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌便對他們說，我也不告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.text_gb: 对祂说，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？谁给你这[Cra]权柄作这些事？
verses.text_big5: 對祂說，你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？誰給你這[Cra]權柄作這些事？
verses.text_en: And said to Him, By what authority do You do these things, or who gave You this authority to do these things?
verses.text_gb_plain: 对祂说，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？谁给你这权柄作这些事？
verses.text_big5_plain: 對祂說，你仗著甚麼權柄作這些事？誰給你這權柄作這些事？

refs.text_gb: 他们叫使徒站在当中，查问说，你们用什么能力，或在谁的名里作这事？
refs.text_big5: 他們叫使徒站在當中，查問說，你們用甚麼能力，或在誰的名裏作這事？
refs.text_en: And they stood them in the midst and inquired, By what power or in what name did you do this?

verses.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
verses.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
verses.text_en: And Jesus said to them, I will question you about one thing; answer Me and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣对他们说，我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌對他們說，我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。

verses.text_gb: 约翰的[Cra]浸，是从[Crb]天上来的，还是从人来的？你们回答我。
verses.text_big5: 約翰的[Cra]浸，是從[Crb]天上來的，還是從人來的？你們回答我。
verses.text_en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约翰的浸，是从天上来的，还是从人来的？你们回答我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約翰的浸，是從天上來的，還是從人來的？你們回答我。

refs.text_gb: 照这话，约翰出来了，在旷野施浸，传悔改的浸，使罪得赦。
refs.text_big5: 照這話，約翰出來了，在曠野施浸，傳悔改的浸，使罪得赦。
refs.text_en: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

refs.text_gb: 约翰回答说，若不是从天上赐的，人就不能得到什么。
refs.text_big5: 約翰回答說，若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得到甚麼。
refs.text_en: John answered and said, A man cannot receive anything unless it has been given to him from heaven.

refs.text_gb: 我要起来，到我父亲那里去，向他说，父亲，我犯罪得罪了天，并得罪了你。
refs.text_big5: 我要起來，到我父親那裏去，向他說，父親，我犯罪得罪了天，並得罪了你。
refs.text_en: I will rise up and go to my father, and I will say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you.

refs.text_gb: 儿子说，父亲，我犯罪得罪了天，并得罪了你。我不配再称为你的儿子。
refs.text_big5: 兒子說，父親，我犯罪得罪了天，並得罪了你。我不配再稱為你的兒子。
refs.text_en: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you; I am no longer worthy to be called your son.

verses.text_gb: 他们彼此议论说，我们若是说从天上来的，祂必说，这样，你们为什么[Cra]不信他？
verses.text_big5: 他們彼此議論說，我們若是說從天上來的，祂必說，這樣，你們為甚麼[Cra]不信他？
verses.text_en: And they reasoned with one another saying, If we say, From heaven, He will say, Why then did you not believe him?
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们彼此议论说，我们若是说从天上来的，祂必说，这样，你们为什么不信他？
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們彼此議論說，我們若是說從天上來的，祂必說，這樣，你們為甚麼不信他？

refs.text_gb: 因为约翰在义路中来到你们这里，你们不信他，税吏和娼妓倒信他。你们看见了，后来还是不悔改去信他。
refs.text_big5: 因為約翰在義路中來到你們這裏，你們不信他，稅吏和娼妓倒信他。你們看見了，後來還是不悔改去信他。
refs.text_en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the harlots believed him. And you, when you saw it, did not later regret it to believe him.

verses.text_gb: 我们要是说从人来的─他们又[Cra]怕群众，因为众人真以[Crb]约翰为[Crc]申言者。
verses.text_big5: 我們要是說從人來的─他們又[Cra]怕群眾，因為眾人真以[Crb]約翰為[Crc]申言者。
verses.text_en: But should we say, From men?-they feared the crowd, for all held that John was really a prophet.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们要是说从人来的─他们又怕群众，因为众人真以约翰为申言者。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們要是說從人來的─他們又怕群眾，因為眾人真以約翰為申言者。

refs.text_gb: 他们看出这比喻是指着他们说的，就想要捉拿祂，只是惧怕群众，于是离开祂走了。
refs.text_big5: 他們看出這比喻是指著他們說的，就想要捉拿祂，只是懼怕群眾，於是離開祂走了。
refs.text_en: And they sought to seize Him, yet they feared the crowd, for they perceived that it was with them in view that He spoke the parable. And leaving Him, they went away.

refs.text_gb: 因为希律晓得约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，并且保护他；虽听他讲论，甚感困惑，却仍喜欢听他。
refs.text_big5: 因為希律曉得約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，並且保護他；雖聽他講論，甚感困惑，卻仍喜歡聽他。
refs.text_en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. And when he heard him, he was very perplexed yet heard him gladly.

refs.text_gb: 那时，耶路撒冷和犹太全地，并约但河四周全境的人，都络绎地出去到约翰那里，
refs.text_big5: 那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約但河四周全境的人，都絡繹的出去到約翰那裏，
refs.text_en: At that time Jerusalem and all Judea and all the surrounding region of the Jordan went out to him,

refs.text_gb: 约翰是点着且发亮的灯，你们情愿暂时在他的光中欢腾。
refs.text_big5: 約翰是點著且發亮的燈，你們情願暫時在他的光中歡騰。
refs.text_en: He was the lamp that was burning and shining, and you were willing to exult for a while in his light.

refs.text_gb: 你们出去究竟为什么？要看申言者么？我告诉你们，是的，他比申言者大多了。
refs.text_big5: 你們出去究竟為甚麼？要看申言者麼？我告訴你們，是的，他比申言者大多了。
refs.text_en: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and much more than a prophet.

refs.text_gb: 希律想要杀他，只是怕群众，因他们都以约翰为申言者。
refs.text_big5: 希律想要殺他，只是怕群眾，因他們都以約翰為申言者。
refs.text_en: And though he desired to kill him, he feared the crowd because they held him as a prophet.

refs.text_gb: 于是想要捉拿祂，只是惧怕群众，因为群众以祂为申言者。
refs.text_big5: 於是想要捉拿祂，只是懼怕群眾，因為群眾以祂為申言者。
refs.text_en: And though they sought to seize Him, they feared the crowds because they held Him as a prophet.

verses.text_gb: 于是他们回答耶稣说，我们[Fn1]不知道。耶稣便对他们说，[Fn2]我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
verses.text_big5: 於是他們回答耶穌說，我們[Fn1]不知道。耶穌便對他們說，[Fn2]我也不告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。
verses.text_en: And they answered Jesus and said, We do not know. And Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是他们回答耶稣说，我们不知道。耶稣便对他们说，我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是他們回答耶穌說，我們不知道。耶穌便對他們說，我也不告訴你們，我仗著甚麼權柄作這些事。

footnotes.zh: 这是谎言。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是謊言。
footnotes.en: 11:33 1 not This was a lie.

footnotes.zh: 见太二一27注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見太二一27註2。

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]耶稣就用[Cra]比喻对他们[Crb]说，有人栽了一个[Crc]葡萄园，四周围上篱笆，挖了一个[Crd]压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给[Cre]园户，就往[Crf]外国去了。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]耶穌就用[Cra]比喻對他們[Crb]說，有人栽了一個[Crc]葡萄園，四周圍上籬笆，挖了一個[Crd]壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給[Cre]園戶，就往[Crf]外國去了。
verses.text_en: And He began to speak to them in parables: A man planted a vineyard and put a hedge around it and dug a vat for a winepress and built a tower; and he leased it out to vinedressers and went abroad.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶稣就用比喻对他们说，有人栽了一个葡萄园，四周围上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說，有人栽了一個葡萄園，四周圍上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。

footnotes.en: 12:1 1 And For vv. 1-12, see notes in Matt. 21:33-46.

refs.text_gb: 祂就用比喻教训他们许多事，在教训之间，对他们说，
refs.text_big5: 祂就用比喻教訓他們許多事，在教訓之間，對他們說，
refs.text_en: And He taught them many things in parables and said to them in His teaching:

refs.text_gb: 你们听另一个比喻。有一个作家主的人，栽了一个葡萄园，四周围上篱笆，里面挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。
refs.text_big5: 你們聽另一個比喻。有一個作家主的人，栽了一個葡萄園，四周圍上籬笆，裏面挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
refs.text_en: Hear another parable. There was a man, a householder, who planted a vineyard and put a hedge around it, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower; and he leased it out to vinedressers and went abroad.

refs.text_gb: 收果子的时候近了，他打发奴仆到园户那里去收果子。
refs.text_big5: 收果子的時候近了，他打發奴僕到園戶那裏去收果子。
refs.text_en: And when the time to harvest the fruit drew near, he sent his slaves to the vinedressers to get his fruit.

refs.text_gb: 园户拿住他的奴仆，打了一个，杀了一个，用石头打死一个。
refs.text_big5: 園戶拿住他的奴僕，打了一個，殺了一個，用石頭打死一個。
refs.text_en: And the vinedressers took his slaves and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

refs.text_gb: 他又打发别的奴仆去，比先前更多，园户还是照样待他们。
refs.text_big5: 他又打發別的奴僕去，比先前更多，園戶還是照樣待他們。
refs.text_en: Again, he sent some other slaves, more than the first, and they did likewise to them.

refs.text_gb: 后来就打发他的儿子到他们那里去，心里说，他们必尊敬我的儿子。
refs.text_big5: 後來就打發他的兒子到他們那裏去，心裏說，他們必尊敬我的兒子。
refs.text_en: Then later he sent to them his son, saying, They will respect my son.

refs.text_gb: 不料，园户看见那儿子，就彼此说，这是承受产业的；来吧，我们杀了他，得他的产业。
refs.text_big5: 不料，園戶看見那兒子，就彼此說，這是承受產業的；來罷，我們殺了他，得他的產業。
refs.text_en: But the vinedressers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take possession of his inheritance.

refs.text_gb: 于是拿住他，推出葡萄园外杀了。
refs.text_big5: 於是拿住他，推出葡萄園外殺了。
refs.text_en: And they took him and cast him out of the vineyard and killed him.

refs.text_gb: 这样，葡萄园的主人来到的时候，要怎样处治那些园户？
refs.text_big5: 這樣，葡萄園的主人來到的時候，要怎樣處治那些園戶？
refs.text_en: Therefore when the master of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vinedressers?

refs.text_gb: 他们说，他必凶恶的除灭那些恶人，将葡萄园另租给那按时候交果子的园户。
refs.text_big5: 他們說，他必兇惡的除滅那些惡人，將葡萄園另租給那按時候交果子的園戶。
refs.text_en: They said to Him, He will miserably destroy those evil men and will lease the vineyard to other vinedressers, who will give the fruit to him in their seasons.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，“匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头；这是主所作的，在我们眼中看为希奇。”你们在经上从来没有念过么？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，“匠人所棄的石頭，已成了房角的頭塊石頭；這是主所作的，在我們眼中看為希奇。”你們在經上從來沒有念過麼？
refs.text_en: Jesus said to them, Have you never read in the Scriptures, "The stone which the builders rejected, this has become the head of the corner. This was from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes"?

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，神的国必从你们夺去，赐给那能结果子的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，神的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
refs.text_en: Therefore I say to you that the kingdom of God shall be taken from you and shall be given to a nation producing its fruit.

refs.text_gb: 那跌在这石头上的，必要跌碎；这石头掉在谁身上，就要把谁砸得粉碎，簸散如糠秕。
refs.text_big5: 那跌在這石頭上的，必要跌碎；這石頭掉在誰身上，就要把誰砸得粉碎，簸散如糠秕。
refs.text_en: And he who falls on this stone shall be broken to pieces; but on whomever it falls, it shall crush him to powder and scatter him like chaff.

refs.text_gb: 祭司长和法利赛人听了祂的比喻，就看出祂是指着他们说的；
refs.text_big5: 祭司長和法利賽人聽了祂的比喻，就看出祂是指著他們說的；
refs.text_en: And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard His parables, they perceived that He was speaking concerning them.

refs.text_gb: 于是想要捉拿祂，只是惧怕群众，因为群众以祂为申言者。
refs.text_big5: 於是想要捉拿祂，只是懼怕群眾，因為群眾以祂為申言者。
refs.text_en: And though they sought to seize Him, they feared the crowds because they held Him as a prophet.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对百姓说这个比喻：有人栽了一个葡萄园，租给园户，就到外国去了很久。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對百姓說這個比喻：有人栽了一個葡萄園，租給園戶，就到外國去了很久。
refs.text_en: And He began to speak to the people this parable: A certain man planted a vineyard and leased it out to vinedressers and went abroad for a considerable time.

refs.text_gb: 到了时候，打发一个奴仆到园户那里，叫他们把葡萄园的果子交给他；园户竟打了他，叫他空手回去。
refs.text_big5: 到了時候，打發一個奴僕到園戶那裏，叫他們把葡萄園的果子交給他；園戶竟打了他，叫他空手回去。
refs.text_en: And at the proper time he sent a slave to the vinedressers so that they might give him some of the fruit of the vineyard; but the vinedressers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

refs.text_gb: 园主再打发另一个奴仆去，他们也打了他，并且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。
refs.text_big5: 園主再打發另一個奴僕去，他們也打了他，並且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。
refs.text_en: And he went on to send another slave, but they beat that one also, and dishonored him, and sent him away empty-handed.

refs.text_gb: 园主又打发第三个再去，他们也打伤了他，把他推出去。
refs.text_big5: 園主又打發第三個再去，他們也打傷了他，把他推出去。
refs.text_en: And he went on to send a third, but that one also they wounded and threw out.

refs.text_gb: 葡萄园的主人说，我怎么办？我要打发我的儿子，就是我所爱的去，或者他们会尊敬他。
refs.text_big5: 葡萄園的主人說，我怎麼辦？我要打發我的兒子，就是我所愛的去，或者他們會尊敬他。
refs.text_en: And the master of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my son, the beloved; they will probably respect this one.

refs.text_en: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned with one another, saying, This is the heir; let us kill him that the inheritance may become ours.

refs.text_gb: 于是把他推出葡萄园外杀了。这样，葡萄园的主人要怎样处治他们？
refs.text_big5: 於是把他推出葡萄園外殺了。這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎樣處治他們？
refs.text_en: And they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the master of the vineyard do to them?

refs.text_gb: 他要来除灭这些园户，将葡萄园租给别人。众人听见了，就说，千万不可。
refs.text_big5: 他要來除滅這些園戶，將葡萄園租給別人。眾人聽見了，就說，千萬不可。
refs.text_en: He will come and destroy these vinedressers and will give the vineyard to others. And when they heard this, they said, May it never happen!

refs.text_gb: 耶稣看着他们说，那么，经上写着，“匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头。”这是什么意思？

refs.text_en: But He looked at them, and said, What then is this that is written, "The stone which the builders rejected, this has become the head of the corner"?

refs.text_gb: 凡跌在那石头上的，必要跌碎；那石头掉在谁身上，就要把谁砸得粉碎，簸散如糠秕。

refs.text_en: But what do you think? A man had two children. And he came to his first son and said, Child, go today and work in the vineyard.

refs.text_gb: 我要歌唱我所亲爱的，唱我所爱者的歌，论到祂的葡萄园。我所亲爱的有葡萄园，在肥美的山冈上。

refs.text_en: Let me sing of my Beloved, / A song of my Beloved concerning His vineyard. / My Beloved had a vineyard / On a fertile hill.

refs.text_gb: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树，赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。
refs.text_big5: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹，趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。
refs.text_en: You brought a vine out of Egypt; / You drove out nations and planted it;

refs.text_gb: 然而我栽种你是上好的葡萄树，全然是真种子。你怎么向我变为外邦葡萄树的坏枝条呢？
refs.text_big5: 然而我栽種你是上好的葡萄樹，全然是真種子。你怎麼向我變為外邦葡萄樹的壞枝條呢？
refs.text_en: Yet I, I had planted you as a choice vine, / Wholly a faithful seed. / How then have you turned yourself before Me / Into the degenerate shoots of a foreign vine?

refs.text_gb: 祂刨挖园子，清除石头，栽种上等的葡萄树，又在园中盖了一座楼，凿出压酒池；指望结好葡萄，反倒结了野葡萄。
refs.text_big5: 祂刨挖園子，清除石頭，栽種上等的葡萄樹，又在園中蓋了一座樓，鑿出壓酒池；指望結好葡萄，反倒結了野葡萄。
refs.text_en: And He dug it up and cleared away its stones, / And He planted it with the choicest vine. / Then He built a tower in the middle of it, / And hewed out a wine vat in it. / And He looked for it to produce grapes, / But it produced only wild grapes.

refs.text_gb: 伸出镰刀吧，因为庄稼熟了；前来践踏吧，因为酒醡满了；酒池盈溢，因为他们的罪恶甚大。
refs.text_big5: 伸出鐮刀罷，因為莊稼熟了；前來踐踏罷，因為酒醡滿了；酒池盈溢，因為他們的罪惡甚大。
refs.text_en: Send forth the sickle, / For the harvest is ripe; / Come, tread, / For the winepress is full; / The wine vats overflow, / For their evil is great.

refs.text_gb: 所罗门在巴力哈们有一葡萄园：他将这葡萄园交给看守的人，每人要为其中的果子交一千舍客勒银子。

refs.text_en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon: / He let out the vineyard to keepers; / Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

refs.text_gb: 我自己的葡萄园在我面前。所罗门哪，一千舍客勒归你，二百舍客勒归看守果子的人。
refs.text_big5: 我自己的葡萄園在我面前。所羅門哪，一千舍客勒歸你，二百舍客勒歸看守果子的人。
refs.text_en: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me. / You will have the thousand, O Solomon; / And those who keep its fruit, two hundred.

refs.text_gb: 这事正如一个人往外国去，离开本家，把权柄交给他的奴仆，分派各人的工作，又吩咐看门的要儆醒。

refs.text_en: It is like a man who is about to go abroad, having left his house and given to his slaves authority, to each his work, and who commanded the doorkeeper to watch.

refs.text_gb: 诸天的国又好比一个人要往外国去，就叫了自己的奴仆来，把他的家业交给他们，
refs.text_big5: 諸天的國又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了自己的奴僕來，把他的家業交給他們，
refs.text_en: For the kingdom of the heavens is just like a man about to go abroad, who called his own slaves and delivered to them his possessions.

refs.text_gb: 按照各人的才干，个别的给了一个五他连得银子，一个二他连得，一个一他连得，就往外国去了。
refs.text_big5: 按照各人的才幹，個別的給了一個五他連得銀子，一個二他連得，一個一他連得，就往外國去了。
refs.text_en: To one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to each according to his own ability. And he went abroad.
